fonte: 47 baralhos Anki do Ronaldo (revisados pela sessão Preparação Cesgranrio Transpetro contra os capítulos e gabaritos oficiais)

decks.nome: Ingles - Vocabulario das provas nivel 2 e expressoes
Arquitetura de Dados - Cartoes de bolso
Engenharia de Software - Cartoes de bolso
Governanca e LGPD - Cartoes de bolso

cards.f: The main purpose of the text is to
cards.sig: Pede o objetivo do texto inteiro (ideia principal). Gesto: resolva por último; leia só verbo e objeto de cada alternativa; marque a que cobre mais parágrafos.
cards.dica: Foi a 1ª questão de Inglês nas 5 provas analisadas. Mesma pergunta: The main idea of the text is to.
cards.ex: The main purpose of the text is to (...) (B) speculate on matters that may affect the global energy market in 2018.
cards.nc: According to the text (detalhe); one can infer (trecho)

cards.f: According to the text,
cards.sig: Pede uma informação escrita no texto (informação específica). Gesto: ache a âncora, leia a frase inteira e a seguinte; confira sujeito, verbo, número e tempo.
cards.dica: according to = de acordo com. É o tipo que mais cai: 2,3 questões por prova.
cards.ex: According to Text I, WEO-2017 includes a special focus on China because this country has been
cards.nc: one can infer (pede dedução, não cópia)

cards.f: is mentioned in paragraph 4 because
cards.sig: Pede o motivo de algo ser citado naquele parágrafo. Gesto: vá ao parágrafo; o motivo costuma estar na frase da âncora ou na seguinte.
cards.dica: mentioned = mencionado. Texto que especula (would, might) pede resposta que especula.
cards.ex: The production of oil from shale rock in the US is mentioned in paragraph 4 (lines 21-29) because in 2018 it

cards.f: EXCEPT / NOT
cards.sig: EXCETO / NÃO: inverte a pergunta. Quatro alternativas estão no texto ou servem; marque a única que não serve. Gesto: confira uma por uma e risque as que encontrar no texto.
cards.dica: Circule o EXCEPT ou o NOT antes de ler as opções: é fácil esquecer no meio.
cards.ex: According to Jennifer Fremont-Smith and Paul G. Stoltz, mindset includes all of the following EXCEPT

cards.f: can be replaced / substituted, without change in meaning, by
cards.sig: Pede uma palavra de mesmo sentido no contexto. Gesto: cubra a palavra e diga em português o que caberia; dê o sinal (+ ou −) e corte as de sinal oposto.
cards.dica: replaced, substituted = substituído; without change in meaning = sem mudar o sentido. Se a palavra for conectivo, use a tabela de rótulos.
cards.ex: the word pivotal can be replaced, with no change in meaning, by (A) tricky (B) erratic (C) essential (D) haphazard (E) problematic
cards.nc: means (significa); refers to (a que se refere)

cards.f: means
cards.sig: Pede o significado da palavra ou expressão no texto. Gesto: volte à frase; o cognato ajuda (simultaneously = simultaneamente), mas confirme no contexto.
cards.dica: Expressão idiomática não se traduz palavra por palavra: take hold = ganhar força.
cards.ex: the term “simultaneously” means (A) at the same time
cards.nc: means that (paráfrase de um trecho inteiro)

cards.f: mean, respectively,
cards.sig: Dois termos e pares de respostas na mesma ordem. Gesto: resolva primeiro o termo mais fácil, corte os pares em que ele falha e só então teste o outro.
cards.dica: respectively = respectivamente. A isca acerta metade do par.
cards.ex: picked up and driven by mean, respectively, (...) (D) improved – motivated by

cards.f: the two items are synonymous in
cards.sig: Lista de pares: pede o par de SINÔNIMOS (mesmo sentido). Gesto: teste par a par na linha indicada; pares de sentido oposto são iscas.
cards.dica: Based on the meanings in the text = com base nos sentidos do texto. O par currently e actually era isca.
cards.ex: Based on the meanings in the text, the two items are synonymous in (...) (D) “key” (line 39) – main
cards.nc: antonymous (sentidos opostos)

cards.f: the two words are antonymous in
cards.sig: Pede o par de ANTÔNIMOS (sentidos opostos). Gesto: teste par a par; aqui o par certo foi curb (conter) e foster (estimular).
cards.dica: anti = contra: antonymous = de sentidos opostos.
cards.ex: Based on the meanings in Text I, the two words are antonymous in (...) (C) “...curb...” (line 46) – foster
cards.nc: synonymous (mesmo sentido)

cards.f: one can infer that / it can be concluded that
cards.sig: Pede uma dedução apoiada no trecho (inferência). Gesto: sublinhe 2 ou 3 palavras do trecho, dê a direção (sobe ou desce, + ou −) e marque a que diz o mesmo com outras palavras.
cards.dica: infer = deduzir; conclude = concluir. Variantes: it can be inferred that, one can conclude that. Conhecimento de mundo não vale: só o trecho.
cards.ex: “Right now, the satellite supplier market is booming, driving down the cost of access to satellites”, one can infer that the more access to the satellite supplier market is feasible, (A) the lower its price will be.
cards.nc: According to (informação escrita)

cards.f: can be associated with the idea of
cards.sig: Pede o rótulo do conectivo (opposition, addition, time, condition...). Gesto: dê o rótulo pela tabela sem traduzir a frase e confira os dois lados.
cards.dica: Variante: the words in bold are associated with the idea of.
cards.ex: the word However can be associated with the idea of (A) time (B) condition (C) emphasis (D) opposition (E) accumulation

cards.f: establishes cohesion by means of indicating
cards.sig: Também pede o rótulo do conectivo: que relação ele indica (example, result, opposition, condition, purpose).
cards.dica: cohesion = coesão; by means of = por meio de.
cards.ex: the term “for instance” establishes cohesion by means of indicating a/an (A) result (B) example (C) opposition (D) condition (E) purpose

cards.f: in which the boldfaced expression introduces an idea of addition
cards.sig: Forma invertida: o rótulo vem no enunciado (addition) e cada alternativa traz um conectivo. Gesto: rotule um por um e fique com o único da família pedida.
cards.dica: As outras traziam although, because of, even though e but: só as well as é adição.
cards.ex: The sentence, in Text I, in which the boldfaced expression introduces an idea of addition is (...) (D) “as well as other business relationships abroad.”

cards.f: refers to
cards.sig: Pede o referente: a que ou a quem o pronome ou a expressão se refere. Gesto: risque o que vem depois (o referente vem antes), filtre singular ou plural e substitua cada candidato.
cards.dica: O substantivo mais próximo é a isca mais comum.
cards.ex: the pronoun “its” refers to (A) brooms (B) items (C) chop (D) palm tree (E) indigenous peoples

cards.f: first, second, third, fourth, fifth paragraph
cards.sig: 1º, 2º, 3º, 4º e 5º parágrafo. O enunciado diz onde está a resposta: vá direto ao parágrafo indicado.
cards.dica: Numere os parágrafos a lápis antes de começar.
cards.ex: In the fragment in the fifth paragraph of the text “Today, art is still a hallmark of socioeconomic status, even though most bankers also treat art”

cards.f: sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth paragraph
cards.sig: 6º, 7º, 8º, 9º e 10º parágrafo.
cards.dica: Do 4º em diante, quase sempre é número + th: sixth, seventh, tenth (fifth, eighth e ninth mudam um pouco).
cards.ex: From the seventh paragraph of the text, one can infer that automated driving will have the benefits of

cards.f: the fragment in lines 30-39
cards.sig: o trecho das linhas 30 a 39. fragment = trecho; line = linha; paragraph = parágrafo. Em 30 de 40 questões o enunciado disse onde estava a resposta.
cards.dica: Leia a frase inteira do trecho, a anterior e a seguinte.
cards.ex: According to the fragment in lines 30-39, it is true that

cards.f: boldfaced / in bold / in boldface
cards.sig: em negrito: o termo-alvo da questão está destacado no texto.
cards.dica: bold = negrito.
cards.ex: the expression in bold refers to

cards.f: criticize, disapprove, repudiate, disavow
cards.sig: Verbos de ATAQUE: criticar, desaprovar, repudiar, renegar. Em ideia principal, corte-os quando o texto informa ou elogia.
cards.dica: Na BNDES 2024 Q31, repudiate (A) e disavow (D) eram iscas; a certa foi inform about (C).
cards.ex: The main idea of the text is to (A) disapprove space technology.
cards.exSrc: Transpetro 2023, Q11 (A é isca; gabarito E)
cards.nc: inform, describe, present (tom neutro)

cards.f: The communicative intention of Text I is to
cards.sig: Também pede a ideia principal: intenção comunicativa = propósito do autor. Gesto igual ao do main purpose: verbo e objeto, escopo do texto todo.
cards.dica: intention = intenção; communicative = comunicativa.
cards.ex: The communicative intention of Text I is to (...) (C) argue that Brazil should try to avoid potential dangers associated to its recent deepwater oil discoveries.
cards.nc: The main purpose of the text is to

cards.f: The main intention of Text II is to discuss the Brazilian
cards.sig: Quando o verbo já está no enunciado (to discuss, to describe), as alternativas são só substantivos: escolha o tema que resume o texto inteiro.
cards.dica: Na Banese 2025 Q10 (to describe the association between banking and), a resposta foi uma palavra: art.
cards.ex: The main intention of Text II is to discuss the Brazilian (...) (D) strategic partnership with the IEA in the field of energy aiming at a safer and sustainable future.

cards.f: the author states that / affirms that
cards.sig: Pede o que o autor afirma (informação explícita). Gesto: ache a âncora e leia a frase inteira; a certa costuma ser paráfrase (state-of-the-art virou cutting-edge).
cards.dica: state, como verbo = afirmar, declarar. Tendência ou necessidade não vira fato: has become highly competitive era isca (Transpetro 2018 Q19).
cards.ex: In the eighth paragraph of the text, the author states that, for the last 40 years, the company where he works has been
cards.nc: the author believes (opinião do autor)

cards.f: In terms of numerical reference, one concludes that
cards.sig: Pede qual número está ligado à informação certa. Gesto: volte à linha de cada número e confira a que ele se refere: produzido ou comercializado, total ou parte, alta ou queda.
cards.dica: In terms of = em termos de, quanto a. Os 40% eram do petróleo comercializado pelo Golfo, não do produzido.
cards.ex: In terms of numerical reference, one concludes that (A) “over 40 per cent” (lines 16-17) refers to the percentage of global oil produced by Iran and Saudi.
cards.exSrc: Transpetro 2018, Q17 (A é isca; gabarito B)

cards.f: it is true that / it is possible to affirm that
cards.sig: Pede a única alternativa verdadeira segundo o trecho. Gesto: em cada alternativa procure a peça trocada (sujeito, número, tempo); uma peça errada elimina.
cards.dica: true = verdadeiro; affirm = afirmar. Variante: it can be said that (pode-se dizer que).
cards.ex: According to the fragment in lines 30-39, it is true that
cards.nc: EXCEPT (procura a que não serve)

cards.f: all of the following
cards.sig: = todos os seguintes (os itens das alternativas). Costuma vir com EXCEPT: quatro servem, uma não.
cards.dica: following = seguinte; below = abaixo (in the fragments below).
cards.ex: it can be said that getting a job in the O&G industry can result from all the following situations, EXCEPT

cards.f: Based on the meanings of the words in the text, it can be said that
cards.sig: Cada alternativa traz palavra e rótulo (similar ideas, synonyms, antonyms, can be replaced by). Gesto: confira a palavra e também o rótulo, que pode estar trocado.
cards.dica: Surge e increase são sinônimos: a alternativa que os chamou de antonyms estava errada.
cards.ex: (E) “surge” (line 87) and increase are antonyms.
cards.exSrc: Transpetro 2018, Q18 (E é isca; gabarito D)
cards.nc: express similar ideas × express opposite ideas

cards.f: express similar ideas / express opposite ideas
cards.sig: similar ideas = sentidos parecidos (sinônimos); opposite ideas = sentidos opostos (antônimos).
cards.dica: Major e main são parecidos: a alternativa que dizia opposite ideas era isca.
cards.ex: (A) major (line 22) and main express opposite ideas.
cards.exSrc: Petrobras 2012, Q14 (A é isca; gabarito B)

cards.f: The fragment ... means that
cards.sig: Pede a paráfrase do trecho inteiro. Gesto: traduza o termo-chave antes de ler as opções (latency = atraso) e elimine as que contradizem esse termo.
cards.dica: low latency = atraso mínimo (minimal delay).
cards.ex: “The Satellites for Digitalization of Railways (SODOR) project will provide low latency” means that (...) (D) high volume of data will be transmitted with minimal delay.
cards.nc: means (sentido de uma palavra)

cards.f: The boldfaced item is synonymous with the expression in parentheses in
cards.sig: Cada alternativa traz o termo em negrito e um equivalente entre parênteses. Gesto: rotule os dois (sentido ou tipo de conectivo) e fique com o par de mesmo rótulo.
cards.dica: Aqui eram conectivos: because = due to the fact that (causa).
cards.ex: The boldfaced item is synonymous with the expression in parentheses in (...) because other sectors in the economy are going to grow as fast as Petrobras (...) (due to the fact that)

cards.f: implies that
cards.sig: = sugere, dá a entender (inferência). Gesto: expressão idiomática tem sentido figurado: roll up your sleeves = arregaçar as mangas, esforçar-se.
cards.dica: Não leia ao pé da letra: as alternativas sobre roupa eram iscas.
cards.ex: “be aware that you will need to roll up your sleeves and work hard for the first couple years, and you will be rewarded in the end.” (lines 23-25), implies that one must

cards.f: the author believes that
cards.sig: Pede a opinião do autor. Gesto: releia o trecho indicado e mantenha a mesma força: texto incerto pede resposta incerta; corte definitely e inevitable.
cards.dica: believe = acreditar.
cards.ex: According to the last paragraph, the author believes that the (A) future of the energy business is uncertain and difficult to anticipate.
cards.nc: the author states (afirmação explícita)

cards.f: Concerning the referent to the pronoun it, in the fragments below,
cards.sig: Lista: cada alternativa é um par pronome e referente. Gesto: teste par a par, pondo o referente proposto no lugar do it. Variante: In terms of pronominal reference.
cards.dica: Concerning = a respeito de. It vazio (making it harder) não retoma nada.
cards.ex: Concerning the referent to the pronoun it, in the fragments below, (...) (D) in “making it harder for Brazilian exporters of manufactured goods.” (lines 75-76), it refers to “stream” (line 75).
cards.exSrc: Petrobras 2011, Q15 (D é isca; gabarito E)

cards.f: The same suffix is found in
cards.sig: Pede outra palavra com o mesmo sufixo e a mesma função. Gesto: nomeie o sufixo (deeper = deep + -er, comparativo) e tire-o de cada opção: só serve se sobrar uma palavra do mesmo tipo.
cards.dica: water e together só terminam em -er: não é sufixo.
cards.ex: the words “deeper” and “wider” are formed by the addition of a suffix. The same suffix is found in (A) delay (B) water (C) together (D) stronger (E) wired

cards.f: express a future action, EXCEPT
cards.sig: Pede o único trecho que NÃO fala de futuro. Gesto: procure marcadores de tempo (next 25 years, soon after 2030, by the end of that decade); o futuro pode vir do marcador, sem will.
cards.dica: A que não era futuro descrevia o agora: are changing the face of the global energy system.
cards.ex: All the boldfaced verb phrases express a future action, EXCEPT in

cards.f: expresses an advice
cards.sig: Pede o modal de conselho: should (ou ought to). Must e have to = obrigação; need to = necessidade; can = capacidade ou possibilidade.
cards.dica: advice = conselho (falso cognato: não é aviso).
cards.ex: The sentence in which the boldfaced item expresses an advice is (...) (E) “They should be articulating their skills” (lines 68-69)
cards.nc: obligation (must, have to)

cards.f: Comparing Texts I and II, one concludes that
cards.sig: Pede o que vale para os dois textos ou só para um. Gesto: only e neither caem com um contraexemplo; em both, confira cada metade nos dois textos.
cards.dica: Nas 3 questões do tipo na sua pasta (Petrobras 2011, 2012 e 2017), o gabarito começava por both.
cards.ex: Comparing Texts I and II, one concludes that (...) (E) both Text I and Text II mention the importance of renewable resources and clean energy technologies as a means of meeting energy demand.

cards.f: speculate on
cards.sig: especular sobre, levantar hipóteses. Serve quando o texto diz que as respostas são incertas.
cards.dica: uncertain = incerto: texto incerto pede verbo de incerteza.
cards.ex: (B) speculate on matters that may affect the global energy market in 2018.
cards.nc: provide precise answers (contraria texto incerto)

cards.f: inform about / describe
cards.sig: informar sobre / descrever: verbos de tom neutro, típicos da ideia principal certa em texto informativo.
cards.dica: Foram gabaritos na BNDES 2024 Q31 (inform about) e na Transpetro 2023 Q11 (describe).
cards.ex: (C) inform about a new trend among businesses around the world that have striven to produce a more meaningful socioeconomic and environmental impact.
cards.nc: criticize, repudiate (ataque)

cards.f: present an overview of
cards.sig: apresentar um panorama, uma visão geral de: cobre o texto inteiro, por isso costuma ser a ideia principal.
cards.dica: overview = over (por cima) + view (visão).
cards.ex: (B) present an overview of world energy scenarios for the coming decades.

cards.f: provide precise answers
cards.sig: dar respostas precisas: isca quando o próprio texto diz que as respostas são incertas.
cards.dica: precise = preciso, exato.
cards.ex: (C) provide precise answers to the most relevant questions on global energy.
cards.exSrc: Transpetro 2018, Q11 (C é isca; gabarito B)
cards.nc: speculate on (especular)

cards.f: anticipate / forecast / predict
cards.sig: prever, antecipar. Em ideia principal, confira o prazo e o escopo: ano ou década errados derrubam a alternativa.
cards.dica: O relatório ia até 2040; in the next decade era isca.
cards.ex: (E) anticipate how the US, China and India will transform the global energy system in the next decade.
cards.exSrc: Petrobras 2017, Q11 (E é isca; gabarito B)

cards.f: argue that
cards.sig: argumentar, defender a tese de que. Aparece quando o texto toma posição (should, must).
cards.ex: (C) argue that Brazil should try to avoid potential dangers associated to its recent deepwater oil discoveries.

cards.f: list potential dangers
cards.sig: listar perigos potenciais: tom de ALARME, errado quando o texto é otimista. List sozinho pode ser certo.
cards.dica: Na Petrobras 2012 Q18, o gabarito foi list relevant hints (E).
cards.ex: (D) list potential dangers of space technology.
cards.exSrc: Transpetro 2023, Q11 (D é isca; gabarito E)

cards.f: presents a series of actions exclusively performed in the past
cards.sig: Pede o trecho em que TODOS os verbos estão no passado. Gesto: um único verbo no presente (hold, am, want) elimina a alternativa.
cards.dica: exclusively = exclusivamente, só.
cards.ex: The only fragment from Text I that presents a series of actions exclusively performed in the past is

cards.f: opposition
cards.sig: Rótulo de CONTRASTE: a segunda parte contraria a primeira. Família: however, but, nevertheless, although, despite.
cards.dica: Nas alternativas também aparece como contrast ou concession.
cards.ex: the word However can be associated with the idea of (...) (D) opposition
cards.nc: emphasis (ênfase); accumulation (adição)

cards.f: addition (accumulation)
cards.sig: adição, acúmulo: a segunda parte soma uma informação à primeira. Família: moreover, furthermore, besides, in addition, also, as well as.
cards.dica: accumulation = acúmulo: mesmo rótulo que addition.
cards.ex: The sentence, in Text I, in which the boldfaced expression introduces an idea of addition is
cards.exSrc: Petrobras 2012, Q15 (gabarito D, as well as)

cards.f: result (conclusion, consequence)
cards.sig: resultado: a segunda parte é consequência ou conclusão da primeira (portanto, por isso). Família: therefore, thus, hence, so, consequently, as a result.
cards.dica: Pergunte: a 2ª parte acontece por causa da 1ª? Então é result.
cards.nc: cause (a 2ª parte é o motivo)

cards.f: purpose
cards.sig: finalidade, objetivo: para, a fim de. Família: in order to, so as to, so that, to + verbo.
cards.dica: É a mesma palavra de The main purpose of the text (o objetivo principal).
cards.nc: result (consequência)

cards.f: time
cards.sig: tempo: when, while, meanwhile, until, since (desde), as (à medida que). Cuidado: while, since e as também têm outro sentido.
cards.dica: Teste: dá para trocar por quando, enquanto ou desde?

cards.f: however
cards.sig: opposition: porém, no entanto, contudo. Mesma família: nevertheless.
cards.dica: Depois de however vem a virada: o que segue contraria o anterior.
cards.ex: However, others are already delivering practical results.
cards.nc: moreover (adição); how (como)

cards.f: but
cards.sig: opposition: mas, porém. Mesma família: however, yet.
cards.ex: But it’s not just natural ecosystems that can benefit from prioritizing regeneration.
cards.nc: not only ... but also (aí é adição)

cards.f: Still, this is far from enough to avoid severe impacts of climate change.
cards.sig: Still no início da frase, com vírgula = contraste: mesmo assim, ainda assim (= nevertheless).
cards.dica: Pegadinha da banca: aqui não é o 'ainda' de tempo.
cards.ex: In the fragment “Still, this is far from enough to avoid severe impacts of climate change” (lines 93-94), Still can be replaced, without changing the meaning of the sentence, by
cards.nc: still no meio da frase = ainda

cards.f: Some projects are still in the planning stages, ...
cards.sig: still no meio da frase = ainda (algo continua). Aqui não é contraste.
cards.ex: Some projects are still in the planning stages, offering great promise for the future.
cards.nc: Still, no início = mesmo assim (contraste)

cards.f: nevertheless
cards.sig: opposition: no entanto, mesmo assim. Mesma família: nonetheless, however.
cards.dica: never + the + less: nem por isso menos = mesmo assim.
cards.ex: Nevertheless, for Brazil, this represents something much more spectacular.

cards.f: although
cards.sig: opposition (concessão): embora. Mesma família: though, even though.
cards.ex: Although far fewer women work in the oil and gas (O&G) industry compared to men, many women find rewarding careers in the industry.
cards.nc: also (também); always (sempre)

cards.f: even though
cards.sig: opposition (concessão): mesmo que, embora. Mesma família: although.
cards.ex: Today, art is still a hallmark of socioeconomic status, even though most bankers also treat art both as a financial investment and interior decoration
cards.nc: even (até, mesmo); even so (mesmo assim)

cards.f: While skills are certainly desirable for many positions, ...
cards.sig: while com ideias que se opõem = embora, ao passo que (contraste).
cards.dica: Teste: troque por embora; se a frase fizer sentido, é contraste.
cards.ex: While skills are certainly desirable for many positions, does having the right ones guarantee you’ll get the job?
cards.nc: while com ações ao mesmo tempo = enquanto (tempo)

cards.f: despite
cards.sig: opposition (concessão): apesar de. Mesma família: in spite of. Vem antes de substantivo ou de -ing.
cards.dica: despite the fact that = apesar de que (+ oração).
cards.ex: Despite the gulf tragedy, the quest for oil and gas in the most difficult places on the planet is just getting underway.
cards.nc: although (+ oração)

cards.f: moreover
cards.sig: addition: além disso. Mesma família: furthermore, besides, in addition.
cards.dica: more + over: mais por cima = além disso.
cards.nc: however (contraste)

cards.f: furthermore
cards.sig: addition: além disso, ademais. Mesma família: besides, moreover.
cards.dica: further = mais adiante: soma mais um ponto.
cards.ex: Furthermore, those who had two or more of these statements, were seven times more likely to get the job
cards.exSrc: BR Distribuidora 2011, Q19 (troca por Besides, gabarito C)
cards.nc: therefore (resultado)

cards.f: besides
cards.sig: addition: além disso; além de. Mesma família: furthermore, moreover.
cards.ex: Furthermore can be substituted, without change in meaning, by (A) Instead (B) However (C) Besides
cards.nc: beside (sem s) = ao lado de

cards.f: also
cards.sig: addition: também.
cards.ex: Satellite communications will also be pivotal.
cards.nc: although (embora)

cards.f: as well as
cards.sig: addition: assim como, além de, e também.
cards.dica: Foi a única de adição entre although, because of, even though e but.
cards.ex: ...with phone calls and emails with our facility in Norway, as well as other business relationships abroad.
cards.nc: as (já que; à medida que)

cards.f: therefore
cards.sig: result: portanto, por isso. Mesma família: thus, consequently.
cards.dica: there + fore: por isso.
cards.ex: Still can be replaced, without changing the meaning of the sentence, by (A) Therefore (B) Furthermore (C) Nevertheless (D) In other words (E) Because of that
cards.exSrc: Petrobras 2017, Q17 (A e E valem o mesmo e caíram juntas)
cards.nc: however (contraste); furthermore (adição)

cards.f: so
cards.sig: result: então, por isso (o que vem depois é consequência do que veio antes).
cards.dica: Teste: troque por por isso; se a frase continuar fazendo sentido, é resultado.
cards.ex: This generation entering the workforce has already been branded with the word “entitlement,” so students will need to fight against this bias
cards.nc: so that (para que: finalidade); so + adjetivo + that (tão ... que); so far (até agora)

cards.f: because of that
cards.sig: result: por causa disso, por isso (that retoma a causa já dita).
cards.dica: because = causa; because of that = consequência.
cards.ex: Still can be replaced (...) by (A) Therefore (...) (E) Because of that
cards.exSrc: Petrobras 2017, Q17 (A e E valem o mesmo e caíram juntas)
cards.nc: because (causa)

cards.f: because
cards.sig: cause: porque (+ oração). Mesma família: since, as, due to the fact that.
cards.dica: Na Petrobras 2011 Q17, because = due to the fact that foi o gabarito.
cards.ex: because other sectors in the economy are going to grow as fast as Petrobras
cards.nc: because of (+ substantivo); because of that (resultado)

cards.f: ...since the concept of regeneration presupposes environmental damage.
cards.sig: since + motivo = já que, uma vez que (causa).
cards.dica: Se vier data ou época depois (since 2010), é desde.
cards.ex: (E) explain that regenerative brands act in diametrical opposition to sustainable ones, since the concept of regeneration presupposes environmental damage.
cards.nc: since + data = desde (tempo)

cards.f: due to
cards.sig: cause: devido a (+ substantivo). Mesma família: owing to, because of.
cards.ex: ...because, due to its long-term energy policies, the country

cards.f: given that
cards.sig: cause (premissa): considerando que, dado que. Paráfrase literal: taking into account that.
cards.ex: The threat to stability is all the greater given that Iran is likely to win any such clash
cards.exSrc: Transpetro 2018, Q13 (gabarito E, taking into account that)
cards.nc: even so, even though, despite the fact that (concessão)

cards.f: if
cards.sig: condition: se.
cards.ex: If it can, the result will limit global demand growth for oil, gas and coal.
cards.nc: whether (se ... ou não, em pergunta indireta)

cards.f: in order to
cards.sig: purpose: para, a fim de (+ verbo). Mesma família: so as to, to.
cards.ex: (A) joint effort with the IEA in order to implement The Biofuture Platform in the near future.

cards.f: for instance
cards.sig: example: por exemplo. Mesma família: for example.
cards.dica: instance = caso, exemplo.
cards.ex: For instance, Reimagine Appalachia (RI) is a multi-stakeholder coalition that aims to revitalize abandoned coal mines

cards.f: such as
cards.sig: example: como, tais como (introduz exemplos).
cards.ex: ...use its wood to produce and sell items such as brooms.
cards.nc: such sozinho = tal, desse tipo

cards.f: when
cards.sig: time: quando.
cards.ex: The turning point in this journey for art and banking came in the 1940s, when the art world’s centre of gravity suddenly shifted straight across the Atlantic
cards.nc: where (onde)

cards.f: RI is supporting the Appalachian Regional Reforestation Initiative, while also creating jobs
cards.sig: while com ações ao mesmo tempo = enquanto, ao mesmo tempo que (tempo).
cards.ex: RI is supporting the Appalachian Regional Reforestation Initiative, while also creating jobs and economic opportunities in the region.
cards.nc: while com ideias opostas = embora, ao passo que

cards.f: ...has grown increasingly transactional since the Medici era
cards.sig: since + época ou data = desde (tempo).
cards.dica: Na Transpetro 2018 Q17, o gabarito falava da queda de custos since 2010 (desde 2010).
cards.ex: ...we may observe how the relationship between artists and bankers has grown increasingly transactional since the Medici era.
cards.nc: since + motivo = já que (causa)

cards.f: because of
cards.sig: cause: por causa de (+ substantivo). Mesma família: due to, owing to.
cards.ex: I chose the oil and gas industry because of the challenging projects, and I want to be part of our country’s energy solution.
cards.nc: because (+ oração)

cards.f: in spite of
cards.sig: opposition (concessão): apesar de, antes de substantivo ou de -ing. Mesmo valor de despite.
cards.dica: Caiu no próprio enunciado: in spite of the oil spill disaster = apesar do desastre do vazamento de petróleo.
cards.ex: According to Text II, in spite of the oil spill disaster in the Gulf of Mexico,
cards.nc: although, even though (+ oração completa)

cards.f: concession
cards.sig: concessão: admite um fato e mesmo assim afirma outro (embora, apesar de). É da família opposition: although, even though, despite.
cards.dica: Concede (admite) e depois contraria.

cards.f: emphasis
cards.sig: ênfase, reforço: indeed, in fact. Nas provas lidas, só apareceu como alternativa errada.
cards.ex: the word However can be associated with the idea of (...) (C) emphasis
cards.exSrc: Transpetro 2023, Q12 (C é isca; gabarito D)

cards.f: yet
cards.sig: opposition, no início da oração: mas, contudo. Em frase negativa, not yet = ainda não.
cards.nc: still (ainda)

cards.f: whereas
cards.sig: opposition: ao passo que, enquanto (compara dois lados opostos). Mesma família: while.
cards.nc: where (onde)

cards.f: even so
cards.sig: opposition: mesmo assim, ainda assim.
cards.dica: Na Transpetro 2018 Q13, even so era alternativa errada para given that, que é causa.
cards.ex: ...but even so the achievement is considerable.
cards.nc: even though (embora)

cards.f: on the other hand
cards.sig: opposition: por outro lado (apresenta o lado contrário).
cards.dica: Era isca para trocar Furthermore, que é adição.
cards.ex: Furthermore can be substituted, without change in meaning, by (...) (E) On the other hand
cards.exSrc: BR Distribuidora 2011, Q19 (E é isca; gabarito C)
cards.nc: in addition (adição)

cards.f: rather than
cards.sig: contraste, substituição: em vez de, e não. Mesma família: instead of.
cards.ex: ...its true mission should be to boost people’s vitality rather than protect them from death.
cards.nc: rather sozinho = bastante

cards.f: in addition (to)
cards.sig: addition: além disso; além de. Mesma família: moreover, besides.

cards.f: not only ... but also
cards.sig: addition: não só ... mas também.
cards.dica: Mesmo com but, aqui é soma, não contraste.
cards.ex: They are doing it not only because it drastically reduces water use and emissions, boosts soil fertility and improves animal welfare, but also because it enhances the livelihoods...
cards.nc: but sozinho (contraste)

cards.f: thus
cards.sig: result: assim, desse modo, portanto. Mesma família: hence, therefore.

cards.f: As a result,
cards.sig: result: como resultado, por isso: o que vem depois é a consequência.
cards.ex: As a result, our latest data shows that Brazil will become a net oil exporter this year
cards.nc: as a result of + substantivo = por causa de (causa)

cards.f: Electric vehicles (EVs) are in the fast lane as a result of government support
cards.sig: as a result of + substantivo = por causa de, devido a: apresenta a CAUSA, não a consequência.
cards.dica: Sem of (As a result,) é consequência; com of, é causa.
cards.ex: Electric vehicles (EVs) are in the fast lane as a result of government support and declining battery costs
cards.nc: As a result, (consequência)

cards.f: ...the obituary of oil, as growth for trucks (...) keep pushing demand higher
cards.sig: as + motivo = já que, porque (causa).
cards.ex: ...but it is far too early to write the obituary of oil, as growth for trucks, petrochemicals, shipping and aviation keep pushing demand higher.
cards.nc: as = à medida que (tempo); as ... as = tão ... quanto

cards.f: taking into account that
cards.sig: cause: levando em conta que (= given that). Foi o gabarito por ser a paráfrase mais literal.
cards.dica: Sobrando duas da família certa, fique com a mais literal.
cards.ex: given that can be replaced, without change in meaning, by (...) (D) because of the fact that (E) taking into account that
cards.nc: because of the fact that (causal, mas menos literal)

cards.f: unless
cards.sig: condition negativa: a menos que, a não ser que (= if not).
cards.dica: less = menos: unless = a menos que.

cards.f: provided that
cards.sig: condition: desde que, contanto que. Mesma família: as long as, providing that.
cards.dica: Aqui desde que é condição, não tempo.
cards.nc: since (desde: tempo)

cards.f: as long as
cards.sig: condition: desde que, contanto que (não é tempo).
cards.dica: Parece 'tão longo quanto', mas é condição.

cards.f: so that
cards.sig: purpose: para que, a fim de que (+ oração).
cards.dica: so sozinho = por isso; so that = para que.
cards.ex: (B) wear formal clothes to work so that, as years go by, a couple of top-rank officers can recognize one’s worth.
cards.nc: so (resultado)

cards.f: meanwhile
cards.sig: time: enquanto isso, ao mesmo tempo.
cards.ex: ...pushed by deployment in China and India, meanwhile in the European Union, wind becomes the leading source of electricity soon after 2030.
cards.nc: mean (significar); means (meio)

cards.f: until
cards.sig: time: até (que). not until = só quando.

cards.f: ...as economic growth has picked up, so has consumption of oil and coal
cards.sig: as + mudança gradual = à medida que, conforme (tempo, proporção).
cards.dica: so has consumption = assim também o consumo (subiu).
cards.ex: ...some recent data suggests that as economic growth has picked up, so has consumption of oil and coal.
cards.nc: as = já que (causa)

cards.f: so far
cards.sig: time: até agora, até o momento (não é resultado).
cards.dica: Na Petrobras 2011 Q17, trocar so far por meanwhile estava errado.
cards.ex: ...neither the company nor the country’s oil industry has so far been big enough to become a government cash cow.
cards.nc: so (por isso)

cards.f: in other words
cards.sig: reformulation: em outras palavras, ou seja. Mesma família: that is, i.e.
cards.ex: Still can be replaced, without changing the meaning of the sentence, by (...) (D) In other words

cards.f: in fact
cards.sig: emphasis: de fato, na verdade. Mesma família: indeed.
cards.dica: Nas provas lidas, ênfase só apareceu como alternativa errada.
cards.ex: In fact, extreme oil will likely be the new normal.
cards.nc: in other words (reformulação: ou seja)

cards.f: it
cards.sig: singular de coisa (ou animal): ele, ela, isso. Procure um substantivo singular ANTES do it.
cards.dica: Teste: troque o it pelo candidato e releia a frase.
cards.ex: “Brazil has everything that China doesn’t and it’s natural that, as China continues to grow, it’s just going to be starved for those resources,”
cards.nc: it vazio (it is hard to): não retoma nada

cards.f: WEO-2017 finds it is too early to write the obituary of oil.
cards.sig: it vazio: sujeito obrigatório do inglês que não retoma nada (é cedo demais para...). Não procure referente.
cards.dica: Padrões: it is + adjetivo + to; it is time that.
cards.ex: Given the climate urgency, it is time that businesses think and act beyond sustainability.

cards.f: making it harder for Brazilian exporters
cards.sig: make it + adjetivo + for/to: it vazio que antecipa o que vem depois (torna mais difícil para os exportadores). Não retoma o substantivo anterior.
cards.dica: A alternativa que ligava esse it a stream era isca.
cards.ex: ...before the new oil fields have fully come on stream, making it harder for Brazilian exporters of manufactured goods.

cards.f: its
cards.sig: possessivo singular de coisa: seu, sua, dele, dela (de algo). Retoma um substantivo singular anterior.
cards.dica: Teste: its wood = the palm tree’s wood (a madeira da palmeira).
cards.ex: The Amazon’s indigenous peoples chop this palm tree down and use its wood to produce and sell items such as brooms.
cards.exSrc: BNDES 2024, Q34 (its = palm tree, gabarito D)
cards.nc: it’s = it is

cards.f: it’s
cards.sig: contração de it is (ou it has): é, está. Não é possessivo.
cards.dica: Com apóstrofo = it is; sem apóstrofo (its) = dele, dela.
cards.ex: But it’s not just natural ecosystems that can benefit from prioritizing regeneration.
cards.nc: its (possessivo)

cards.f: they
cards.sig: plural (pessoas ou coisas): eles, elas. Procure um substantivo plural ANTES.
cards.dica: O plural mais próximo costuma ser isca: teste todos os candidatos.
cards.ex: Companies are running lean and mean in this economy – they don’t have the time to train for those key skills.
cards.exSrc: BR Distribuidora 2011, Q15 (they = companies, gabarito C)
cards.nc: them (objeto); their (possessivo)

cards.f: them
cards.sig: plural na função de objeto: os, as, eles, elas (depois de verbo ou preposição).
cards.ex: ...its true mission should be to boost people’s vitality rather than protect them from death.
cards.nc: they (sujeito)

cards.f: their
cards.sig: possessivo plural: deles, delas, seu, sua. O dono é plural.
cards.ex: By joining these initiatives, businesses can accelerate their own transition to a regenerative model.
cards.nc: there (lá; there is = há)

cards.f: that shift
cards.sig: this ou that + substantivo resume a ideia da frase ANTERIOR (that shift = essa mudança que acabou de ser descrita).
cards.dica: Volte à frase de antes e ache a mudança: de onde para onde.
cards.ex: ...moving away from heavy industry fuelled largely by coal to a more service-based one, with a more varied fuel mix. But the pace of that shift is uncertain

cards.f: these
cards.sig: plural de this: estes, estas, esses. Retoma algo plural já citado.
cards.ex: These two disparate fields gradually evolved a number of points of contact, many of which have persisted for centuries.
cards.exSrc: Banese 2025 (these two fields = banking e art)
cards.nc: those (aqueles)

cards.f: those
cards.sig: plural de that: aqueles, aquelas, esses.
cards.ex: The question is how rapidly all those gains can be translated into electric supply.
cards.nc: these (estes)

cards.f: which
cards.sig: pronome relativo para coisa: que, o qual, a qual.
cards.ex: These include implemention of The Biofuture Platform, which aims to promote international coordination on advanced low carbon fuels.
cards.nc: who (pessoa)

cards.f: , which
cards.sig: which depois de vírgula retoma o sintagma inteiro à esquerda (às vezes a oração inteira), não só a última palavra.
cards.dica: Leia o bloco todo antes da vírgula: bank’s art collection programme, não bank’s art.
cards.ex: David Rockefeller launched the bank’s art collection programme, which would define the future vision of nearly every finance institution globally.
cards.exSrc: Banese 2025, Q12 (gabarito D, art collection programme)

cards.f: of which
cards.sig: dos quais, das quais: o which retoma um substantivo ANTES (91% de quê?).
cards.dica: A isca era o substantivo que vem depois (road vehicles).
cards.ex: ...the transport sector contributes around 14% of the UK’s greenhouse gas emissions, of which 91% is from road vehicles
cards.exSrc: Transpetro 2023, Q16 (which = greenhouse gas emissions, gabarito E)
cards.nc: many of which = muitos dos quais

cards.f: who
cards.sig: pronome relativo para pessoa: que, quem.
cards.ex: The employer absolutely must find people who have the hard skills to do whatever it is they are being hired to do.
cards.nc: which (coisa)

cards.f: this
cards.sig: sozinho, retoma a ideia anterior inteira: isto, isso.
cards.ex: If they can perfect this, they can lead the way in other markets with similar geology, such as Africa.
cards.nc: these (plural)

cards.f: those who
cards.sig: aqueles que, quem (pessoas).
cards.ex: Furthermore, those who had two or more of these statements, were seven times more likely to get the job

cards.f: whose
cards.sig: cujo, cuja: indica o dono (pessoa ou coisa) do substantivo que vem logo depois.
cards.dica: whose + substantivo: a empresa cujo lucro...
cards.nc: who’s = who is

cards.f: where
cards.sig: onde, em que, no qual: lugar, empresa ou situação já citados.
cards.ex: I left that company to join a new startup company where I hold the position of president.
cards.nc: were (eram, estavam)

cards.f: any such clash
cards.sig: such + substantivo = tal, desse tipo: retoma algo já descrito (aqui, o conflito aberto citado antes).
cards.ex: The threat to stability is all the greater given that Iran is likely to win any such clash
cards.nc: such as (como, por exemplo)

cards.f: the right ones
cards.sig: one, ones = substituem um substantivo contável já citado (aqui, ones = skills).
cards.ex: While skills are certainly desirable for many positions, does having the right ones guarantee you’ll get the job?
cards.nc: one (número um)

cards.f: greater than that of this palm tree’s wood
cards.sig: that of = o, a de: that retoma um substantivo singular anterior (aqui, the value).
cards.dica: No plural: those of = os, as de.
cards.ex: The value of these seeds is seven times greater than that of this palm tree’s wood.

cards.f: others
cards.sig: outros (pronome): retoma um grupo já citado. Some ... others = alguns ... outros.
cards.ex: Some projects are still in the planning stages, offering great promise for the future. However, others are already delivering practical results.
cards.nc: another (outro, mais um)

cards.f: In doing so
cards.sig: do so, doing so = fazer isso: retoma a ação dita antes.
cards.ex: In doing so, there is a growing body of evidence to suggest that regenerative businesses can achieve far better financial performance
cards.nc: so (por isso)

cards.f: his / her
cards.sig: his = dele; her = dela. Concordam com o DONO, não com a coisa possuída.
cards.dica: Em português seu e sua concordam com a coisa; em inglês, com o dono.
cards.ex: (B) Woman 2 complains against her very boring schedule at the office
cards.nc: its (de coisa); their (de vários)

cards.f: the former / the latter
cards.sig: the former = o primeiro (dos dois citados); the latter = o último, este. Volte e ache os dois itens na ordem.
cards.dica: former = anterior; latter lembra later (depois): o último.

cards.f: another
cards.sig: outro (mais um, um diferente). The other = o outro (o que resta de dois).
cards.ex: It would take another Middle East war to change the equation.

cards.f: themselves
cards.sig: eles mesmos, os próprios (ênfase) ou a si mesmos (reflexivo).
cards.ex: Satellite technology will increasingly be a part of the vehicles themselves, particularly when automated driving becomes more mainstream.

cards.f: so has consumption of oil and coal
cards.sig: so + auxiliar + sujeito = assim também: retoma o verbo anterior (o consumo também subiu).
cards.ex: ...as economic growth has picked up, so has consumption of oil and coal.

cards.f: lines · According to the fragment in lines 30-39, it is true that
cards.sig: linha(s) (substantivo). No enunciado, (lines 30-39) = linhas 30 a 39: mostra onde está a resposta. Cognato: parece com linha.
cards.dica: Provas até 2018 citam linhas; as de 2022 em diante (Eletronuclear, BASA, BNDES, Banese, Transpetro 2023) citam o parágrafo.
cards.ex: Saudi Arabia and Iran are mentioned in paragraphs 2 and 3 (lines 8-20) because they (Transpetro 2018, Q12)
cards.nc: paragraph (parágrafo); sentence (frase)

cards.f: energy · Global energy demand is 30% higher by 2040...
cards.sig: energia (substantivo). Energy mix = matriz energética; energy security = segurança energética. Cognato: parece com energia.
cards.dica: Energy está em 6 dos 11 textos medidos, inclusive Transpetro 2018 e 2023.
cards.ex: ...towards a more secure and sustainable energy future with Latin America's largest country. (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: power (energia elétrica, potência; também poder)

cards.f: oil · The kingdom's oil exports now mostly go to Asia...
cards.sig: petróleo (substantivo). Crude oil = petróleo bruto; oil and gas (O&G) = petróleo e gás. Fora desse contexto, óleo.
cards.dica: O&G é o setor da Transpetro: nos textos, oil é petróleo, não óleo de cozinha.
cards.ex: Exports of these commodities are already driving up the exchange rate before the new oil fields have fully come on stream... (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: gas (gás natural; no inglês americano, também gasolina)

cards.f: text · The main idea of the text is to
cards.sig: texto (substantivo). Text I e Text II = Texto I e Texto II, quando a prova traz dois textos. Cognato: parece com texto.
cards.dica: Com Text I e Text II, caiu comparação entre os textos nas três provas da Petrobras lidas (2011, 2012 e 2017).
cards.ex: Comparing Texts I and II, one concludes that (Petrobras 2017, Q20)
cards.nc: context (contexto); test (teste)

cards.f: paragraph · In the fragment in the fourth paragraph of the text
cards.sig: parágrafo (substantivo). O enunciado diz o parágrafo: vá direto a ele. Cognato: parece com parágrafo.
cards.dica: Ordinais dos enunciados: first 1º, second 2º, third 3º, fourth 4º, fifth 5º, sixth 6º, seventh 7º, eighth 8º.
cards.ex: In the fragment of paragraph 5 “and they produce power even at night or on calm days”, they refers to (Eletronuclear 2022, Q20)
cards.nc: line (linha); fragment (trecho)

cards.f: years · For the last three years the country has managed to deliver economic growth with only minimal increases in energy consumption.
cards.sig: anos (substantivo). For the last three years = nos últimos três anos; this year = este ano.
cards.dica: Year soa 'iér'. A 10-year plan = um plano de 10 anos (sem s quando vem antes do substantivo).
cards.ex: I held that position for three years. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: decade (década, 10 anos); century (século)

cards.f: gas · Some 60 percent of that came from burning fossil fuels, mostly natural gas, in some 10,000 generators, large and small, around the country.
cards.sig: gás (substantivo). Natural gas = gás natural; greenhouse gas = gás de efeito estufa. Cognato.
cards.dica: Oil and gas = petróleo e gás: o negócio da Transpetro.
cards.ex: The resurgence in oil and gas production from the United States... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: No inglês americano, gas também é gasolina (gasoline).

cards.f: industry · The renewables industry has had a great year.
cards.sig: setor, ramo (substantivo). The oil industry = o setor de petróleo. Também indústria. Cognato: parece com indústria.
cards.dica: Industry nem sempre é fábrica: é o ramo inteiro, como 'a indústria do petróleo'.
cards.ex: Although far fewer women work in the oil and gas (O&G) industry compared to men, many women find rewarding careers in the industry. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: industrial (industrial, adjetivo); sector (setor)

cards.f: world · ...the conservation area is rich in biodiversity often found nowhere else in the world.
cards.sig: mundo (substantivo). The world's largest = o maior do mundo; world-wide (worldwide) = no mundo todo.
cards.dica: World Cup = Copa do Mundo.
cards.ex: ...a model that is now successfully applied as best-practice world-wide. (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: word (palavra): só o L de diferença

cards.f: time / times · ...a new reactor in Flamanville is a decade late and more than three times over budget.
cards.sig: vezes (substantivo). Three times over budget = três vezes acima do orçamento. No singular, time = tempo ou vez: for the first time = pela primeira vez.
cards.dica: Número + times = multiplicação: seven times greater = sete vezes maior.
cards.ex: ...together with hydroelectric, they surpassed coal for the first time ever in 2019... (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: time (tempo) x times (vezes); Financial Times (nome de jornal)

cards.f: fragment · From the fragment in the second paragraph of the text “...”, it can be concluded that
cards.sig: trecho, fragmento (substantivo). No enunciado, o fragment vem entre aspas e diz onde ler. Cognato: parece com fragmento.
cards.dica: Leia a frase inteira do fragment, a anterior e a seguinte: o que decide pode estar fora do recorte.
cards.ex: In the fragments “some recent data suggests that as economic growth has picked up”... (Transpetro 2018, Q16)
cards.nc: section (trecho, seção: In the section of paragraph 3, BNDES 2024); sentence (frase)

cards.f: country · Take Japan, a country that is aging rapidly.
cards.sig: país (substantivo). Countries = países. Em outros contextos, the country = o campo, a zona rural.
cards.dica: Nos 11 textos medidos, country foi sempre país. Countryside = interior, zona rural.
cards.ex: But its land runs through with some of the highest rates of deforestation in the country. (BASA 2024)
cards.nc: county (condado); countryside (zona rural)

cards.f: change · ...the word pivotal can be replaced, with no change in meaning, by
cards.sig: mudança (substantivo); to change = mudar. With no change in meaning = sem mudar o sentido: a questão pede um sinônimo.
cards.dica: Change também é troco. Climate change = mudança climática.
cards.ex: It would take another Middle East war to change the equation. (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: exchange (troca, câmbio: exchange rate = taxa de câmbio)

cards.f: power · The controversial future of nuclear power in the U.S.
cards.sig: energia (substantivo). Nuclear power = energia nuclear; power plant = usina. Outros sentidos: poder (their individual power) e, como verbo, abastecer (power more cars = abastecer mais carros).
cards.dica: Em texto de energia, power é energia; em texto de história ou de política, poder.
cards.ex: ...mythologizing their individual power through art and architecture. (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: energy (energia em geral); strength (força física)

cards.f: work / works · With PrevisIA, the work is handed over to an AI algorithm that automates mapping...
cards.sig: trabalho (substantivo); to work = trabalhar. It works = funciona. Também obra: artists use their work = os artistas usam suas obras.
cards.dica: It works! = Funciona! Workforce = força de trabalho.
cards.ex: I worked with a lot of smart, focused and talented geoscientists and engineers. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: job (emprego, vaga) x work (trabalho em geral)

cards.f: according to · According to the last paragraph, the author believes that the
cards.sig: de acordo com, segundo (expressão). Abre questão de informação específica: a resposta está escrita no texto.
cards.dica: According soa como 'acordo': according to = de acordo com.
cards.ex: According to a 2019 survey by ReGenFriends, nearly 80% of US consumers prefer “regenerative” brands to “sustainable” brands. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: accordingly (de acordo; consequentemente)

cards.f: refers to · The pronoun they in “they don't have time to train for those key skills.” (lines 38-39) refers to
cards.sig: refere-se a, retoma (verbo refer + to). Questão de referência: ache o termo que o pronome substitui.
cards.dica: Nas provas lidas, o referente veio sempre antes do pronome: risque o que vem depois e teste os candidatos.
cards.ex: “This daunting challenge”, in paragraph 4, refers to the (Eletronuclear 2022, Q18)
cards.nc: reference (referência); referent (o termo retomado)

cards.f: company · ...over 50 percent of companies reported difficulty finding applicants with the right skills.
cards.sig: empresas (substantivo). Company = empresa, companhia. Cognato: parece com companhia.
cards.dica: Companhia aérea = airline company: company é empresa.
cards.ex: When the company sold its division in the state where I was working... (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: firm (firma, empresa); business (negócio, empresa)

cards.f: cost · Right now, the satellite supplier market is booming, driving down the cost of access to satellites.
cards.sig: custo (substantivo); to cost = custar. Driving down the cost = derrubando o custo. Cognato: parece com custo.
cards.dica: Drive down = fazer cair; drive up = fazer subir. Na Transpetro 2023 Q14, driving down the cost levou a the lower its price.
cards.ex: ...to unlock new resources in a cost-effective way. (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: price (preço, o que se paga); costume (fantasia, traje)

cards.f: means / meaning · The fragment in the third paragraph of the text “The Satellites for Digitalization of Railways (SODOR) project will provide low latency” means that
cards.sig: significa (verbo mean). Meaning = significado, sentido: without change in meaning = sem mudar o sentido.
cards.dica: What does it mean? = O que significa? Mean, means, meaning: tudo é sentido.
cards.ex: Based on the meanings in Text I, the two words are antonymous in (Petrobras 2011, Q14)
cards.nc: a means / by means of (substantivo) = meio, maneira

cards.f: use / using · The Amazon's indigenous peoples chop this palm tree down and use its wood to produce and sell items such as brooms.
cards.sig: usar (verbo); use = uso (substantivo): rational use of fossil fuels = uso racional dos combustíveis fósseis. Cognato: parece com usar.
cards.dica: User = usuário; useful = útil; useless = inútil.
cards.ex: ...energy efficiency, rational use of fossil fuels, energy security and sustainable development... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: used to + verbo = costumava (Researchers used to comb through...)

cards.f: need · All of that electricity will need to be replaced...
cards.sig: precisar (verbo); need = necessidade (substantivo): growing energy needs = necessidades crescentes de energia.
cards.dica: I need you = preciso de você. Will need to = vai precisar.
cards.ex: “We needed a new tool that could get ahead of the devastation.” (BASA 2024)
cards.nc: must (obrigação forte); should (conselho)

cards.f: future · Satellite data and communications will also play a fundamental role in shaping a sustainable future for road vehicles.
cards.sig: futuro (substantivo). In the near future = num futuro próximo. Cognato: parece com futuro.
cards.dica: Future também é tempo verbal: will, is set to, is expected to, is projected to marcam futuro.
cards.ex: (A) predict the imminent decrease of global oil demands in the near future. (Petrobras 2017, Q11)

cards.f: model · ...is it possible to generate short-term deforestation prediction models?
cards.sig: modelos (substantivo). Prediction models = modelos de previsão. Cognato: parece com modelo.
cards.dica: Business model = modelo de negócio; computer model = modelo (programa) de computador.
cards.ex: By joining these initiatives, businesses can accelerate their own transition to a regenerative model. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: mode (modo: growth mode = modo de crescimento)

cards.f: demand · ...because demand for electricity is expected to rise, especially if we power more cars with it.
cards.sig: demanda, procura (substantivo). Supply and demand = oferta e procura. Como verbo, exigir. Cognato: parece com demanda.
cards.dica: Demand é o lado de quem quer comprar: a procura.
cards.ex: To me, the prospect is of supply continuing to outpace demand. (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: supply (oferta, fornecimento): o par oposto

cards.f: technology / technical · Meiji Yasuda is investing in new partnerships and technologies to promote preventive healthcare in Japan.
cards.sig: tecnologias (substantivo). Technical = técnico; technological = tecnológico. Cognato.
cards.dica: Tech = tecnologia. Technical skills = habilidades técnicas.
cards.ex: ...for assistance with a technical problem. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: technique (técnica, método); technician (técnico, a pessoa)

cards.f: economy / economic · As such, people in the Amazon can generate seven times more economic value by preserving the murumuru tree than cutting it.
cards.sig: econômico (adjetivo: da economia). Economy = economia; economically = economicamente. Cognato.
cards.dica: Economic growth = crescimento econômico (do país).
cards.ex: The country's economy is changing and moving away from heavy industry fuelled largely by coal... (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: economical (econômico no sentido de barato, que poupa)

cards.f: idea · ...the word However can be associated with the idea of
cards.sig: ideia (substantivo). Idea of opposition = ideia de oposição; main idea = ideia principal. Cognato.
cards.dica: 'The idea of' + rótulo (time, condition, opposition, addition) = questão de conectivo.
cards.ex: The idea for PrevisIA emerged in 2016... (BASA 2024)
cards.nc: ideal (ideal)

cards.f: main · (B) headquarters (line 40) could be substituted by main office.
cards.sig: principal (adjetivo). Main office = escritório principal, a sede; main idea = ideia principal; main purpose = objetivo principal.
cards.dica: Main Street = rua principal. Na prova, deixe a questão de main idea para o fim.
cards.ex: The main purpose of Text I is to (Petrobras 2017, Q11)
cards.nc: major (importante, principal; não é maior): na Petrobras 2012 Q14, a alternativa que chamava major e main de opostos estava errada; o gabarito foi a B

cards.f: market · If they can perfect this, they can lead the way in other markets with similar geology, such as Africa.
cards.sig: mercados (substantivo). Job market = mercado de trabalho; power markets = mercados de energia. Cognato.
cards.dica: Supermarket = supermercado.
cards.ex: (E) list relevant hints for those interested in entering the job market and building a successful professional life. (Petrobras 2012, Q18)
cards.nc: marketing (divulgação, propaganda)

cards.f: based on · Based on the meanings in the text, the two items are synonymous in
cards.sig: com base em (expressão). Abre questão de vocabulário: compare o sentido de cada par no texto. Service-based = baseado em serviços.
cards.dica: Base = base: based on = com base em.
cards.ex: ...to a more service-based one, with a more varied fuel mix. (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: basis (base, fundamento: an excellent basis = uma base excelente); basic (básico)

cards.f: day · ...2017 has seen an increase of 600,000 barrels a day to over 6m.
cards.sig: dia (substantivo). Barrels a day = barris por dia (o a vale por). Daily = diário.
cards.dica: Today = hoje; Monday = segunda-feira (o dia da Lua).
cards.ex: Woman 4: A typical day is a hectic day for me. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: date (data no calendário)

cards.f: produce / product / production · In one step, Brazil could jump up the world rankings of national oil reserves and production, from 15th to fifth.
cards.sig: produção (substantivo). Produce = produzir; product = produto; producer = produtor. Cognatos.
cards.dica: Toda a família começa com prod-: produce, product, production, producer, productivity.
cards.ex: ...for a variety of hair care products... (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: produce (verbo, produzir) x product (substantivo, produto)

cards.f: many · While skills are certainly desirable for many positions, does having the right ones guarantee you'll get the job?
cards.sig: muitos (com substantivo contável). Many positions = muitos cargos; many of which = muitos dos quais.
cards.dica: Many com contáveis (many jobs); much com incontáveis (much money). How many? = Quantos?
cards.ex: In many ways, the energy business is at a moment of change and transition. (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: much (muito, incontável); a lot of (muito, serve para os dois)

cards.f: problem · The problem is that the industry remains fragmented.
cards.sig: problema (substantivo). Cognato: parece com problema.
cards.dica: No problem! = Sem problema! Nos textos, problem anda junto com issue e challenge.
cards.ex: ‘It's a multicriteria decision-making problem.’ (Transpetro 2011)
cards.nc: issue (questão, assunto); trouble (dificuldade)

cards.f: long · This daunting challenge has recently led some environmentalists to reconsider an alternative they had long been wary of: nuclear power.
cards.sig: havia muito tempo (advérbio): had long been wary of = desconfiavam havia muito tempo. Como adjetivo, long = longo.
cards.dica: Long-term = de longo prazo; take too long = demorar demais.
cards.ex: Critics also say nuclear reactors are simply too expensive and take too long to build to be of much help with the climate crisis. (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: as long as (desde que: condição); long-lasting (duradouro)

cards.f: word · ...the word in bold refers to
cards.sig: palavra (substantivo). The word in bold = a palavra em negrito.
cards.dica: Word lembra o editor de texto: o programa das palavras.
cards.ex: Based on the meanings of the words in the text, it can be said that (Transpetro 2018, Q18)
cards.nc: world (mundo): só o L de diferença

cards.f: data · Renewables, including hydro, accounted for just 5 per cent of global daily energy supply according to the IEA's latest data.
cards.sig: dados (substantivo). Latest data = dados mais recentes. Falso cognato: não é data do calendário (isso é date).
cards.dica: Database = banco de dados: data é a matéria-prima de TI.
cards.ex: Data analysts need to know how to crunch numbers in Excel. (BR Distribuidora 2011)
cards.nc: date (data, dia do calendário)

cards.f: grow / growth / growing · If it can, the result will limit global demand growth for oil, gas and coal.
cards.sig: crescimento (substantivo). Grow = crescer; growing = crescente. Direção: sobe.
cards.dica: Grow up = crescer, virar adulto. Growth é o substantivo de grow.
cards.ex: Global oil demand continues to grow to 2040, although at a steadily decreasing pace... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: decline (queda): o oposto; grown (crescido, particípio)

cards.f: way · Instead of trying to repair damage done by deforestation after the fact, they wanted to find a way to prevent it from happening at all.
cards.sig: jeito, maneira (substantivo). Find a way = achar um jeito. Também caminho: lead the way = abrir caminho; the other way around = o contrário.
cards.dica: My way = do meu jeito. Milky Way = Via Láctea (caminho).
cards.ex: ...rather than the other way around. (BR Distribuidora 2011)
cards.nc: away (longe, embora); always (sempre)

cards.f: large / largest · ...the fields contain the world's largest known offshore oil deposits.
cards.sig: o maior (superlativo de large). Large = grande. Falso cognato: large não é largo.
cards.dica: Large é o G das roupas (L de large): grande.
cards.ex: Tired of getting notifications after large swaths of forest had already been cleared... (BASA 2024)
cards.nc: wide (largo, amplo: wider = mais largo, BNDES 2024); larger (maior, comparativo)

cards.f: take / took · It took just the month of March this year to fell an area of forest in Triunfo do Xingu equivalent to 700 football pitches.
cards.sig: levou (passado de take): it took + tempo = levou tanto tempo. Take também é tomar, pegar, assumir: take the position = assumir o cargo.
cards.dica: It takes time = leva tempo. Take, took, taken.
cards.ex: ...the company asked me to take the position of managing their marine and offshore power products division. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: take hold (firmar-se, ganhar força: Petrobras 2011 Q16); take part (participar); take up space (ocupar espaço)

cards.f: natural · ...could help get supplies to areas which have experienced natural disasters...
cards.sig: natural (adjetivo). Natural disasters = desastres naturais; natural gas = gás natural; natural resources = recursos naturais. Cognato.
cards.dica: Igual ao português; muda a pronúncia: 'nétchural'.
cards.ex: But it's not just natural ecosystems that can benefit from prioritizing regeneration. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: naturally (naturalmente; claro)

cards.f: people / peoples · The employer absolutely must find people who have the hard skills to do whatever it is they are being hired to do.
cards.sig: pessoas (substantivo; plural de person). Peoples, com s, = povos: indigenous peoples = povos indígenas.
cards.dica: People já é plural: people are, nunca people is.
cards.ex: ...regenerative firms seek to boost the health and vitality of people, places and the planet simultaneously... (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: person (pessoa); public (público)

cards.f: last · The majority of American nuclear plants today are approaching the end of their design life, and only one has been built in the last 20 years.
cards.sig: últimos (adjetivo). In the last 20 years = nos últimos 20 anos; last year = no ano passado; at last = finalmente.
cards.dica: The last one = o último. Como verbo, last = durar: long-lasting = duradouro.
cards.ex: ...Brazilians are hoping that this time “the country of the future” will at last realise its full economic potential. (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: latest (mais recente: the latest data); least (o mínimo: not least = principalmente)

cards.f: term · “Existing deforestation prediction models were long-term, looking at what would happen in decades,” says Carlos Souza Jr...
cards.sig: prazo (substantivo). Long-term = de longo prazo; short-term = de curto prazo. Também termo, palavra: the term 'simultaneously' = o termo.
cards.dica: O 'term' de um contrato é o prazo dele.
cards.ex: ...the term “simultaneously” means (BNDES 2024, Q33)
cards.nc: terms (termos, condições: in terms of = em termos de)

cards.f: area · When already deforested areas are recent, this indicates gangs are operating in the area, so there's a higher risk that nearby forest will soon be wiped out.
cards.sig: áreas (substantivo). Environmental Protection Area = Área de Proteção Ambiental (APA). Cognato.
cards.dica: Area = área, pronunciado 'éria'.
cards.ex: ...the second largest area felled in the past 16 years. (BASA 2024)
cards.nc: region (região); field (campo, área de atuação)

cards.f: state / states · In the eighth paragraph of the text, the author states that, for the last 40 years, the company where he works has been
cards.sig: afirma (verbo state). Como substantivo, state = estado: the Gulf states = os países do Golfo; United States = Estados Unidos.
cards.dica: The author states = o autor afirma. Statement = afirmação.
cards.ex: Woman 4: I was working for a company in another state where oil and gas was not its primary business. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: status (posição, situação); state-of-the-art (de ponta)

cards.f: find / finds · WEO-2017 finds it is too early to write the obituary of oil.
cards.sig: constata, conclui (verbo find, num relatório). No dia a dia, find = encontrar, achar; find + algo + adjetivo = considerar: find the notion too passive = acham a ideia passiva demais.
cards.dica: The report finds that = o relatório conclui que. Findings = resultados de uma pesquisa.
cards.ex: Gen Y and Z consumers find the notion of “sustainability” too passive. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: look for (procurar) x find (encontrar: o resultado da procura)

cards.f: found · They want to buy from regenerative businesses that embody and practice the three noble qualities found in all living systems...
cards.sig: encontradas (particípio de find: find, found, found). Cuidado: to found (regular) = fundar; founders = fundadores.
cards.dica: Lost and found = achados e perdidos.
cards.ex: In the 18th and 19th centuries, banks would provide immeasurable support to the founders of the earliest art academies and national museums. (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: fund (fundo, verba); founded (fundado)

cards.f: place · Despite the gulf tragedy, the quest for oil and gas in the most difficult places on the planet is just getting underway.
cards.sig: lugares (substantivo). Como verbo, place = colocar: to place Brazil at the centre = colocar o Brasil no centro.
cards.dica: Take place = acontecer. Place lembra praça (um lugar).
cards.ex: ...we are taking another important step to place Brazil at the centre of global debate on key energy policy issues... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: space (espaço); plate (prato, placa)

cards.f: get / getting · Skillset vs. Mindset: Which Will Get You the Job?
cards.sig: garantir, fazer conseguir (verbo get): which will get you the job? = qual vai te garantir o emprego? Get também é levar (getting supplies to an area) e ficar (get worse = piorar).
cards.dica: Get é o verbo coringa: conseguir, receber, chegar, ficar. Decida pelo que vem depois dele.
cards.ex: Getting blood or other perishable supplies to an area that's been struck by an earthquake or hurricane... (Transpetro 2011)
cards.nc: get ahead of (antecipar-se a: BASA 2024); get involved (envolver-se)

cards.f: present · First, it focuses on trends present in the region, looking at geostatistics and historical data from Prodes...
cards.sig: presentes (adjetivo). Também atual: present OPEC production cuts = os cortes atuais da OPEP. Como verbo, apresentar: presented = apresentado.
cards.dica: Present = o agora: atual. Present tense = tempo presente.
cards.ex: (D) might compensate for present OPEC production cuts and cause a decrease in oil prices. (Transpetro 2018, Q14)
cards.nc: presently (atualmente); gift (presente de aniversário)

cards.f: help · Understanding what has happened can help make predictions more precise.
cards.sig: ajudar (verbo); help = ajuda (substantivo). Help + verbo sem to: help make = ajudar a fazer.
cards.dica: Help! = Socorro! Helpful = útil.
cards.ex: ...new digital tools that can help its clients anticipate and prevent cardiovascular problems. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: assistance (ajuda, assistência); support (apoio)

cards.f: sector · Right now, the transport sector contributes around 14% of the UK's greenhouse gas emissions...
cards.sig: setor (substantivo). Transport sector = setor de transportes. Cognato.
cards.dica: Sector = setor (com c, como na origem latina).
cards.ex: ...where the manufacturing sector withered after its currency strengthened... (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: section (seção, trecho); industry (setor, ramo)

cards.f: purpose · The main purpose of the text is to
cards.sig: objetivo, propósito (substantivo). Main purpose = objetivo principal: as alternativas começam com verbo (describe, explain, criticize). Cognato.
cards.dica: Purpose = 'para quê?'. Também é rótulo de conectivo: in order to, so that = purpose (finalidade).
cards.ex: ...connecting each point to the internet for operational management purposes... (Transpetro 2023)
cards.nc: intention (intenção: the communicative intention of the text é a mesma pergunta)

cards.f: say / says / said · Without a “firm local content policy”, says Petrobras CEO, Dutch disease and the oil curse will take hold.
cards.sig: diz (verbo say). Said = disse. Em citação, a ordem inverte: says Petrobras CEO = diz o presidente da Petrobras.
cards.dica: Say, said, said. Analysts say = analistas dizem.
cards.ex: ‘You don't know where demand is, so it's tricky,’ said Nagurney. (Transpetro 2011)
cards.nc: tell (contar, dizer a alguém); speak (falar)

cards.f: become · By the mid-2020s, the United States is projected to become the world's largest LNG exporter...
cards.sig: tornar-se (verbo). Become, became, become. Is projected to become = deve se tornar (previsão).
cards.dica: Become = 'vir a ser'. Não confunda com welcome (bem-vindo).
cards.ex: ...particularly when automated driving becomes more mainstream. (Transpetro 2023)
cards.nc: come (vir); welcome (bem-vindo)

cards.f: provide · Already, satellites provide regular software updates to vehicles and enhanced safety through an in-car emergency call service.
cards.sig: fornecer, oferecer (verbo). Provider = fornecedor. Cognato: parece com prover.
cards.dica: Provedor de internet = internet provider.
cards.ex: (C) provide precise answers to the most relevant questions on global energy. (Transpetro 2018, Q11)
cards.nc: provided that (desde que: condição); prove (provar)

cards.f: express / expression · ...the expression in bold refers to
cards.sig: expressão (substantivo). Express = expressar: express similar ideas = expressam ideias parecidas. Cognatos.
cards.dica: Express similar ideas = sinônimos; express opposite ideas = antônimos.
cards.ex: Based on the meanings in Text I, the two items that express synonymous ideas are (Petrobras 2017, Q14)
cards.nc: impression (impressão)

cards.f: decade · Because no new plants were built in the U.S. for decades, he and his colleagues found...
cards.sig: décadas (substantivo). For decades = durante décadas; in the past decade = na última década. Cognato.
cards.dica: Deca = 10: decade = 10 anos.
cards.ex: The US becomes the undisputed leader for oil and gas production for decades... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: decay (deterioração: product decay); century (século)

cards.f: recent / recently · Industrial production has faltered in recent months, with manufacturers blaming the trend on a flood of cheap Chinese-made imports.
cards.sig: recentes (adjetivo). In recent months = nos últimos meses; recently = recentemente. Cognato.
cards.dica: O -ly vira -mente: recently = recentemente.
cards.ex: Dr Birol also congratulated Brazil for its recent successful deepwater bid round. (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: latest (mais recente); resent (ressentir-se)

cards.f: increase · A comparable increase in 2018 would offset most of the current OPEC production cuts and either force another quota reduction or push prices down.
cards.sig: aumento (substantivo); to increase = aumentar. Direção: sobe. Increasingly = cada vez mais.
cards.dica: Increase sobe, decrease desce. Na mesma frase, offset = compensar (Transpetro 2018 Q14: might compensate for).
cards.ex: ...the relationship between artists and bankers has grown increasingly transactional since the Medici era. (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: decrease (diminuição): o oposto

cards.f: support · To curb any negative effects, Brazil is trying to support domestic manufacturing by increasing “local content” requirements in the oil industry.
cards.sig: apoiar (verbo); support = apoio. Falso cognato: não é suportar no sentido de aguentar (isso é stand ou bear).
cards.dica: Suporte técnico = apoio técnico: support é apoio, sustentação.
cards.ex: “Electric vehicles (EVs) are in the fast lane as a result of government support and declining battery costs... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: stand / bear (aguentar, tolerar); supply (fornecimento)

cards.f: quality / qualities · Write a compelling cover letter that speaks to your best qualities...
cards.sig: qualidades (substantivo). Your best qualities = suas melhores qualidades. Cognato.
cards.dica: Quality control = controle de qualidade.
cards.ex: ...a strong emphasis on cleaner energy technologies, in large part to address poor air quality... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: quantity (quantidade); qualifications (qualificações, formação)

cards.f: replaced · ...Still can be replaced, without changing the meaning of the sentence, by
cards.sig: substituído (particípio de replace). Can be replaced by = pode ser substituído por: questão de sinônimo ou de conectivo.
cards.dica: Re + place = pôr outro no lugar. Replacement = substituição.
cards.ex: ...the fragment “can be applied” is replaced, without change in meaning, by (Transpetro 2011, Q19)
cards.nc: substituted (substituído: can be substituted by é a mesma pergunta); displace (tirar do lugar: displace coal, Transpetro 2018)

cards.f: price · ...which makes the price of their energy high.
cards.sig: preço (substantivo). Oil prices = preços do petróleo; push prices down = derrubar os preços.
cards.dica: Price soa 'praice'. Na questão numérica, confira se o valor é de compra ou de venda (Banese 2025 Q13).
cards.ex: What will be the energy mix, trade patterns and price trends? (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: prize (prêmio); cost (custo)

cards.f: as well as · ...with phone calls and emails with our facility in Norway, as well as other business relationships abroad.
cards.sig: assim como, além de (conectivo de adição). Foi a resposta da Petrobras 2012 Q15 (idea of addition). Well sozinho = bem: well-known = bem conhecido; well before = bem antes.
cards.dica: As well as = 'e também'. Rótulo: addition.
cards.ex: The most well-known example of this trend was the Medici family... (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: as well (também, no fim da frase); oil well (poço de petróleo)

cards.f: already · About 5 sq km had already been destroyed in March.
cards.sig: já (advérbio). Had already been destroyed = já tinham sido destruídos.
cards.dica: All + ready = tudo pronto: já.
cards.ex: 30% of its population is already over 65. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: yet (ainda; já, em perguntas); all ready (todos prontos)

cards.f: system · ...her system aims for the cleanest path at minimum cost...
cards.sig: sistema (substantivo). Monitoring system = sistema de monitoramento. Cognato.
cards.dica: Information system = sistema de informação.
cards.ex: ...are changing the face of the global energy system... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: systematic (sistemático)

cards.f: item / items · Based on the meanings in the text, the two items are antonymous in
cards.sig: termos, itens (substantivo). The two items = os dois termos (pares de palavras). Também objetos: items such as brooms = itens como vassouras. Cognato.
cards.dica: Antonymous = antônimos (opostos); synonymous = sinônimos (mesmo sentido).
cards.ex: “such critical perturbations,” (lines 34-35) refers to all the items below, EXCEPT (Transpetro 2011, Q15)
cards.nc: issue (questão, assunto)

cards.f: trend · The question is whether the trend can be continued.
cards.sig: tendência (substantivo). Price trends = tendências de preço. Não é trem (train).
cards.dica: Trending topics = assuntos em alta: tendência.
cards.ex: ...we may conclude that the historical trend is bound to spring back. (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: train (trem); tend to (tender a)

cards.f: national · ...or during epidemics or breaches of national security.
cards.sig: nacional (adjetivo). National security = segurança nacional. Nation = nação. Cognato.
cards.dica: Nation = nação; national = nacional; international = internacional.
cards.ex: Pumped by the national oil company from “pre-salt” deposits... (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: native (nativo)

cards.f: end · ...with 271.52 sq km of forest in the conservation area expected to be lost by the end of the year.
cards.sig: fim (substantivo). By the end of the year = até o fim do ano; in the end = no fim. Como verbo, end = terminar.
cards.dica: The End = Fim, no final dos filmes.
cards.ex: ...and you will be rewarded in the end. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: and (e); ending (desfecho)

cards.f: look · It looks and smells like ordinary crude oil.
cards.sig: parece (verbo look + like = parecer). Look at = olhar, analisar; look for = procurar.
cards.dica: Com like, look vira parecer: It looks like... = Parece...
cards.ex: ...work with the field's earth model or look at seismic. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: look for (procurar) x look after (cuidar de)

cards.f: great · The industry has had a great year, with bids from offshore wind for capacity auctions in the UK and elsewhere at record low levels.
cards.sig: ótimo, excelente (adjetivo). Também grande: at great depth = a grande profundidade; so great are the discoveries = as descobertas são tão grandes.
cards.dica: Great! = Ótimo! Alexander the Great = Alexandre, o Grande.
