cards.ex: So great are the discoveries, and the investment required to exploit them, that they have the potential to transform the country... (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: greater (maior); grateful (grato)

cards.f: as a result · As a result, our latest data shows that Brazil will become a net oil exporter...
cards.sig: como resultado, por isso (conectivo de consequência). Result = resultado; result in = resultar em; result from = resultar de.
cards.dica: Rótulos da banca: result, conclusion, consequence. Mesma família: therefore, thus, so, consequently.
cards.ex: ...getting a job in the O&G industry can result from all the following situations, EXCEPT (Petrobras 2012, Q12)
cards.nc: results from (vem de: causa) x results in (leva a: consequência)

cards.f: show / shows · “Brazil's experience shows that policies do matter,” said Dr Fatih Birol, the IEA's Executive Director.
cards.sig: mostra (verbo show). Policies do matter = as políticas importam, sim (o do dá ênfase).
cards.dica: Show = o que se mostra no palco.
cards.ex: The coming year will show us whether it is ready for that challenge. (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: showcase (exibir); shown (mostrado)

cards.f: climate · But debates rage over whether nuclear should be a big part of the climate solution in the U.S.
cards.sig: clima (substantivo). Climate change = mudança climática; climate crisis = crise climática. Organisational climate = clima organizacional.
cards.dica: Climate = clima de longo prazo; weather = o tempo de hoje (chuva ou sol).
cards.ex: Given the climate urgency, it is time that businesses think and act beyond sustainability. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: weather (tempo do dia); climax (clímax)

cards.f: emissions · If energy efficiency gains continue, CO2 emissions will remain flat or even fall.
cards.sig: emissões (substantivo). Carbon emissions = emissões de carbono. Emit = emitir. Cognato.
cards.dica: Na mesma frase, remain flat = ficar estável: flat caiu na Transpetro 2018 Q18.
cards.ex: To cut U.S. carbon emissions in half by 2030... (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: missions (missões)

cards.f: important · The fourth question is, if anything, the most important.
cards.sig: importante (adjetivo). The most important = o mais importante. Cognato.
cards.dica: Importance = importância; it doesn't matter = não importa.
cards.ex: ...it's important to communicate your abilities effectively... (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: import (importar; imports = importações)

cards.f: today · It became one of the first few commercial art collections, as we know them today.
cards.sig: hoje (advérbio). Today's employers = os empregadores de hoje.
cards.dica: To + day = 'neste dia'.
cards.ex: Today, art is still a hallmark of socioeconomic status... (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: nowadays (hoje em dia); tonight (hoje à noite)

cards.f: factor · Every country is different and local factors, including politics, are important.
cards.sig: fatores (substantivo). Local factors = fatores locais. Cognato.
cards.dica: Factor = o que influencia o resultado.
cards.ex: The only factor that made the difference was that those who had one of the 72 mindset qualities... (BR Distribuidora 2011)
cards.nc: fact (fato); actor (ator)

cards.f: environment / environmental · While environmental opposition may have been the primary force hindering nuclear development in the 1980s and 90s, now the biggest challenge may be costs.
cards.sig: ambiental (adjetivo). Environment = meio ambiente; environmentalists = ambientalistas.
cards.dica: Environment = o que está em volta (environ = ao redor).
cards.ex: ...along three complementary dimensions: economic, socio-cultural and environmental. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: environmentalist (ambientalista, pessoa)

cards.f: next · Over the next 25 years, the world's growing energy needs are met first by renewables and natural gas...
cards.sig: próximos (adjetivo). Over the next 25 years = nos próximos 25 anos. Como advérbio, em seguida: will happen next = vai acontecer em seguida.
cards.dica: Next! = Próximo! (na fila).
cards.ex: ...and an easy way to start up a conversation the next time you see them. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: last (último) x next (próximo); near (perto)

cards.f: high / higher · ...other countries continue to push overall global demand higher...
cards.sig: mais alto (comparativo de high): push demand higher = empurrar a demanda para cima. High = alto: all-time high = recorde histórico. Direção: sobe.
cards.dica: High + er = mais alto. A banca põe higher e lower lado a lado nas inferências (Transpetro 2023 Q14).
cards.ex: Destruction across the Brazilian Amazon is creeping close to an all-time high. (BASA 2024)
cards.nc: highly (muito, altamente); lower (mais baixo): o par oposto

cards.f: far · Still, this is far from enough to avoid severe impacts of climate change.
cards.sig: longe (advérbio). Far from enough = longe de ser suficiente. Antes de comparativo, muito: far better = muito melhor. So far = até agora.
cards.dica: Far + comparativo = 'de longe': far less space = muito menos espaço.
cards.ex: ...regenerative businesses can achieve far better financial performance and impact than their sustainability-focused peers. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: so far (até agora); fair (justo: to be fair = para ser justo)

cards.f: reason · Much lower labor costs are one reason, according to both Finan and the MIT report, but better project management is another.
cards.sig: motivo, razão (substantivo). One reason = um dos motivos. Cognato: parece com razão.
cards.dica: Reason = o porquê. Reasonable = razoável.
cards.ex: The reason is simple: after a century and a half of breakneck oil prospecting, the easy stuff is history. (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: season (estação); reasoning (raciocínio)

cards.f: part · Satellite technology is a critical part of revolutionizing connectivity on trains.
cards.sig: parte (substantivo). A critical part = uma parte essencial. Take part in = participar de; in large part = em grande parte; for its part = por sua vez.
cards.dica: Partner = parceiro; partnership = parceria.
cards.ex: For its part, Petrobras is spending $800m-$900m a year over the next five years on R&D... (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: party (festa, partido); apart (separado)

cards.f: fast · Space technology is developing fast, and, with every advance, it is becoming more accessible to industry.
cards.sig: rápido, depressa (adjetivo e advérbio, mesma forma). Developing fast = se desenvolvendo rápido; as fast as = tão rápido quanto.
cards.dica: Fast food = comida rápida.
cards.ex: How fast can it grow now? (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: fast não é fácil (easy); faster (mais rápido)

cards.f: point · These two disparate fields gradually evolved a number of points of contact, many of which have persisted for centuries.
cards.sig: pontos (substantivo). Points of contact = pontos de contato; charging points = pontos de recarga. Como verbo, point out = apontar. Cognato.
cards.dica: Turning point = ponto de virada.
cards.ex: The turning point in this journey for art and banking came in the 1940s... (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: point of view (ponto de vista); pointless (inútil)

cards.f: develop / development · Souza and his team began developing a new model capable of generating annual predictions.
cards.sig: desenvolvendo (verbo develop). Development = desenvolvimento; developing nations = países em desenvolvimento. Cognato: parece com desenvolver.
cards.dica: Developer = desenvolvedor. Na Transpetro 2018 Q18, thriving e developing foram dados como sinônimos (gabarito D).
cards.ex: The other long-term dividend Brazil is seeking from the discoveries is in research and development (R&D). (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: deploy (implantar: renewables are being deployed rapidly)

cards.f: author · Concerning the renewable energy industry, the author affirms that it
cards.sig: autor (substantivo). The author affirms / states / believes = o autor afirma / declara / acredita. Cognato.
cards.dica: A questão quer a opinião de quem escreveu, não a sua nem o que você sabe do mundo.
cards.ex: According to the text author, in paragraph 4, one can conclude that the art work Abstraktes Bild (Faust) was sold in 2020 for (Banese 2025, Q13)
cards.nc: authority (autoridade: authorities = autoridades)

cards.f: region · Imazon is now establishing partnerships with authorities across the region...
cards.sig: região (substantivo). Across the region = em toda a região; regional = regional. Cognato.
cards.dica: Region = região (o -ion vira -ião).
cards.ex: ...to reassert its influence in the region. (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: religion (religião)

cards.f: second · The country is the world's second biggest exporter of iron ore.
cards.sig: segundo (ordinal). Second biggest = o segundo maior. Também segundo de relógio (seconds).
cards.dica: First, second, third = 1º, 2º, 3º.
cards.ex: The second question is how rapidly production of oil from shale rock will grow in the US... (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: secondary (secundário)

cards.f: make / making · ...making it harder for Brazilian exporters of manufactured goods.
cards.sig: tornando (verbo make + adjetivo = tornar): making it harder = tornando mais difícil. Aqui o it não retoma nada (Petrobras 2011 Q15). Make também é fazer: make sense = fazer sentido.
cards.dica: Make + algo + adjetivo = tornar: make predictions more precise = tornar as previsões mais precisas.
cards.ex: ...practical benefits for our customers that make sense on both a business and a sustainability level. (Transpetro 2023)
cards.nc: do (fazer tarefa) x make (fazer, fabricar, tornar)

cards.f: water · They are doing it not only because it drastically reduces water use and emissions...
cards.sig: água (substantivo). Deep-water = águas profundas; bodies of water = corpos d'água.
cards.dica: Water termina em -er, mas não é comparativo: na BNDES 2024 Q32, water e together foram iscas; o certo era stronger.
cards.ex: ...and areas with bodies of water, or other terrain that doesn't lend itself to agricultural expansion... (BASA 2024)
cards.nc: waiter (garçom)

cards.f: action · But without a robust computational platform and the ability to update road maps more quickly, PrevisIA couldn't be put into action.
cards.sig: ação (substantivo). Put into action = pôr em prática. Cognato.
cards.dica: Action movie = filme de ação.
cards.ex: None of the classic, accepted advice, like using action verbs or including hobbies/interests actually made any difference. (BR Distribuidora 2011)
cards.nc: activity (atividade); act (agir; lei)

cards.f: plan · In April 2020, the firm launched a 10-year plan to evolve the life insurance firm into a life regeneration company.
cards.sig: plano (substantivo); to plan = planejar. A 10-year plan = um plano de 10 anos. Cognato.
cards.dica: Planning stages = fase de planejamento.
cards.ex: Brazil and the IEA plan to work jointly across a wide range of energy-related activities. (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: plant (usina, planta); plane (avião)

cards.f: explain · ...“largely in places where they build projects on budget, and on schedule,” Finan explains.
cards.sig: explica (verbo explain). Explanation = explicação. Cognato.
cards.dica: Explain the reasons = explicar os motivos: começo comum de alternativa de ideia principal.
cards.ex: ...businesses should explain how their triple regeneration strategy... could yield great economic and social value for all stakeholders. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: explore (explorar); exploit (explorar recursos)

cards.f: reduce · Launching this year, SODOR will help operators reduce emissions by using the network more efficiently...
cards.sig: reduzir (verbo). Reduction = redução: cost reductions = reduções de custo. Direção: desce. Cognato.
cards.dica: Reduce, reuse, recycle: os 3 Rs.
cards.ex: They found that “without cost reductions, nuclear energy will not play a significant role” in decarbonizing the power sector. (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: curb (conter), cut (cortar), lower (baixar): todos na família 'desce'

cards.f: report · While carbon emissions have flattened in recent years, the report finds that global energy-related CO2 emissions increase slightly by 2040...
cards.sig: relatório (substantivo). Como verbo, report = relatar, informar; report on = noticiar, fazer reportagem sobre.
cards.dica: Reporter = repórter: quem faz o report.
cards.ex: (D) report on a computational model to speed up the shipment of perishable products through clogged roads in summer. (Transpetro 2011, Q11)
cards.nc: record (registro, recorde); support (apoio)

cards.f: associated / association · ...the word in bold can be associated with the idea of
cards.sig: associada (particípio de associate). Can be associated with the idea of = pode ser associada à ideia de: questão de conectivo. Association = associação. Cognato.
cards.dica: Viu 'associated with the idea of'? Dê o rótulo do conectivo (opposition, addition, cause) antes de ler as alternativas.
cards.ex: Brazil joins IEA as an Association country, reshaping international energy governance (Petrobras 2017)

cards.f: activity / activities · And despite Triunfo do Xingu being protected under Brazilian law, illegal activities...
cards.sig: atividades (substantivo). Illegal activities = atividades ilegais. Cognato.
cards.dica: Activity = atividade; active = ativo.
cards.ex: ...and drilling activity is rising. (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: action (ação)

cards.f: given that · The threat to stability is all the greater given that Iran is likely to win any such clash...
cards.sig: já que, dado que (conectivo de causa). Caiu na Transpetro 2018 Q13, e a resposta foi taking into account that. Given + substantivo = diante de: given the climate urgency.
cards.dica: Given = dado: given that = dado que. Rótulo: cause.
cards.ex: On any given day I am working on budgets and finance, attending project meetings... (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: even though (embora: oposição) x given that (já que: causa)

cards.f: across · ...when the art world's centre of gravity suddenly shifted straight across the Atlantic, from Paris to Manhattan.
cards.sig: para o outro lado de (preposição): shifted across the Atlantic = mudou para o outro lado do Atlântico. Across the region = por toda a região.
cards.dica: Across lembra cruz (cross): atravessar de um lado ao outro.
cards.ex: ...vitalizing local communities across Japan where the firm operates. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: through (através de, por dentro); cross (cruzar)

cards.f: shift · But the pace of that shift is uncertain...
cards.sig: mudança, transição (substantivo). Como verbo, shift = mudar, deslocar: shift their focus = mudar o foco.
cards.dica: A tecla Shift muda a letra. Na Transpetro 2018 Q15, that shift retomava a mudança descrita na frase anterior.
cards.ex: ...they can shift their focus to their candidates' mindsets... (BR Distribuidora 2011)
cards.nc: change (mudança em geral); switch (trocar, alternar)

cards.f: difficult · Where the common journey of banking and art may lead in later decades or centuries is difficult to predict...
cards.sig: difícil (adjetivo). Difficult to predict = difícil de prever. Difficulty = dificuldade. Cognato.
cards.dica: O oposto é easy (fácil).
cards.ex: (A) future of the energy business is uncertain and difficult to anticipate. (Transpetro 2018, Q20)
cards.nc: different (diferente): começam igual

cards.f: condition · “These roads create the conditions for new deforestation.”
cards.sig: condições (substantivo). Também rótulo de conectivo: condition = condição (if, unless, provided that). Cognato.
cards.dica: Rótulos da banca nas questões de conectivo: time, condition, emphasis, opposition, accumulation.
cards.ex: (D) lowest cost to place goods safely and in adequate conditions. (Transpetro 2011, Q12)
cards.nc: conclusion (conclusão: so, therefore) x condition (condição: if)

cards.f: ability · Ultimately, Brazil's ability to avoid Dutch disease will depend not just on how the money from the oil is spent.
cards.sig: capacidade (substantivo). Ability to avoid = capacidade de evitar. Também rótulo do modal can (ability). Cognato: parece com habilidade.
cards.dica: Able = capaz; ability = capacidade; can = ser capaz de.
cards.ex: “In the West, the nuclear industry has substantially lost its ability to build large plants,” Buongiorno says... (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: skill (habilidade aprendida); possibility (possibilidade: may, might)

cards.f: event · ...is expected to rise is used to... (C) anticipate a probable event.
cards.sig: fato, acontecimento (substantivo). Anticipate a probable event = prever um fato provável: foi a resposta da Eletronuclear 2022 Q17 para is expected to (futuro). Cognato: parece com evento.
cards.dica: Is expected to, is set to, is projected to = previsão (futuro provável).
cards.ex: Join a professional association and attend their events... (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: eventually (por fim: falso cognato; na BASA 2024 Q10, a resposta foi finally)

cards.f: concern / concerns · ...and the perennial concerns about safety and long-lived radioactive waste may not be the biggest...
cards.sig: preocupações (substantivo). Concerns about safety = preocupações com a segurança. Como verbo, concern = dizer respeito a: The third question concerns China.
cards.dica: Concerned = preocupado. Concern lembra concernir: dizer respeito a.
cards.ex: The third question concerns China. (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: concerning (a respeito de, no enunciado); concert (show)

cards.f: issue · What are the issues that will shape the global energy market in 2018?
cards.sig: questões, assuntos (substantivo). On this issue = sobre esse assunto. Também problema. Não é cognato.
cards.dica: Issue = o assunto em pauta.
cards.ex: ...recently sat down with U.S. News to sound off on this issue. (BR Distribuidora 2011)
cards.nc: question (pergunta); subject (assunto, tema)

cards.f: strategy · Art collecting is often included under the umbrella of a marketing strategy...
cards.sig: estratégia (substantivo). Marketing strategy = estratégia de marketing. Cognato.
cards.dica: Strategic = estratégico.
cards.ex: This strategy calls for prolonging the healthy life expectancy of its clients... (BNDES 2024)

cards.f: solution · Woman 5: I chose the oil and gas industry because of the challenging projects, and I want to be part of our country's energy solution.
cards.sig: solução (substantivo). Energy solution = solução energética. Solve = resolver. Cognato.
cards.dica: Problem-solving = resolução de problemas.
cards.ex: (C) finding efficacious transportation solutions depends exclusively on political decisions. (Transpetro 2011, Q13)
cards.nc: solve (resolver) x dissolve (dissolver)

cards.f: third · ...with India accounting for almost one-third of global growth to 2040.
cards.sig: terço: one-third = um terço (33%). Third sozinho = terceiro (3º): the third question = a terceira questão.
cards.dica: Fração = número + ordinal: one-third (1/3), one-fifth (1/5); 1/4 é a quarter.
cards.ex: In Text I, according to the answers to the third question in the interview, (Petrobras 2012, Q13)
cards.nc: three (três); thirty (trinta)

cards.f: opposition · ...the words in bold are associated with the idea of... (E) opposition
cards.sig: oposição, contraste (substantivo). Rótulo da banca para but, however, although, even though, nevertheless, despite. Cognato.
cards.dica: Se a segunda parte contraria a primeira, o rótulo é opposition. Na Banese 2025 Q14, even though = opposition.
cards.ex: (E) explain that regenerative brands act in diametrical opposition to sustainable ones... (BNDES 2024, Q31)
cards.nc: addition (adição: and, also, moreover) x opposition (oposição: but, however)

cards.f: quarter · It is worth remembering that the Gulf states account for a quarter of global production and over 40 per cent of all the oil traded globally.
cards.sig: um quarto, 25% (substantivo): a quarter of global production = um quarto da produção mundial. Também trimestre: the first quarter of 2023 = o primeiro trimestre.
cards.dica: Cuidado na questão numérica: over 40 per cent era do petróleo comercializado pelo Golfo, não do produzido (Transpetro 2018 Q17).
cards.ex: ...and the first quarter of 2023 saw 867 sq km of rainforest destroyed... (BASA 2024)
cards.nc: fourth (quarto, 4º); headquarters (sede)

cards.f: past · The increase in global prices over the past six months has made output from almost all America's producing areas commercially viable...
cards.sig: últimos, passados (adjetivo): over the past six months = nos últimos seis meses. Como substantivo, the past = o passado.
cards.dica: Over the past + período = nos últimos.
cards.ex: This is the result of a 50% increase in oil production in the past decade... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: last (último); pass (passar)

cards.f: lead / leads · That leads to construction delays that drive up costs.
cards.sig: leva a, causa (lead + to). Lead também é liderar: leader = líder; leading source = principal fonte.
cards.dica: Lead, led, led. Leader é quem conduz o grupo.
cards.ex: Jacopo Buongiorno, a professor of nuclear science and engineering at MIT, led a group of scientists... (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: led (passado: liderou); load (carga)

cards.f: addition · The sentence, in Text I, in which the boldfaced expression introduces an idea of addition is
cards.sig: adição, soma (substantivo). Idea of addition = ideia de soma: and, also, moreover, furthermore, in addition, as well as. Cognato.
cards.dica: Addition = sinal de mais (+). Na Petrobras 2012 Q15, a resposta foi as well as.
cards.ex: ...the words “deeper” and “wider” are formed by the addition of a suffix. (BNDES 2024, Q32)
cards.nc: edition (edição); accumulation (acúmulo: outro nome que a banca dá para a soma)

cards.f: article · Jennifer Fremont-Smith and Paul G. Stoltz are both interviewed in this article because they
cards.sig: artigo, matéria (substantivo). This article = esta matéria. Cognato.
cards.dica: O texto da prova costuma ser artigo de jornal, revista ou blog.
cards.ex: The communicative intention of the article is to (Transpetro 2011, Q11)
cards.nc: particle (partícula)

cards.f: EXCEPT · According to Jennifer Fremont-Smith and Paul G. Stoltz, mindset includes all of the following EXCEPT
cards.sig: exceto, menos (preposição). Quatro alternativas estão no texto; marque a única que não está.
cards.dica: EXCEPT em maiúsculas = pergunta invertida. Escreva NÃO ao lado da questão para não esquecer.
cards.ex: All the boldfaced verb phrases express a future action, EXCEPT in (Petrobras 2017, Q16)
cards.nc: expect (esperar); accept (aceitar)

cards.f: job · Despite record high unemployment, many jobs sit empty because employers can't find candidates with the right skills.
cards.sig: empregos, vagas (substantivo). Jobs sit empty = vagas ficam abertas; get the job = conseguir o emprego.
cards.dica: Job fair = feira de empregos; job seekers = quem procura emprego.
cards.ex: Woman 3: They offered me a job! (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: work (trabalho em geral, incontável) x job (um emprego, contável)

cards.f: global · (B) speculate on matters that may affect the global energy market in 2018.
cards.sig: mundial, global (adjetivo). Global energy market = mercado mundial de energia. Cognato.
cards.dica: Esta foi a resposta certa da Transpetro 2018 Q11 (ideia principal): o texto especulava (speculate) sobre o mercado global.
cards.ex: Solar is forging ahead in global power markets... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: globally (no mundo todo, advérbio); local (local): o oposto

cards.f: a means of / by means of · ...wealthy financiers would acquire or commission masterpieces as a means of penitence for their sins...
cards.sig: meio, maneira (substantivo; igual no singular e no plural). As a means of = como meio de; by means of = por meio de.
cards.dica: Com a ou the antes (a means, the means), é substantivo: meio. Logo depois do sujeito, é verbo: significa.
cards.ex: ...the term “for instance” establishes cohesion by means of indicating a/an (BNDES 2024, Q35)
cards.nc: means (verbo) = significa: The fragment means that...

cards.f: used to · Researchers used to comb through thousands of satellite images to see whether they could spot new roads slicing through the biome.
cards.sig: costumavam (used to + verbo = hábito do passado que acabou). Com o PrevisIA, ninguém mais vasculha as imagens à mão.
cards.dica: Used to + verbo = costumava. No exemplo, would often be used as = costumava ser usada como: would também marca hábito no passado.
cards.ex: In the 17th century, art became a consumer commodity, and would often be used as currency... (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: is used to + verbo = é usado para (Eletronuclear 2022 Q17: is expected to rise is used to...); be used to + -ing = estar acostumado a

cards.f: renewables · How fast can renewables grow?
cards.sig: energias renováveis (substantivo plural). Renewable = renovável (adjetivo): renewable energy. Cognato.
cards.dica: Re + new + able = capaz de ficar novo de novo: renovável.
cards.ex: Brazil has also pioneered the use of auctions for long-term contracts for renewable energy... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: fossil fuels (combustíveis fósseis): o oposto

cards.f: state-of-the-art · ...we continue to be involved with the state-of-the-art technologies and use cases.
cards.sig: de ponta, de última geração (expressão adjetiva). Caiu na Transpetro 2023 Q20: a resposta foi cutting-edge. Art sozinho = arte.
cards.dica: State-of-the-art = 'o estado da arte': o mais avançado que existe hoje.
cards.ex: Art and Banking: from the House of Medici to Deutsche Bank (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: cutting-edge (de ponta: o sinônimo da banca); artwork (obra de arte)

cards.f: taking into account · ...given that can be replaced, without change in meaning, by... (E) taking into account that
cards.sig: levando em conta (expressão). Taking into account that = levando em conta que: foi a resposta da Transpetro 2018 Q13 para given that (causa).
cards.dica: Account = conta: take into account = levar em conta.
cards.nc: account for (representar, responder por: accounted for 5 per cent = representou 5%); because of the fact that (também causa, mas a banca ficou com a paráfrase mais literal)

cards.f: business / businesses · Regenerative businesses go beyond sustainability and fight to do more good to society and the planet.
cards.sig: empresas (substantivo). No singular, business = negócio, ramo: the energy business = o setor de energia. Business hours = horário comercial.
cards.dica: Business vem de busy (ocupado): estar ocupado com negócios.
cards.ex: I typically work only during business hours... (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: busy (ocupado); businessman (empresário)

cards.f: project · Some projects are still in the planning stages, offering great promise for the future.
cards.sig: projetos (substantivo). Project management = gestão de projetos. Cognato.
cards.dica: Project é a sua matéria de Projetos (PMBOK) em inglês.
cards.ex: Woman 2: I talk with clients, help prepare bids and work on getting projects out the door. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: design (projeto no sentido de concepção: design life = vida útil projetada)

cards.f: solar · Solar is also thriving: according to the International Energy Agency, costs have fallen by 70 per cent since 2010...
cards.sig: energia solar (substantivo; também adjetivo, solar). Solar PV = solar fotovoltaica. Cognato.
cards.dica: Na mesma frase, thriving = prosperando, em alta (foi sinônimo de developing na Transpetro 2018 Q18).
cards.ex: EO data will be critical in future forecasting models for wind and solar production, to help manage a consistent flow of green energy. (Transpetro 2023)
cards.nc: wind (vento, energia eólica): o par mais comum nos textos de energia

cards.f: electricity · In 2020 the United States generated about four trillion kilowatt-hours of electricity.
cards.sig: eletricidade (substantivo). Electric = elétrico: electric cars = carros elétricos. Cognato.
cards.dica: Electrification = eletrificação (Petrobras 2017).
cards.ex: ...wind becomes the leading source of electricity soon after 2030. (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: electronic (eletrônico) x electric (elétrico)

cards.f: source · ...as fast-declining costs turn solar power into the cheapest source of new electricity generation.
cards.sig: fonte (substantivo). Source of electricity = fonte de eletricidade. Como verbo, obter: source murumuru butter = obter manteiga de murumuru.
cards.dica: Open source = código-fonte aberto.
cards.ex: Renewable energy sources like solar and wind have grown faster than expected... (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: resource (recurso); course (curso)

cards.f: major · A cleaner and more diversified energy mix in China is another major driver of this transformation.
cards.sig: importante, principal (adjetivo). Major driver = fator principal. Falso cognato: major não é maior (isso é bigger ou larger).
cards.dica: Major league = liga principal; minor = secundário.
cards.ex: Woman 1: I went to a university that all major oil companies recruit. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: main (principal): parecidos, não opostos (Petrobras 2012 Q14); mayor (prefeito)

cards.f: wind · Wind is approaching grid parity...
cards.sig: vento, energia eólica (substantivo). Wind farms = parques eólicos; offshore wind = eólica no mar. Não é cognato.
cards.dica: Windsurf = surfe movido a vento.
cards.ex: As more wind and solar installations join the electricity network... (Transpetro 2023)
cards.nc: solar (energia solar): o par mais comum; window (janela)

cards.f: supply / supplies · ...managing highly variable supply and demand, as well as a large network of EV charging points.
cards.sig: oferta, fornecimento (substantivo). Supplies (plural) = suprimentos; supplier = fornecedor.
cards.dica: Supply chain = cadeia de suprimentos (logística).
cards.ex: Computer program helps responders transport supplies in tough conditions (Transpetro 2011)
cards.nc: demand (procura): supply and demand = oferta e procura; support (apoio)

cards.f: tool · And according to a new tool that predicts where deforestation will happen next...
cards.sig: ferramenta (substantivo). Digital tools = ferramentas digitais. Não é cognato.
cards.dica: Toolbox = caixa de ferramentas.
cards.ex: ‘Mathematical tools are essential to develop formal means to predict... (Transpetro 2011)
cards.nc: skill (habilidade): a ferramenta x a capacidade de usá-la

cards.f: coal · The boom years for coal are over...
cards.sig: carvão mineral (substantivo). Coal mines = minas de carvão. Não é cognato.
cards.dica: Charcoal = carvão vegetal (do churrasco); coal = carvão mineral, a energia mais suja dos textos.
cards.ex: ...abandoned coal mines and restore the natural ecosystems in Appalachia. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: carbon (carbono); cool (fresco, legal); goal (meta)

cards.f: question · The key energy questions for 2018
cards.sig: perguntas, questões (substantivo). Key questions = questões-chave. Como verbo, question = questionar.
cards.dica: Question mark = ponto de interrogação.
cards.ex: Five women were asked the same questions regarding their career choices in the oil and gas industry. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: quest (busca: the quest for oil = a busca por petróleo); issue (questão, assunto)

cards.f: million / billion · Thus, the bank purchased Abstraktes Bild (Faust), Gerhard Richter's 1981 triptych, for 12 million dollars...
cards.sig: milhões (numeral million). 12 million dollars = 12 milhões de dólares (million fica sem s depois de número). Billion = bilhão; trillion = trilhão.
cards.dica: 6m = 6 million; 50bn = 50 billion. Na Banese 2025 Q13, o preço de compra (12 milhões) foi a isca; a venda foi pelo triplo, 36.
cards.ex: ...even with a doubling of the car fleet to two billion. (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: billion (bilhão) x million (milhão)

cards.f: road · According to Imazon, 90% of accumulated deforestation is concentrated within 5.5km of a road.
cards.sig: estrada, rodovia (substantivo). Road vehicles = veículos rodoviários; from road to rail = da rodovia para a ferrovia.
cards.dica: Road movie = filme de estrada. Railroad = ferrovia.
cards.ex: ...help shift more passengers from road to rail... (Transpetro 2023)
cards.nc: route (rota); rail (trilho, ferrovia)

cards.f: life · The average life expectancy of its citizens is 84 years.
cards.sig: vida (substantivo). Life expectancy = expectativa de vida; life insurance = seguro de vida; design life = vida útil projetada.
cards.dica: Lifetime = tempo de vida, vida útil.
cards.ex: ...extending the lifetime of some existing trains. (Transpetro 2023)
cards.nc: live (viver; ao vivo); lifestyle (estilo de vida)

cards.f: local · Most renewable companies are small and local, and in many cases undercapitalised...
cards.sig: local (adjetivo). Local content = conteúdo local; local communities = comunidades locais. Cognato.
cards.dica: Local = do lugar; global = do mundo: o par oposto.
cards.ex: However, “if we have a firm and successful local content policy... (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: location (localização: remote locations = locais remotos)

cards.f: experience · The country's experience in managing renewable resources in its energy mix can contribute greatly to IEA discussions on a broadened concept of energy security.
cards.sig: experiência (substantivo). Como verbo, experience = passar por, sofrer: areas which have experienced natural disasters = áreas que sofreram desastres naturais. Cognato.
cards.dica: Experienced = experiente (pessoa) ou que já passou por algo.
cards.ex: ...haven't had the learning experiences needed to do the job efficiently. (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: experiment (experimento, teste)

cards.f: consume / consumer / consumption · India and China will consume 28 percent of global energy by 2030...
cards.sig: consumir (verbo). Consumer = consumidor; consumption = consumo: energy consumption = consumo de energia. Cognatos.
cards.dica: A família do consumo: consume, consumer, consumption.
cards.ex: China, which accounts for a quarter of the world's daily energy use, is the swing consumer. (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: customer (cliente de uma loja) x consumer (consumidor)

cards.f: low / lower · ...one can infer that the more access to the satellite supplier market is feasible,... (A) the lower its price will be.
cards.sig: mais baixo, menor (comparativo de low): the lower its price = menor o preço (resposta da Transpetro 2023 Q14). Low = baixo: low latency = baixa latência. Direção: desce.
cards.dica: Low cost = baixo custo; low-carbon = de baixo carbono.
cards.ex: ...satellites that offer low-latency connectivity and frequently updated data. (Transpetro 2023)
cards.nc: slow (lento); higher (mais alto): o par oposto nas alternativas

cards.f: know / known · ...artists were also known to use their work as collateral for loans.
cards.sig: conhecidos (particípio de know): were known to = eram conhecidos por, sabia-se que. Know = saber, conhecer; know-how = conhecimento prático.
cards.dica: Know, knew, known. O k é mudo: soa 'nou', igual a no.
cards.ex: “We have clearly lost the know-how to build traditional gigawatt-scale nuclear power plants,” Buongiorno says. (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: now (agora); no (não), que soa igual a know

cards.f: level · But at the global level there are four key questions, and each of which answers is highly uncertain.
cards.sig: nível (substantivo). At the global level = em nível global; record low levels = níveis recordes de baixa. Cognato: parece com nível.
cards.dica: Level 1, level 2: as fases de um game.
cards.ex: ...driven not least by the levels of air pollution in many of the major cities... (Transpetro 2018)

cards.f: going · Nuclear power has a lot going for it.
cards.sig: have a lot going for it = ter muitos pontos a favor (expressão). Foi a Eletronuclear 2022 Q19: presents many advantageous qualities. Be going to = vai (futuro); going on = acontecendo.
cards.dica: Algo 'going for you' trabalha a seu favor.
cards.ex: There's a debate going on among career experts about which is more important: skillset or mindset. (BR Distribuidora 2011)
cards.nc: be going to (futuro: this is going to change); going on (acontecendo)

cards.f: position · ...they offered me a position at the company's headquarters in Houston...
cards.sig: cargo, vaga (substantivo). Hold the position of president = ocupar o cargo de presidente. Também posição: a position as a world leader. Cognato.
cards.dica: No organograma, position é o cargo.
cards.ex: ...is catapulting China to a position as a world leader in wind, solar, nuclear and electric vehicles... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: headquarters (sede, matriz: = main office, Petrobras 2012 Q14)

cards.f: situation · The work can be applied to immediate, pressing situations, such as getting blood, food or medication to a disaster site...
cards.sig: situações (substantivo). Pressing situations = situações urgentes (pressing e trivial foram antônimos na Transpetro 2011 Q18). Cognato.
cards.dica: -tion vira -ção: situation = situação.
cards.ex: ...connectivity that can reach into situations where terrestrial technologies struggle to deliver... (Transpetro 2023)
cards.nc: site (local: disaster site); location (localização)

cards.f: field · We call the field every morning for an update on operations, security, construction, facilities and production engineering activities.
cards.sig: campo (substantivo): o campo de petróleo, onde ficam os poços. Também área de atuação: two disparate fields = duas áreas bem diferentes.
cards.dica: Oil field = campo de petróleo; football field = campo de futebol.
cards.ex: (C) all the interviewees mentioned that the challenges of the field attracted them. (Petrobras 2012, Q11)
cards.nc: file (arquivo); feel (sentir)

cards.f: century · By the 16th century, as religious influences receded...
cards.sig: século (substantivo). By the 16th century = por volta do século XVI; half-century = meio século.
cards.dica: Cent = 100: century = 100 anos; per cent = por cem.
cards.ex: “We've innovated so little in the past half-century, there's a lot of ground to gain,” says Ashley Finan... (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: decade (década); centre (centro)

cards.f: potential · Nevertheless, with PrevisIA, there is the potential for change.
cards.sig: potencial (substantivo; também adjetivo). Potential for change = potencial de mudança; potential dangers = perigos potenciais. Cognato.
cards.dica: Na BASA 2024 Q8, o Nevertheless desta frase foi rotulado como opposition.
cards.ex: (C) argue that Brazil should try to avoid potential dangers associated to its recent deepwater oil discoveries. (Petrobras 2011, Q11)

cards.f: goods · (B) announce a study to identify an effective strategy to distribute goods and services in emergencies.
cards.sig: bens, mercadorias (substantivo plural). Goods and services = bens e serviços. No singular, good = bom; for good or for ill = para o bem ou para o mal.
cards.dica: Na Transpetro 2011 Q11, esta foi a resposta certa (intenção do artigo).
cards.ex: ...for good or for ill. (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: good (bom); food (comida)

cards.f: four / fourth · Every reader will have their own view on each of the four questions.
cards.sig: quatro (numeral). Fourth = quarto (4º): the fourth paragraph = o quarto parágrafo.
cards.dica: Four (4) soa como for (para). Fourteen = 14; forty = 40 (sem u).
cards.ex: In the fragment in fourth paragraph of the text (BASA 2024, Q8)
cards.nc: for (para); a quarter (um quarto, 1/4) x fourth (quarto, 4º)

cards.f: international · The International Energy Agency reckons the world will need to find 65 million additional barrels...
cards.sig: internacional (adjetivo). International Energy Agency (IEA) = Agência Internacional de Energia. Cognato.
cards.dica: Inter = entre: international = entre nações.
cards.ex: ...which aims to promote international coordination on advanced low carbon fuels. (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: internal (interno)

cards.f: example · ...set an example to countries around the world.
cards.sig: exemplo (substantivo). Set an example = dar o exemplo; for example = por exemplo. Também rótulo de conectivo: example (for instance, such as). Cognato.
cards.dica: For example = for instance = such as: rótulo example (BNDES 2024 Q35).
cards.ex: In the Amazon, we find an example of how regeneration works in practice. (BNDES 2024)
cards.nc: exam (prova); sample (amostra)

cards.f: likely · ...were seven times more likely to get the job, often over other more qualified candidates.
cards.sig: prováveis, com mais chance (adjetivo): seven times more likely = com sete vezes mais chance. Is likely to = provavelmente vai. Marca possibilidade, não certeza.
cards.dica: Like = parecido; likely = 'com cara de que vai acontecer'. Unlikely = improvável.
cards.ex: ...variables that make deforestation more likely... (BASA 2024)
cards.nc: like (gostar; como); alike (parecido)

cards.f: see / seen · ...is so challenging that Brazilian engineers see it as a new frontier.
cards.sig: veem, consideram (verbo see): see it as = veem como. Com ano como sujeito, registrar: 2017 has seen an increase = em 2017 houve um aumento.
cards.dica: See, saw, seen.
cards.ex: The last few years have seen dramatic reductions in costs and strong increase in supply. (Transpetro 2018)
cards.nc: sea (mar, mesmo som); seem (parecer: It seemed interesting)

cards.f: carbon · The plan requires electricity generation... to be carbon-free by 2035.
cards.sig: livre de carbono (carbon-free). Carbon = carbono: low carbon = baixo carbono; carbon footprint = pegada de carbono. Cognato.
cards.dica: Carbon é carbono, não carvão (carvão é coal).
cards.ex: Its carbon footprint is equivalent to wind, less than solar, and orders of magnitude less than coal. (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: coal (carvão) x carbon (carbono)

cards.f: delay · This insight will help trains run more efficiently with fewer delays for passengers.
cards.sig: atrasos (substantivo). Como verbo, delay = atrasar, adiar. Low latency = minimal delay (atraso mínimo), resposta da Transpetro 2023 Q15.
cards.dica: O delay da transmissão ao vivo é o atraso.
cards.ex: (B) their construction faces constant delays that increase costs. (Eletronuclear 2022, Q23)
cards.nc: delete (apagar); relay (retransmitir)

cards.f: best · ...the computer model calculates the best supply chain in situations where standard routes may be disrupted.
cards.sig: a melhor (superlativo de good). Best practice = melhor prática; at best = na melhor das hipóteses.
cards.dica: Good, better, best = bom, melhor, o melhor.
cards.ex: The conventional wisdom fails (at best). (BR Distribuidora 2011)
cards.nc: better (melhor, comparativo)

cards.f: discuss · The main intention of Text II is to discuss the Brazilian
cards.sig: discutir, debater (verbo). Key topics discussed = principais temas debatidos. Cognato.
cards.dica: Discuss = analisar um tema; argue that = defender uma tese.
cards.ex: ...were among the key topics discussed by the world's energy leaders... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: argue (argumentar, defender); discover (descobrir)

cards.f: deep / deeper / deeply · Regeneration goes beyond sustainability by creating a deeper and wider socioeconomic impact.
cards.sig: mais profundo (comparativo de deep). Deep = profundo: deep-water = águas profundas; deeply = profundamente.
cards.dica: Adjetivo + -er = mais: deeper, wider, stronger. Foi a questão do sufixo na BNDES 2024 Q32.
cards.ex: ...we have been deeply embedded in the space engineering for more than 40 years... (Transpetro 2023)
cards.nc: depth (profundidade, substantivo: at great depth, Petrobras 2011); wider (mais amplo)

cards.f: meeting / meet · ...and upending traditional ways of meeting energy demand...
cards.sig: atender a (verbo meet): meeting energy demand = atender à demanda de energia. Como substantivo, meeting = reunião: project meetings = reuniões de projeto.
cards.dica: Meet = encontrar; meet demand = ir ao encontro da demanda, atendê-la.
cards.ex: I go to project meetings almost every day. (Petrobras 2012)
cards.nc: met (passado: needs are met first by renewables = as necessidades são atendidas primeiro pelas renováveis)

cards.f: investment · In 2020, faced with the spread of Covid-19, people's interest in illiquid art investments has diminished...
cards.sig: investimentos (substantivo). Invest = investir; investor = investidor. Cognato.
cards.dica: Na Banese 2025 Q11, o interesse diminuiu (diminished): a covid foi um fator negativo para esses investimentos.
cards.ex: ...and the need for more investment in CCUS... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: investigation (investigação)

cards.f: in fact · In fact, extreme oil will likely be the new normal.
cards.sig: na verdade, de fato (expressão). Rótulo da banca: emphasis; nas provas lidas, emphasis só apareceu como alternativa errada. Fact = fato.
cards.dica: In fact reforça o que veio antes: na verdade.
cards.ex: ...refers to the fact that (Transpetro 2011, Q13)
cards.nc: after the fact (depois do ocorrido); the fact that (o fato de que)

cards.f: government · Petrobras chief executive says neither the company nor the country's oil industry has so far been big enough to become a government cash cow.
cards.sig: governo (substantivo). Cash cow = fonte de dinheiro fácil (vaca leiteira). Cognato.
cards.dica: Govern = governar. Governance = governança: a sua matéria de Governança de TI.
cards.ex: (A) criticize government anti-deforestation actions. (BASA 2024, Q6)
cards.nc: governance (governança)

cards.f: including · ...as it becomes the cheapest source of electricity generation in many places, including China and India...
cards.sig: incluindo, inclusive (preposição). Including China and India = inclusive China e Índia. Cognato.
cards.dica: O que vem depois de including é exemplo do que veio antes.
cards.ex: ...including higher population density, the presence of settlements and rural properties... (BASA 2024)
cards.nc: excluding (excluindo); except (exceto)

cards.f: turn down · I couldn't turn down the great starting salary and a chance to live in New Orleans.
cards.sig: recusar (phrasal verb turn down). Caiu na Petrobras 2012 Q16: a resposta foi refuse. Turn sozinho = virar, transformar: turn solar power into... = transformar a energia solar em...
cards.dica: Turn down = abaixar (o volume); com uma oferta, recusar.
cards.ex: ...a Petrobras engineer turns on a tap and watches black liquid flow into a beaker. (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: turn on (ligar, abrir); in turn (por sua vez)

cards.f: highly · As it happens, we can obtain a highly moisturizing butter from the seeds of this palm tree...
cards.sig: muito, altamente (advérbio). Highly moisturizing = muito hidratante; highly uncertain = muito incerto. Não é 'mais alto' (higher).
cards.dica: High + ly = em alto grau: muito.
cards.ex: (A) has become highly competitive without subsidies or government support. (Transpetro 2018, Q19)
cards.nc: higher (mais alto); hardly (quase não)

cards.f: rapidly · Professionals are rapidly accumulating these skills...
cards.sig: rapidamente (advérbio). Rapid = rápido. Cognato.
cards.dica: O -ly é o nosso -mente: rapidly = rapidamente.
cards.ex: ...renewables are being deployed rapidly thanks to falling costs... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: rapid (adjetivo) x rapidly (advérbio)

cards.f: right · If that is right, the surge in oil prices over the past two months is a temporary and unsustainable phenomenon.
cards.sig: certo, correto (adjetivo). If that is right = se isso estiver certo. Right now = agora mesmo; right também é direito (o lado ou o direito legal).
cards.dica: All right = tudo certo. Right skills = as habilidades certas.
cards.ex: ...a person with the right mindset will develop the right skillset... (BR Distribuidora 2011)
cards.nc: write (escrever: mesmo som); rights (direitos)

cards.f: set · Jennifer: At Smarterer, we define skillset as the set of digital, social, and technical tools professionals use to be effective in the workforce.
cards.sig: conjunto (substantivo): the set of tools = o conjunto de ferramentas; skillset = conjunto de habilidades. Como verbo, set = estabelecer: set goals = estabelecer metas.
cards.dica: Mindset = mentalidade; skillset = conjunto de habilidades (o tema do texto da BR 2011).
cards.ex: President Joe Biden has set ambitious goals for fighting climate change... (Eletronuclear 2022)
cards.nc: is set to + verbo (vai, deve: futuro); settle (resolver, assentar)

cards.f: study · One of the most head-spinning studies we did, which was conducted by an independent statistician...
cards.sig: estudos (substantivo); to study = estudar. A study = um estudo, uma pesquisa. Cognato: parece com estudo.
cards.dica: Studies = estudos (o y vira ies no plural).
cards.ex: The study mentioned by Paul Stoltz (lines 75-89) shows that, to get a job, candidates must (BR Distribuidora 2011, Q18)
cards.nc: student (estudante); survey (pesquisa de opinião, levantamento)

cards.f: conventional · ...the earth's hoard of conventional oil is waning even faster.
cards.sig: convencional, tradicional (adjetivo). Conventional oil = petróleo convencional; conventional wisdom = senso comum. Cognato.
cards.dica: Conventional = o de sempre, o tradicional.
cards.ex: ...other forms of clean and conventional energy is recognized around the world... (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: convenient (conveniente, prático)

cards.f: challenge · A few figures from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) illustrate the challenge.
cards.sig: desafio (substantivo). Challenging = desafiador. Não é cognato.
cards.dica: Challenge soa 'tchálendj'. Na Eletronuclear 2022 Q18, this daunting challenge retomava a meta de rede elétrica sem carbono até 2035.
cards.ex: ...provides an excellent basis to develop solutions for global energy challenges. (Petrobras 2017)
cards.nc: change (mudança)

cards.f: severe · Even worse, Brazil could suffer a more severe form of the disease, the “oil curse”...
cards.sig: grave, severo (adjetivo). A more severe form of the disease = uma forma mais grave da doença. Cognato.
cards.dica: Severe impacts = impactos graves.
cards.ex: (A) suffering from severe problems derived from poor air quality. (Petrobras 2017, Q13)
cards.nc: several (vários): parecem, mas several é quantidade

cards.f: per cent / percent · ...solar photovoltaic capacity grew by 50 per cent in 2016...
cards.sig: por cento (per cent ou percent). 50 per cent = 50%; percentage = porcentagem.
cards.dica: Cent = 100. Na questão numérica, confira a que se refere cada porcentagem (Transpetro 2018 Q17).
cards.ex: Ninety-eight percent pick A. (BR Distribuidora 2011)
cards.nc: century (século); cent (centavo de dólar)

cards.f: continue · The shale oil and gas revolution in the United States continues thanks to the remarkable ability of producers...
cards.sig: continua (verbo continue). Continues to grow = continua a crescer. Cognato.
cards.dica: Continue = continuar; continuous = contínuo.
cards.ex: ...as China continues to grow, it's just going to be starved for those resources... (Petrobras 2011)
cards.nc: contain (conter)

cards.f: social · Social media managers must know the tools of their trade like Twitter, Facebook, WordPress, and have writing and communication skills.
cards.sig: social (adjetivo). Social media = redes sociais; social status = posição social. Cognato.
cards.dica: Socioeconomic = socioeconômico (social + econômico).
cards.ex: ...and as a marker of social status. (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: society (sociedade)

cards.f: reach · ...satcoms will step in to deliver highly reliable connectivity where 4G struggles to reach.
cards.sig: alcançar, chegar a (verbo). Where 4G struggles to reach = onde o 4G mal consegue chegar. Não é cognato.
cards.dica: Reach = esticar o braço até alcançar.
cards.ex: ...it now reaches an estimated value of 500 million U.S. dollars... (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: teach (ensinar); rich (rico)

cards.f: near / nearly · ...combined with monitoring sensors, will mean near real-time data guides operational decisions.
cards.sig: quase (near + real-time = quase em tempo real). Near = perto, próximo; nearly = quase (nearly 80% = quase 80%).
cards.dica: Nearly não é 'perto': é quase. Nearby = ali perto.
cards.ex: ...which would define the future vision of nearly every finance institution globally. (Banese 2025)
cards.nc: nearly (quase) x near (perto); early (cedo)

cards.f: aim / aims · ...with the aim of stopping deforestation before it starts.
cards.sig: objetivo (substantivo): with the aim of = com o objetivo de. Como verbo, aim = visar: aims to revitalize = visa revitalizar.
cards.dica: Aim = mirar o alvo. Rótulo parecido nos conectivos: purpose (finalidade).
cards.ex: ...a multi-stakeholder coalition that aims to revitalize... (BNDES 2024)

cards.nc: triple (o triplo)

cards.f: times
cards.sig: vezes (seven times more = sete vezes mais).
cards.ex: ...people in the Amazon can generate seven times more economic value by preserving the murumuru tree than cutting it.
cards.nc: time (tempo; vez)

cards.f: into
cards.sig: para dentro de; em (evolve into = transformar-se em).
cards.ex: ...the firm launched a 10-year plan to evolve the life insurance firm into a life regeneration company.
cards.nc: in (em, dentro)

cards.f: through
cards.sig: através de, por meio de; durante.
cards.ex: ...satellites provide regular software updates to vehicles and enhanced safety through an in-car emergency call service.
cards.nc: though (embora)

cards.f: within
cards.sig: dentro de (within minutes = em poucos minutos, em até minutos).
cards.ex: (C) low volume of data will be communicated within minutes.
cards.nc: without (sem)

cards.f: under
cards.sig: sob, debaixo de; menos de (under control = sob controle).
cards.ex: ...a biofuels programme that has helped keep domestic oil-demand growth under control.

cards.f: after
cards.sig: depois de, após (soon after 2030 = logo depois de 2030).
cards.ex: After one year, the company asked me to take the position of managing their marine and offshore power products division.
cards.nc: before (antes)

cards.f: before
cards.sig: antes de.
cards.ex: My day usually starts well before 8 a.m. with phone calls and emails
cards.nc: after (depois)

cards.f: towards / toward
cards.sig: em direção a, rumo a; em relação a.
cards.ex: LNG from the United States is also accelerating a major structural shift towards a more flexible and globalized gas market.

cards.f: against
cards.sig: contra.
cards.ex: (B) Woman 2 complains against her very boring schedule at the office

cards.f: per
cards.sig: por (per cent = por cento; per day = por dia).
cards.ex: Renewables, including hydro, accounted for just 5 per cent of global daily energy supply

cards.f: below
cards.sig: abaixo (in the fragments below = nos trechos abaixo).
cards.ex: Concerning the referent to the pronoun it, in the fragments below,

cards.f: least
cards.sig: o menos; at least = pelo menos; not least = sobretudo, em boa parte.
cards.ex: ...driven not least by the levels of air pollution in many of the major cities
cards.nc: less (menos)

cards.f: much
cards.sig: muito (com incontável); much more = muito mais.
cards.ex: ...and with much of the area still to be fully explored
cards.nc: many (muitos, contável)

cards.f: few / a few
cards.sig: few = poucos (ideia negativa); a few = alguns (ideia positiva); the last few years = os últimos anos.
cards.ex: It became one of the first few commercial art collections, as we know them today.

cards.f: any
cards.sig: qualquer; algum (em pergunta ou negação).
cards.ex: ...any volatility will destabilise a market where speculation is rife.

cards.f: each
cards.sig: cada (um): each of the four questions = cada uma das quatro perguntas.
cards.ex: ...connecting each point to the internet for operational management purposes
cards.nc: every (todo)

cards.f: own
cards.sig: próprio (their own transition = a sua própria transição).
cards.ex: By joining these initiatives, businesses can accelerate their own transition to a regenerative model.

cards.f: same
cards.sig: mesmo, mesma (the same = o mesmo).
cards.ex: My days are never the same, which is what I love about the job I have.

cards.f: no
cards.sig: nenhum, nenhuma; não (with no change in meaning = sem nenhuma mudança de sentido).
cards.ex: the word pivotal can be replaced, with no change in meaning, by

cards.f: just
cards.sig: apenas, só; também acabou de, justamente. Não é absoluto: just one of the women foi gabarito.
cards.ex: Sustainable brands strive to just do less harm to the planet.
cards.nc: only (absoluto)

cards.f: enough
cards.sig: suficiente, o bastante; far from enough = longe de ser suficiente.
cards.ex: Do your research – I can’t stress this enough.

cards.f: almost
cards.sig: quase.
cards.ex: I go to project meetings almost every day.

cards.f: often
cards.sig: frequentemente, muitas vezes.
cards.ex: Art collecting is often included under the umbrella of a marketing strategy

cards.f: always / never
cards.sig: sempre / nunca. Em alternativa, são absolutos: costumam derrubar a opção.

cards.f: what
cards.sig: o que; que, qual.
cards.ex: What are the issues that will shape the global energy market in 2018?

cards.f: why
cards.sig: por que; the reasons why = os motivos pelos quais.
cards.ex: Question 1: Why did you choose the oil and gas industry?

cards.f: we / us / our
cards.sig: nós / nos, a nós / nosso, nossa.
cards.ex: We have a strong track record of translating these advances into practical benefits for our customers

cards.f: I / me / my
cards.sig: eu / me, mim / meu, minha.
cards.ex: On most days I work on my computer to complete my projects.

cards.f: you / your
cards.sig: você, vocês / seu, sua, de vocês.
cards.ex: Do you have any data or statistics to back up your argument?

cards.f: one-third
cards.sig: um terço (cerca de 33%).
cards.ex: ...with India accounting for almost one-third of global growth to 2040.

cards.f: triple
cards.sig: o triplo (3 vezes).
cards.dica: Comprado por 12 milhões e vendido pelo triplo: 36 milhões.
cards.ex: ...for 12 million dollars; in February 2020, it was sold for triple the amount to an anonymous buyer.
cards.nc: doubling (o dobro)

cards.f: actually
cards.sig: na verdade, de fato. Não é atualmente.
cards.dica: Na BR Distribuidora 2011 Q16, o par currently e actually era isca.
cards.ex: None of the classic, accepted advice, like using action verbs or including hobbies/interests actually made any difference.
cards.nc: currently, nowadays = atualmente

cards.f: eventually
cards.sig: finalmente, no fim, com o tempo. Não é eventualmente.
cards.dica: Pense em event: o evento final.
cards.nc: occasionally = eventualmente, de vez em quando

cards.f: ultimately
cards.sig: em última análise, no fim das contas. Não é ultimamente.
cards.dica: Na Petrobras 2011 Q17, trocar Ultimately por Furthermore estava errado.
cards.ex: Ultimately, Brazil’s ability to avoid Dutch disease will depend not just on how the money from the oil is spent.
cards.nc: lately, recently = ultimamente

cards.f: realize / realise
cards.sig: perceber, dar-se conta. Com potential ou dream: concretizar.
cards.dica: Não é só realizar (fazer); para isso o inglês usa carry out.
cards.ex: During Covid-19, the firm realized that its true mission should be to boost people’s vitality rather than protect them from death.
cards.nc: carry out = realizar, executar

cards.f: attend
cards.sig: frequentar, participar de, comparecer. Não é atender.
cards.ex: Join a professional association and attend their events
cards.nc: answer, serve = atender

cards.f: support
cards.sig: apoiar, sustentar; apoio. Não é suportar (aguentar).
cards.ex: To curb any negative effects, Brazil is trying to support domestic manufacturing by increasing “local content” requirements in the oil industry.
cards.nc: stand, bear, tolerate = suportar

cards.f: policy
cards.sig: política no sentido de diretriz, programa de ação (energy policy). Não é polícia.
cards.ex: Without a “firm local content policy”, says Petrobras CEO, Dutch disease and the oil curse will take hold.
cards.nc: politics = política partidária; police = polícia

cards.f: data
cards.sig: dados, informações. Não é a data do calendário.
cards.ex: Satellite data and communications will also play a fundamental role in shaping a sustainable future for road vehicles.
cards.nc: date = data

cards.f: push
cards.sig: empurrar, pressionar, impulsionar. Não é puxar.
cards.dica: push higher = empurra para cima (sobe); push down = empurra para baixo (desce).
cards.ex: ...other countries continue to push overall global demand higher
cards.nc: pull = puxar

cards.f: major
cards.sig: principal, importante, grande. Não é maior.
cards.dica: Na Petrobras 2012 Q14, major and main express opposite ideas era isca: são parecidos.
cards.ex: I went to a university that all major oil companies recruit.
cards.nc: bigger, larger = maior

cards.f: large
cards.sig: grande. Não é largo.
cards.dica: largely = em grande parte.
cards.ex: ...managing highly variable supply and demand, as well as a large network of EV charging points.
cards.nc: wide = largo, amplo

cards.f: achieve
cards.sig: alcançar, conseguir, atingir. Não é achar.
cards.ex: ...regenerative businesses can achieve far better financial performance and impact than their sustainability-focused peers.
cards.nc: find = achar

cards.f: pivotal
cards.sig: essencial, crucial, decisivo (sinal positivo).
cards.dica: Lembra pivô, mas não traduza pela aparência: no texto, vinha perto de critical e fundamental.
cards.ex: Satellite communications will also be pivotal.
cards.nc: erratic, haphazard (iscas)

cards.f: consistent
cards.sig: constante, regular, coerente (consistent flow = fluxo constante).
cards.dica: Na Transpetro 2023 Q17, o gabarito foi constant power flow.
cards.ex: ...to help manage a consistent flow of green energy.
cards.nc: intermittent = intermitente (isca)

cards.f: advice
cards.sig: conselho. Não é aviso.
cards.dica: expresses an advice = expressa um conselho (should).
cards.ex: None of the classic, accepted advice, like using action verbs or including hobbies/interests actually made any difference.
cards.nc: warning, notice = aviso

cards.f: plant
cards.sig: em texto de energia, usina ou fábrica (power plant = usina de energia). Também planta.
cards.ex: (D) “5 per cent” (line 68) refers to the percentage of global energy generated by hydroelectric plants.

cards.f: actual
cards.sig: real, efetivo, verdadeiro. Não é atual.
cards.nc: current = atual

cards.f: assist / assistance
cards.sig: ajudar / ajuda. Não é assistir.
cards.ex: ...calls at night or on weekends from a rig or other geologists for assistance with a technical problem.
cards.nc: watch = assistir

cards.f: prospective
cards.sig: futuro, potencial (prospective employees = futuros funcionários).
cards.dica: Na Petrobras 2012 Q14, prospective and former are synonyms era isca.
cards.ex: ...discuss the qualities that employers have been looking for in prospective job candidates.
cards.nc: former = antigo, ex-

cards.f: record
cards.sig: recorde (record high = alta recorde) ou registro. Não é recordar.
cards.dica: track record = histórico.
cards.ex: Despite record high unemployment, many jobs sit empty because employers can’t find candidates with the right skills.
cards.nc: remember = recordar

cards.f: claimed
cards.sig: declarado, alegado (claim = afirmar, alegar, reivindicar). Não é clamar.
cards.dica: Na Transpetro 2018 Q18, claimed can be replaced by hidden era isca.
cards.ex: Growth was probably lower than the claimed numbers
cards.nc: hidden = escondido

cards.f: currency
cards.sig: moeda (o dinheiro de um país). Não é corrente.
cards.ex: In the 17th century, art became a consumer commodity, and would often be used as currency
cards.nc: current = atual; corrente

cards.f: domestic
cards.sig: nacional, interno (domestic market = mercado interno), não só de casa.
cards.ex: ...a biofuels programme that has helped keep domestic oil-demand growth under control.

cards.f: apply (to)
cards.sig: candidatar-se (apply to a company); também aplicar.
cards.dica: application = candidatura ou aplicação, conforme o contexto.
cards.ex: I want students to apply to Talisman, not because we have open jobs, but because they actually have an interest in what we’re doing

cards.f: resume
cards.sig: currículo (résumé, CV); como verbo, retomar. Não é resumir.
cards.ex: They should be articulating their skills in their resume, cover letter, LinkedIn profile, blog, website
cards.nc: summarize = resumir

cards.f: figure out
cards.sig: descobrir, calcular, entender. figures = números, cifras.
cards.ex: (C) figure out the costs of space technology.

cards.f: expertise
cards.sig: conhecimento especializado, competência. expert = especialista, não esperto.
cards.ex: (B) leading expertise in conventional energy and experience in managing renewable resources.
cards.nc: smart = esperto

cards.f: petrol
cards.sig: gasolina (inglês britânico). Petróleo é oil ou crude oil.
cards.nc: oil, crude oil = petróleo

cards.f: pretend
cards.sig: fingir. Não é pretender.
cards.nc: intend = pretender, ter a intenção

cards.f: sensible
cards.sig: sensato, razoável. Não é sensível.
cards.nc: sensitive = sensível

cards.f: comprehensive
cards.sig: abrangente, completo. Não é compreensivo.
cards.nc: understanding = compreensivo

cards.f: scholarship
cards.sig: bolsa de estudos. Não é escolaridade.
cards.ex: ...as a recipient of one of these scholarships, my graduate advisor strongly encouraged me to participate

cards.f: patron
cards.sig: mecenas, patrocinador. Não é patrão.
cards.ex: ...bankers were motivated by the luxury of becoming patrons of the arts
cards.nc: boss = patrão

cards.f: collateral
cards.sig: garantia de empréstimo. Não é efeito colateral.
cards.ex: ...artists were also known to use their work as collateral for loans.
cards.nc: side effect = efeito colateral

cards.f: commission (verb)
cards.sig: encomendar (uma obra). Como substantivo, comissão.
cards.ex: ...when wealthy financiers would acquire or commission masterpieces

cards.f: lecture
cards.sig: palestra, aula expositiva. Não é leitura.
cards.nc: reading = leitura

cards.f: library
cards.sig: biblioteca. Não é livraria.
cards.nc: bookstore = livraria

cards.f: parents
cards.sig: pais (pai e mãe). Não é parentes.
cards.nc: relatives = parentes

cards.f: college
cards.sig: faculdade, ensino superior. Não é colégio.
cards.nc: school = colégio, escola

cards.f: exquisite
cards.sig: requintado, refinado. Não é esquisito.
cards.nc: weird, strange = esquisito

cards.f: fabric
cards.sig: tecido, pano; também estrutura (the fabric of society). Não é fábrica.
cards.nc: factory, plant = fábrica

cards.f: prejudice
cards.sig: preconceito. Não é prejuízo.
cards.nc: loss, damage = prejuízo

cards.f: assume
cards.sig: supor, presumir; também assumir um cargo. Muitas vezes é supor.
cards.nc: take on = assumir (responsabilidade)

cards.f: compromise
cards.sig: acordo, meio-termo; como verbo, também comprometer (pôr em risco). Não é compromisso.
cards.nc: commitment, appointment = compromisso

cards.f: terrific
cards.sig: ótimo, incrível. Não é terrível.
cards.nc: terrible = terrível

cards.f: novel
cards.sig: romance (livro); como adjetivo, novo, inédito. Não é novela.
cards.nc: soap opera = novela

cards.f: will
cards.sig: futuro, previsão: vai + verbo (-rá: will be = será).
cards.ex: Satellite communications will also be pivotal.
cards.nc: would (hipótese: -ria)

cards.f: would
cards.sig: hipótese, condicional: -ria (compensaria, aumentaria). Não é certeza.
cards.dica: A alternativa will certainly reach era isca: o texto dizia would.
cards.ex: A comparable increase in 2018 would offset most of the current OPEC production cuts and either force another quota reduction or push prices down.
cards.nc: will (certeza de futuro)

cards.f: may
cards.sig: possibilidade: pode, pode ser que, talvez.
cards.ex: Where the common journey of banking and art may lead in later decades or centuries is difficult to predict
cards.nc: May (maio)

cards.f: might
cards.sig: possibilidade mais fraca: poderia, talvez. Texto com might pede resposta que especula.
cards.ex: (E) might affect oil production and trade if they engage in an open conflict.
cards.nc: may (pode ser que); must (obrigação)

cards.f: could
cards.sig: possibilidade (poderia) ou capacidade no passado (podia, conseguia).
cards.ex: Even worse, Brazil could suffer a more severe form of the disease, the “oil curse”
cards.nc: can (pode, consegue)

cards.f: can
cards.sig: capacidade ou possibilidade: pode, consegue.
cards.ex: If they can perfect this, they can lead the way in other markets with similar geology, such as Africa.
cards.nc: could (poderia)

cards.f: should
cards.sig: recomendação, conselho: deveria, deve.
cards.dica: Rótulo nas alternativas: advice ou recommendation.
cards.ex: They should be articulating their skills in their resume, cover letter, LinkedIn profile, blog, website
cards.nc: must (obrigação)

cards.f: must
cards.sig: obrigação forte: deve, tem de.
cards.dica: Rótulo nas alternativas: obligation.
cards.ex: Marketers must know their marketing tools and software.
cards.nc: should (conselho); must be (dedução)

cards.f: have to / has to
cards.sig: obrigação: ter de, precisar.
cards.dica: Na questão de conselho, have to era alternativa errada (obrigação).
cards.ex: Programmers have to know how to program.

cards.f: is set to
cards.sig: previsão próxima: vai, está a caminho de (futuro sem will).
cards.ex: China is set to overtake the U.S. in energy consumption by 2014.

cards.f: is projected to / is expected to
cards.sig: previsão: prevê-se que, espera-se que (futuro sem will).
cards.ex: By the mid-2020s, the United States is projected to become the world’s largest LNG exporter and a net oil exporter by the end of that decade.

cards.f: is likely to / will likely
cards.sig: probabilidade: provavelmente vai, deve.
cards.dica: likely = provável (adjetivo, apesar do -ly).
cards.ex: ...Iran is likely to win any such clash and to treat the result as a licence to reassert its influence in the region.
cards.nc: like (como; gostar)

cards.f: David Rockefeller launched the bank’s art collection programme
cards.sig: -ed no verbo principal = passado simples: launched = lançou.
cards.dica: Ache o sujeito: se o -ed vem logo depois dele, é passado.
cards.ex: In light of this tectonic shift, Chase Manhattan Bank president David Rockefeller launched the bank’s art collection programme
cards.nc: -ed depois de substantivo (particípio)

cards.f: was / were
cards.sig: passado de be: era, estava, foi (was no singular; were no plural).
cards.ex: My first job in the oil and gas industry was an internship with Mobil Oil Corp., in New Orleans.
cards.nc: where (onde)

cards.f: has / have + particípio
cards.sig: presente perfeito: aconteceu e ainda vale agora (has diminished = diminuiu e continua menor).
cards.dica: Com since ou for (desde, há), é ação que vem até hoje.
cards.ex: In 2020, faced with the spread of Covid-19, people’s interest in illiquid art investments has diminished
cards.nc: had + particípio (tinha + particípio)

cards.f: have been + -ing
cards.sig: ação contínua até agora: vem + -ndo (have been looking for = vêm procurando).
cards.ex: (B) discuss the qualities that employers have been looking for in prospective job candidates.

cards.f: is / are + particípio
cards.sig: voz passiva: é, são + particípio (o sujeito recebe a ação). by = por.
cards.ex: Over the next 25 years, the world’s growing energy needs are met first by renewables and natural gas
cards.nc: is + -ing (está fazendo)

cards.f: was / were + particípio
cards.sig: passiva no passado: foi, foram + particípio.
cards.ex: Five women were asked the same questions regarding their career choices in the oil and gas industry.

cards.f: is / are + -ing
cards.sig: ação em andamento: está + -ndo (is booming = está em alta).
cards.ex: Right now, the satellite supplier market is booming, driving down the cost of access to satellites.
cards.nc: is + particípio (voz passiva)

cards.f: In the 18th and 19th centuries, banks would provide immeasurable support
cards.sig: would em narrativa do passado = hábito: costumava, -ava (os bancos forneciam).
cards.dica: Com data no passado (18th century), would é hábito, não hipótese.
cards.ex: In the 18th and 19th centuries, banks would provide immeasurable support to the founders of the earliest art academies and national museums.
cards.nc: would = -ria (hipótese)

cards.f: can’t / cannot
cards.sig: não pode, não consegue (impossibilidade, incapacidade).
cards.ex: ...many jobs sit empty because employers can’t find candidates with the right skills.

cards.f: ought to
cards.sig: recomendação: deveria (= should).

cards.f: must be
cards.sig: dedução: deve ser, certamente é (conclusão lógica, não ordem).
cards.nc: must + verbo (obrigação)

cards.f: need to
cards.sig: necessidade: precisar.
cards.ex: Data analysts need to know how to crunch numbers in Excel.

cards.f: is bound to
cards.sig: certeza no futuro: com certeza vai, está fadado a.
cards.ex: ...we may conclude that the historical trend is bound to spring back.

cards.f: is going to
cards.sig: futuro: vai + verbo.
cards.ex: But with the new discoveries, which stretch across an 800km belt off the coast of south-eastern Brazil, this is going to change.

cards.f: is about to
cards.sig: está prestes a, vai logo.
cards.ex: (A) was about to change its position from a major oil consumer into that of a net oil exporter.
cards.nc: about (sobre, cerca de)

cards.f: used to
cards.sig: used to + verbo = costumava (hábito no passado).
cards.dica: is used to + verbo = é usado para (voz passiva).
cards.nc: be used to + -ing = estar acostumado a

cards.f: certain skills requested by the employer
cards.sig: -ed depois do substantivo = particípio com valor de adjetivo: skills requested by = habilidades solicitadas por.
cards.dica: Com by depois, pense em voz passiva: feito por.
cards.ex: ...but currently lack certain skills requested by the employer?
cards.nc: -ed logo depois do sujeito (passado)

cards.f: became
cards.sig: passado de become: tornou-se, virou.
cards.ex: In the 17th century, art became a consumer commodity

cards.f: is being + particípio
cards.sig: passiva contínua: está sendo + particípio.
cards.ex: ...over the next two decades the global energy system is being reshaped by four major forces

cards.f: investing in R&D
cards.sig: -ing no papel de substantivo: investing = investir, o investimento (sujeito da frase).
cards.ex: According to paragraphs 9 and 10 (lines 55-65), investing in R&D

cards.f: By joining these initiatives
cards.sig: by + -ing = ao + verbo, por meio de (modo de fazer): ao aderir a essas iniciativas.
cards.ex: By joining these initiatives, businesses can accelerate their own transition to a regenerative model.

cards.f: wind becomes the leading source of electricity soon after 2030
cards.sig: presente simples com marcador de futuro (soon after 2030) = projeção futura. O tempo vem do marcador.
cards.ex: ...meanwhile in the European Union, wind becomes the leading source of electricity soon after 2030.

cards.f: un-
cards.sig: não, des-, in- (nega o adjetivo): uncertain = incerto; unsustainable = insustentável; undisputed = incontestável.
cards.dica: Na Petrobras 2017 Q14, undisputed = irrefutable foi o gabarito.
cards.ex: The US becomes the undisputed leader for oil and gas production for decades
cards.nc: under, understand, union, unique, united, university: não são un- de negação

cards.f: in- / im- / ir- / il-
cards.sig: não (nega): inadequate = inadequado; irrefutable = irrefutável; illiquid = sem liquidez; immeasurable = imensurável.
cards.ex: ...people’s interest in illiquid art investments has diminished
cards.nc: in- sem negação: increase, industry, indigenous, important, incumbent

cards.f: dis-
cards.sig: oposto, negação (= des-): disapprove = desaprovar; disadvantaged = desfavorecido; discover = descobrir.
cards.ex: The main idea of the text is to (A) disapprove space technology.
cards.nc: discuss, disaster: dis- sem sentido de negação

cards.f: re-
cards.sig: de novo, outra vez, volta ao estado anterior: renew = renovar; restore = restaurar; revitalize = revitalizar; reassert = reafirmar.
cards.ex: ...a multi-stakeholder coalition that aims to revitalize abandoned coal mines and restore the natural ecosystems in Appalachia.
cards.nc: re- sem de novo: realize, reason, record, region, report

cards.f: pre-
cards.sig: antes: predict = prever; prevent = evitar, impedir; presuppose = pressupor; previous = anterior.
cards.ex: (A) predict the imminent decrease of global oil demands in the near future.

cards.f: -less
cards.sig: sem: harmless = inofensivo (sem dano); useless = inútil; wireless = sem fio.
cards.ex: (D) be absolutely harmless and disappointing.
cards.nc: -ful (cheio de): harmful = prejudicial

cards.f: -ful
cards.sig: cheio de, que tem: successful = bem-sucedido; meaningful = significativo; powerful = poderoso.
cards.ex: ...thanks to a successful push into deep-water production
cards.nc: -less (sem)

cards.f: -ment
cards.sig: substantivo de ação ou resultado: development = desenvolvimento; investment = investimento; achievement = conquista.
cards.dica: -ment forma substantivo; o -mente do português é -ly.
cards.ex: ...but even so the achievement is considerable.
cards.nc: -ly (advérbio)

cards.f: -tion / -sion
cards.sig: substantivo: -ção, -são. production = produção; consumption = consumo; transition = transição; expansion = expansão.
cards.ex: ...as economic growth has picked up, so has consumption of oil and coal.

cards.f: -ity
cards.sig: substantivo: -dade. sustainability = sustentabilidade; profitability = lucratividade; volatility = volatilidade.
cards.ex: ...new ways of operating that boost both sustainability and profitability.

cards.f: -able / -ible
cards.sig: que pode ser: -ável, -ível. renewable = renovável; reliable = confiável; feasible = viável.
cards.dica: un- + -able nega: unreliable = não confiável.
cards.ex: ...one can infer that the more access to the satellite supplier market is feasible,

cards.f: -ly
cards.sig: advérbio: -mente. rapidly = rapidamente; simultaneously = simultaneamente; increasingly = cada vez mais.
cards.ex: ...regenerative firms seek to boost the health and vitality of people, places and the planet simultaneously
cards.exSrc: BNDES 2024, Q33 (= at the same time)
cards.nc: likely (provável), daily (diário), early (cedo, inicial): -ly que não vira -mente

cards.f: largely
cards.sig: em grande parte, principalmente. Não é largamente nem largo.
cards.ex: ...moving away from heavy industry fuelled largely by coal to a more service-based one
cards.nc: large = grande

cards.f: nearly
cards.sig: quase. Não é perto (near = perto).
cards.dica: nearly 80% = quase 80%: confira o número na alternativa.
cards.ex: According to a 2019 survey by ReGenFriends, nearly 80% of US consumers prefer “regenerative” brands to “sustainable” brands.
cards.nc: near = perto

cards.f: -er / -or: producer, supplier, employer
cards.sig: agente, quem faz: producer = produtor; supplier = fornecedor; employer = empregador; exporter = exportador.
cards.dica: -ee = quem recebe: employee = empregado; interviewee = entrevistado.
cards.ex: Right now, the satellite supplier market is booming
cards.nc: -er de comparativo (deeper, stronger)

cards.f: -er: deeper, stronger, cheaper
cards.sig: comparativo de adjetivo curto: mais ... (deeper = mais profundo; stronger = mais forte; cheaper = mais barato; lower = mais baixo).
cards.dica: water, together, other: só terminam em -er, não é sufixo.
cards.ex: Regeneration goes beyond sustainability by creating a deeper and wider socioeconomic impact.
cards.exSrc: BNDES 2024, Q32 (mesmo sufixo: stronger, gabarito D)
cards.nc: -er de agente (producer)

cards.f: -est
