cards.sig: superlativo: o mais ... largest = o maior; cheapest = o mais barato; biggest = o maior.
cards.ex: ...the 15 fields contain the world’s largest known offshore oil deposits.
cards.nc: interest, forest, request, suggest: não são superlativo

cards.f: unlock
cards.sig: un- em verbo = desfazer a ação: unlock = destrancar, liberar (oposto de lock, travar).
cards.dica: Unlock e restrain são opostos: o par de sinônimos estava errado.
cards.ex: (D) unlock (line 70) – restrain

cards.f: over-
cards.sig: acima, além, excesso: overtake = ultrapassar; overview = visão geral; overall = no geral.
cards.ex: China is set to overtake the U.S. in energy consumption by 2014.
cards.nc: over sozinho = mais de, ao longo de (over 40 per cent)

cards.f: under-
cards.sig: abaixo, sob, insuficiente: underpin = sustentar, embasar; undercapitalised = subcapitalizado; underway = em andamento.
cards.ex: ...satellite communications (satcoms) and space-based data are underpinning new ways of operating that boost both sustainability and profitability.
cards.nc: understand (entender) não é abaixo de nada

cards.f: inter-
cards.sig: entre: international = internacional; intersection = interseção, cruzamento; interaction = interação.
cards.ex: ...given the long history of interactions between bankers and people of art

cards.f: trans-
cards.sig: através, passagem de um estado a outro: transition = transição; transform = transformar; transmission = transmissão.
cards.ex: By joining these initiatives, businesses can accelerate their own transition to a regenerative model.

cards.f: de-
cards.sig: reverso, retirada, para baixo: decline = declinar; decrease = diminuir; destabilise = desestabilizar.
cards.ex: ...any volatility will destabilise a market where speculation is rife.

cards.f: out-
cards.sig: superar, para fora: outpace = superar em ritmo; output = produção; outstanding = excepcional.
cards.ex: To me, the prospect is of supply continuing to outpace demand.

cards.f: -ize / -ise
cards.sig: verbo: -izar. prioritize = priorizar; revitalize = revitalizar; criticize = criticar. -ise é a grafia britânica (destabilise).
cards.ex: But it’s not just natural ecosystems that can benefit from prioritizing regeneration.

cards.f: -ship
cards.sig: estado, relação, cargo: leadership = liderança; partnership = parceria; relationship = relacionamento; internship = estágio.
cards.ex: (D) strategic partnership with the IEA in the field of energy aiming at a safer and sustainable future.

cards.f: -ous
cards.sig: adjetivo: -oso. dangerous = perigoso; ambitious = ambicioso; synonymous = sinônimo; antonymous = antônimo.
cards.ex: Based on the meanings in the text, the two items are synonymous in

cards.f: mis-
cards.sig: errado, mal: misunderstand = entender mal; misuse = uso indevido; mislead = enganar.
cards.dica: Não apareceu como prefixo nas provas lidas (mission não conta).

cards.f: post-
cards.sig: depois: postpone = adiar (pôr para depois); post-war = pós-guerra.
cards.ex: (D) avoid postponing assigned tasks and wearing inappropriate clothes in the working environment.

cards.f: co-
cards.sig: junto, com: cooperation = cooperação; coordination = coordenação; co-author = coautor.
cards.ex: ...The Biofuture Platform, which aims to promote international coordination on advanced low carbon fuels.

cards.f: multi-
cards.sig: muitos: multi-stakeholder = com muitas partes interessadas.
cards.ex: For instance, Reimagine Appalachia (RI) is a multi-stakeholder coalition

cards.f: -ness
cards.sig: forma substantivo de qualidade ou estado: awareness = consciência; readiness = prontidão. business vem de busy + ness.

cards.f: -al
cards.sig: adjetivo: -al. environmental = ambiental; global; industrial; regional; essential = essencial.
cards.ex: ...a more meaningful socioeconomic and environmental impact.

cards.f: -ive
cards.sig: adjetivo: -ivo. competitive = competitivo; effective = eficaz; regenerative = regenerativo; communicative = comunicativo.
cards.ex: The communicative intention of Text I is to

cards.f: -en
cards.sig: forma verbo a partir de adjetivo (tornar ...): broaden = ampliar (broad); strengthen = fortalecer (strong); flatten = achatar (flat).
cards.ex: ...can contribute greatly to IEA discussions on a broadened concept of energy security.

cards.f: …a 50% increase in oil production in the past decade thanks to a successful push into deep-water production…
cards.sig: graças a (causa, em geral positiva)
cards.dica: Não é agradecimento: thanks to + causa = graças a. Família da causa: because of, due to.
cards.ex: Thanks to its expertise in global energy market and policy analysis, the IEA can support Brazil’s efforts…
cards.nc: thanks for (obrigado por) é agradecer; thanks to explica a causa.

cards.f: China, which accounts for a quarter of the world’s daily energy use, is the swing consumer.
cards.sig: responde por; representa (uma parcela)
cards.dica: accounts for 25% = representa 25%. Caiu na Petrobras 2017 (q15): accounting for = being the reason for (sendo responsável por).
cards.ex: …with India accounting for almost one-third of global growth to 2040.
cards.nc: account = conta (bancária); accounting = contabilidade; take into account = levar em conta.

cards.f: The sentence in which the boldfaced item expresses an advice is
cards.sig: frase; oração
cards.dica: Falso cognato: na prova, sentence é frase. Sentença judicial só no contexto jurídico.
cards.nc: phrase = expressão, grupo de palavras; word = palavra; paragraph = parágrafo.

cards.f: Some 60 percent of that came from burning fossil fuels, mostly natural gas…
cards.sig: combustíveis (fossil fuels = combustíveis fósseis)
cards.dica: fuel = combustível. Também verbo: fuelled by coal = movido a carvão; fuel growth = alimentar o crescimento.
cards.ex: …promote international coordination on advanced low carbon fuels.
cards.nc: biofuels = biocombustíveis; fossil = fóssil (petróleo, gás e carvão).

cards.f: …output from almost all America’s producing areas commercially viable and drilling activity is rising.
cards.sig: perfuração (de poços)
cards.dica: drill = broca, furadeira; perfurar. drilling activity = atividade de perfuração.
cards.ex: …deep-water drilling might seem taboo just now.
cards.nc: drill também é treino, simulado: fire drill = simulado de incêndio.

cards.f: …with bids from offshore wind for capacity auctions in the UK and elsewhere at record low levels.
cards.sig: no mar, afastado da costa (offshore wind = eólica no mar)
cards.dica: off (fora) + shore (costa) = fora da costa. A produção do pré-sal é offshore.
cards.ex: …managing their marine and offshore power products division.
cards.nc: onshore = em terra. Em finanças, offshore = no exterior (conta offshore).

cards.f: Dr Birol also congratulated Brazil for its recent successful deepwater bid round.
cards.sig: de águas profundas
cards.dica: deep (profundo) + water (água). ultradeepwater = águas ultraprofundas, como as do pré-sal.
cards.ex: …deepwater operations in the sulfur-laden depths of the Black Sea.
cards.nc: deep também é forte, acentuado: deep declines = quedas acentuadas.

cards.f: What will be the energy mix, trade patterns and price trends?
cards.sig: matriz (energy mix = matriz energética)
cards.dica: energy mix = a combinação de fontes de um país (petróleo, gás, hidrelétrica, solar…). O Brasil tem uma das matrizes mais limpas.
cards.ex: A cleaner and more diversified energy mix in China…
cards.nc: fuel mix = mistura de combustíveis; mixed = misto, variado.

cards.f: It looks and smells like ordinary crude oil.
cards.sig: bruto, cru (crude oil = petróleo bruto)
cards.dica: crude = não refinado. Em notícia, crude sozinho já significa petróleo: crude prices = preço do petróleo.
cards.ex: With crude still hemorrhaging into the Gulf of Mexico…
cards.nc: raw (cru, matéria-prima: raw materials); rude = grosseiro.

cards.f: Blistering growth in emerging nations has turned the power grid upside down.
cards.sig: rede elétrica (power grid)
cards.dica: grid = grade, malha. Na energia, a malha de transmissão. grid parity = custo igual ao da energia da rede.
cards.ex: Wind is approaching grid parity…
cards.nc: network também é rede (de computadores, de pessoas); grid é a rede elétrica.

cards.f: …even as electric-car sales rise steeply.
cards.sig: subir, aumentar (rise = alta; rising = crescente)
cards.dica: rise, rose, risen = subir sozinho. Sinônimos: increase, grow, go up. Em gráfico e notícia é palavra certa.
cards.ex: There are going to be some rising tensions over that.
cards.nc: raise = elevar algo (raise prices); arise = surgir.

cards.f: …costs have fallen by 70 per cent since 2010…
cards.sig: cair, diminuir (fall = queda)
cards.dica: fall, fell, fallen. falling costs = custos em queda. Sinônimos: decrease, decline, drop, go down.
cards.nc: Cuidado: to fell = derrubar árvores (BASA 2024: to fell an area of forest). fail = falhar.

cards.f: …deep declines in the cost of renewables and growing electrification are changing the face of the global energy system…
cards.sig: queda, declínio; (verbo) cair, diminuir
cards.dica: Família da queda: decline, decrease, fall, drop, slump. fast-declining costs = custos caindo rápido.
cards.ex: …as fast-declining costs turn solar power into the cheapest source of new electricity generation.
cards.nc: decline também é recusar: decline an offer = recusar uma oferta.

cards.f: The main purpose of Text I is to (A) predict the imminent decrease of global oil demands in the near future.
cards.sig: diminuição, queda; diminuir
cards.dica: de- (para baixo) + -crease (crescer, do latim crescere) = decrescer. O oposto é increase (aumento).
cards.ex: …refers to the percentage decrease in solar energy costs since 2010.
cards.nc: increase (aumentar); decree (decreto) só parece.

cards.f: …produce more than 40 per cent of the world’s crude oil.
cards.sig: mais de; mais do que
cards.dica: more than 40 = acima de 40. Família: over (over 70% = mais de 70%); less than e under (menos de).
cards.ex: …with consumers in Asia accounting for more than 70% of global oil and gas imports by 2040.
cards.nc: more and more = cada vez mais; no more than = no máximo.

cards.f: The country is the world’s second biggest exporter of iron ore.
cards.sig: exportador
cards.dica: -er = quem faz: export + er = exportador. net exporter = exporta mais do que importa.
cards.ex: …Brazil will become a net exporter this year…
cards.nc: importer (importador); exports e imports (exportações e importações).

cards.f: …2017 has seen an increase of 600,000 barrels a day to over 6m.
cards.sig: barris por dia (a day = por dia)
cards.dica: Em números: a day = per day = por dia; a year = por ano. bpd = barrels per day. 6m = 6 milhões.
cards.ex: …the world will need to find 65 million additional barrels a day by 2030.
cards.nc: barrel = barril, unidade do petróleo (cerca de 159 litros).

cards.f: Pumped by the national oil company from “pre-salt” deposits…
cards.sig: pré-sal
cards.dica: O próprio texto explica: chamam assim porque as jazidas ficam abaixo de 2.000 m de sal. deposits aqui = jazidas.
cards.nc: deposit também é depósito bancário; pre- = antes (pre-selected = pré-selecionado).

cards.f: …has made output from almost all America’s producing areas commercially viable…
cards.sig: produção (quantidade produzida)
cards.dica: out (para fora) + put (pôr): o que sai da produção. oil output = produção de petróleo.
cards.ex: …developing deep-water oil resources and expanding biofuels output…
cards.nc: input = entrada, insumo; outcome = resultado.

cards.f: …the transport sector contributes around 14% of the UK’s greenhouse gas emissions…
cards.sig: estufa (greenhouse gases = gases de efeito estufa)
cards.dica: green + house = a estufa de plantas. GHG = greenhouse gases.
cards.ex: …reduce greenhouse gas emissions by promoting the use of nuclear power.
cards.nc: global warming = aquecimento global; green = verde, sustentável.

cards.f: The second question is how rapidly production of oil from shale rock will grow in the US…
cards.sig: xisto (shale oil e shale gas)
cards.dica: A revolução do shale fez os EUA voltarem a ser grandes produtores de petróleo e gás. Termo técnico em português: folhelho.
cards.ex: The shale oil and gas revolution in the United States continues…
cards.nc: shell = concha, casca; shall = verbo modal.

cards.f: In many ways, the energy business is at a moment of change and transition.
cards.sig: transição (energy transition = transição energética)
cards.dica: energy transition = troca gradual de fontes fósseis por fontes limpas. Tema certo nos textos do Sistema Petrobras.
cards.ex: …businesses can accelerate their own transition to a regenerative model.
cards.nc: transmission (transmissão); transaction (transação).

cards.f: …the perennial concerns about safety and long-lived radioactive waste may not be the biggest…
cards.sig: segurança (contra acidentes)
cards.dica: safety = segurança física, contra acidentes (safe = seguro). security = proteção contra ataques, crimes e ameaças.
cards.ex: …and enhanced safety through an in-car emergency call service.
cards.nc: security (energy security, cybersecurity); save = salvar.

cards.f: Currently, one of the largest commercial collections of artworks is owned by Deutsche Bank.
cards.sig: atualmente; no momento
cards.dica: current = atual (the current crisis = a crise atual) + -ly (= -mente) = atualmente. Na BR Distribuidora 2011 (q16), a dupla currently e actually foi isca de sinônimos.
cards.nc: actually = na verdade (falso cognato). current também é corrente (de água, elétrica).

cards.f: …Dutch disease and the oil curse will take hold.
cards.sig: firmar-se, instalar-se (ficar forte e difícil de parar)
cards.dica: Caiu na Petrobras 2011 (q16): take hold = become stronger and difficult to stop.
cards.ex: …a new startup company where I hold the position of president.
cards.nc: hold = segurar; ocupar (hold the position = ocupar o cargo); realizar (hold a meeting).

cards.f: …some recent data suggests that as economic growth has picked up, so has consumption of oil and coal.
cards.sig: melhorou, ganhou força (pick up = retomar, acelerar)
cards.dica: Caiu na Transpetro 2018 (q16): picked up = improved. Iscas: declined, deteriorated, stabilized.
cards.nc: pick up também é pegar, buscar alguém; pick = escolher.

cards.f: …is another major driver of this transformation.
cards.sig: motor, fator que impulsiona
cards.dica: Caiu na Transpetro 2018 (q16): driven by = motivated by. drive = impulsionar (e dirigir).
cards.ex: Beijing has high ambitions for a much cleaner energy economy, driven not least by the levels of air pollution…
cards.nc: driving down the cost = derrubando o custo; driver também é motorista ou driver de dispositivo.

cards.f: Nuclear power has a lot going for it.
cards.sig: muitas vantagens (has a lot going for it); a lot = muito
cards.dica: Caiu na Eletronuclear 2022 (q19): has a lot going for it = presents many advantageous qualities.
cards.ex: …evaluating new business opportunities and making a lot of decisions.
cards.nc: a lot of = lots of = muitos; lot também é lote (parking lot = estacionamento).

cards.f: …continues thanks to the remarkable ability of producers to unlock new resources in a cost-effective way.
cards.sig: notável, extraordinário
cards.dica: Caiu na Eletronuclear 2022 (q21): remarkable = extraordinary (par de sinônimos correto).
cards.ex: …remarkable growth, perhaps, but still well short of what’s needed…
cards.nc: remark = comentário; remarkably = notavelmente.

cards.f: Solar is also thriving: according to the International Energy Agency…
cards.sig: prosperando, crescendo com força
cards.dica: Caiu na Transpetro 2018 (q18): thriving e developing são sinônimos (alternativa correta).
cards.nc: thrive = prosperar; strive = esforçar-se (strive to boost, BNDES 2024).

cards.f: …the surge in oil prices over the past two months is a temporary and unsustainable phenomenon.
cards.sig: disparada, alta forte e repentina
cards.dica: Caiu na Transpetro 2018 (q18): surge e increase NÃO são antônimos; têm sentido parecido.
cards.ex: The resurgence in oil and gas production from the United States…
cards.nc: resurgence = ressurgimento, retomada; plunge = despencar (o oposto).

cards.f: If energy efficiency gains continue, CO2 emissions will remain flat or even fall.
cards.sig: estável, sem variação
cards.dica: Caiu na Transpetro 2018 (q18): flat e high NÃO expressam ideias parecidas. Em gráfico, flat = linha horizontal, sem subir nem descer.
cards.nc: flat também é plano e, no Reino Unido, apartamento.

cards.f: …renewables are being deployed rapidly thanks to falling costs…
cards.sig: implantados, instalados (em grande escala)
cards.dica: Caiu na Petrobras 2017 (q14): deployed e disturbed NÃO são sinônimos. Em TI, deploy = implantar um sistema em produção.
cards.nc: deployment = implantação; employ = empregar.

cards.f: The US becomes the undisputed leader for oil and gas production for decades…
cards.sig: indiscutível, incontestável
cards.dica: Caiu na Petrobras 2017 (q14): undisputed = irrefutable. Padrão: un- nega a palavra (unnecessary, unreliable).
cards.nc: Na mesma questão: unlock (destravar) não é restrain (conter); incumbent (atual, estabelecido) não é unnecessary.

cards.f: The work can be applied to immediate, pressing situations,
cards.sig: urgente, premente
cards.dica: Caiu na Transpetro 2011 (q18): pressing e trivial são antônimos (resposta certa). A mesma frase caiu na q19: can be applied = may be applied.
cards.nc: press = pressionar, imprensa; pressure = pressão.

cards.f: To curb any negative effects, Brazil is trying to support domestic manufacturing…
cards.sig: conter, frear, limitar
cards.dica: Caiu na Petrobras 2011 (q14): curb e foster são antônimos (foster = estimular, promover).
cards.nc: curve (curva); cure (curar).

cards.f: …they offered me a position at the company’s headquarters in Houston…
cards.sig: sede (escritório central)
cards.dica: Caiu na Petrobras 2012 (q14): headquarters could be substituted by main office (alternativa correta). head (cabeça) + quarters (instalações).
cards.nc: quarter = trimestre ou um quarto; HQ = sigla de headquarters.

cards.f: …they surpassed coal for the first time ever in 2019…
cards.sig: superaram, ultrapassaram
cards.dica: Caiu na Eletronuclear 2022 (q21): surpassed e fell behind NÃO são sinônimos (fell behind = ficou para trás).
cards.nc: overtake = ultrapassar (China is set to overtake the U.S., Petrobras 2011); exceed = exceder.

cards.f: Computer program helps responders transport supplies in tough conditions
cards.sig: difícil, duro, complicado
cards.dica: Na Transpetro 2011 (q18), que pedia um par de antônimos, a dupla tough e complicated foi isca: as duas têm sentido parecido.
cards.ex: Woman 1: Tough one to describe a typical day.
cards.nc: though (embora), through (através de), thought (pensamento): parecem, mas não são.

cards.f: I worked with a lot of smart, focused and talented geoscientists and engineers.
cards.sig: inteligente
cards.dica: Caiu na Petrobras 2012 (q14): a alternativa que dizia que smart e intelligent são antônimos estava ERRADA; são sinônimos.
cards.ex: …will need a smart infrastructure to monitor and control the electricity network…
cards.nc: smart grid = rede elétrica inteligente; start (começar) só parece.

cards.f: …projects to enhance production…
cards.sig: melhorar, aumentar, aprimorar
cards.dica: Caiu na Petrobras 2012 (q14): enhance e reduce NÃO expressam ideias parecidas; são quase opostos.
cards.nc: enhanced safety = segurança reforçada. Sinônimos: improve, boost, increase.

cards.f: …could dramatically increase oil exports to nearly one million barrels per day to world markets.
cards.sig: exportações
cards.dica: ex- = para fora: o que sai do país. im- = para dentro: imports = importações.
cards.ex: The kingdom’s oil exports now mostly go to Asia…
cards.nc: imports (importações): After depending on oil imports… (Petrobras 2017).

cards.f: …the easiest economic sector to green, analysts say…
cards.sig: tornar verde, sustentável
cards.dica: Caiu na Eletronuclear 2022 (q16): to green = become less harmful or more sensitive to the environment.
cards.ex: …to help manage a consistent flow of green energy.
cards.nc: green job = emprego ligado ao meio ambiente (Petrobras 2012).

cards.f: …in the absence of large-scale carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS)…
cards.sig: armazenamento
cards.dica: store = guardar, estocar (e também loja). CCUS = captura, uso e armazenamento de carbono.
cards.ex: …necessary increase in investment in carbon capture, utilization and storage.
cards.nc: Em TI, storage = armazenamento de dados; stock = estoque ou ações.

cards.f: …when I get calls at night or on weekends from a rig or other geologists for assistance with a technical problem.
cards.sig: sonda, plataforma de perfuração
cards.dica: drilling rig = sonda de perfuração. idled rigs = sondas paradas.
cards.ex: …look for idled rigs heading to other shores.
cards.nc: platform = plataforma de produção; rig é o equipamento que perfura.

cards.f: The murumuru is a palm tree that grows in the Amazon forest.
cards.sig: floresta
cards.dica: rainforest = floresta tropical; deforestation = desmatamento.
cards.ex: …with 271.52 sq km of forest in the conservation area…
cards.nc: forecast (previsão) começa igual, mas não tem nada a ver.

cards.f: Instead of trying to repair damage done by deforestation after the fact…
cards.sig: dano, estrago; danificar
cards.dica: damage não leva s quando é dano em geral: environmental damage = danos ambientais. damaged hair = cabelo danificado.
cards.nc: damages (plural, no jurídico) = indenização; danger = perigo.

cards.f: Regenerative businesses go beyond sustainability and fight to do more good to society and the planet.
cards.sig: lutar, combater
cards.dica: fight climate change = combater a mudança climática. Sinônimos: tackle, combat.
cards.ex: …by 2035 to fight the climate crisis.
cards.nc: flight (voo); fit (caber, adequado).

cards.f: …joining a professional association to have free access to their events.
cards.sig: livre, gratuito (free access = acesso livre, sem custo)
cards.dica: No fim de uma palavra, -free = sem: carbon-free = sem carbono; tax-free = isento de imposto; risk-free = sem risco.
cards.ex: …goal of achieving a carbon-free electricity grid in the U.S. by 2035…
cards.nc: freedom = liberdade; for free = de graça.

cards.f: …new ways of operating that boost both sustainability and profitability.
cards.sig: impulsionar, aumentar
cards.dica: boost = dar um empurrão para cima (booster = reforço). Sinônimos: enhance, increase, foster.
cards.ex: …boost the consumption of fossil fuels such as natural gas.
cards.nc: boom = expansão rápida; boot = inicializar, bota.

cards.f: …might compensate for present OPEC production cuts and cause a decrease in oil prices.
cards.sig: cortes, reduções
cards.dica: cut, cut, cut: igual nos três tempos. cut emissions in half = cortar as emissões pela metade.
cards.ex: To cut U.S. carbon emissions in half by 2030…
cards.nc: cost = custo; cut off = cortar o fornecimento.

cards.f: Right now, the satellite supplier market is booming, driving down the cost of access to satellites.
cards.sig: em forte expansão
cards.dica: boom = estouro, crescimento explosivo. the boom years = os anos de ouro.
cards.ex: The boom years for coal are over…
cards.nc: boost = impulsionar; bust = quebra, colapso (booms and busts, Petrobras 2011).

cards.f: Satellite technology will increasingly be a part of the vehicles themselves…
cards.sig: cada vez mais
cards.dica: increasing (crescente) + -ly. Traduza por cada vez mais.
cards.ex: …the relationship between artists and bankers has grown increasingly transactional…
cards.nc: increase = aumentar; increasing = crescente.

cards.f: …has been growing dramatically because of the threat posed by climate change.
cards.sig: drasticamente, de forma acentuada
cards.dica: Em economia não tem a ver com drama: indica mudança grande. dramatic reductions = reduções enormes.
cards.ex: The last few years have seen dramatic reductions in costs and strong increase in supply.
cards.nc: slightly = levemente, o oposto em intensidade.

cards.f: But the pace of that shift is uncertain…
cards.sig: ritmo, velocidade
cards.dica: at a fast pace = em ritmo acelerado. apace = rapidamente.
cards.ex: Prospecting proceeds apace in the ultradeepwater reserves off the coasts of Ghana and Nigeria…
cards.nc: peace (paz) tem som parecido; space = espaço.

cards.f: …has been expanding faster than personal computing and mobile phones in the 1990s and 2000s.
cards.sig: na década de 1990 (nos anos 90)
cards.dica: O s no fim indica a década inteira: in the 1970s = nos anos 70. mid-2020s = meados dos anos 2020.
cards.ex: …hindering nuclear development in the 1980s and 90s…
cards.nc: in 1990 = só no ano de 1990.

cards.f: The oil industry could grow from about 10 per cent of GDP to up to 25 per cent…
cards.sig: até (no máximo)
cards.dica: up to 25% = até 25%. Em número, up to marca o limite de cima.
cards.nc: up to date = atualizado; it’s up to you = depende de você.

cards.f: …will pay immediate dividends in the challenging sector of geology and oil exploitation.
cards.sig: desafiador; (verbo) desafiando
cards.dica: challenge = desafio. Como verbo: challenging incumbent suppliers = desafiando os fornecedores já estabelecidos (Petrobras 2017).
cards.nc: changing (mudando) parece na escrita. hurdles = obstáculos (Eletronuclear 2022).

cards.f: …a major reorientation of global trade flows…
cards.sig: comércio (trade flows = fluxos comerciais)
cards.dica: trade = comércio entre países ou empresas; trader = negociante; trade-off = troca entre vantagens e desvantagens.
cards.ex: Social media managers must know the tools of their trade…
cards.nc: tools of their trade = ferramentas do ofício (trade também é profissão).

cards.f: …grow addicted to the money that flows from them.
cards.sig: flui; fluxo
cards.dica: cash flow = fluxo de caixa; trade flows = fluxos comerciais.
cards.ex: …it is some of the first commercial oil to flow from the country’s giant new deepwater discoveries.
cards.nc: flaw = falha, defeito.

cards.f: …can build projects on budget and on schedule.
cards.sig: orçamento (on budget = dentro do orçamento)
cards.dica: on budget = no custo previsto; over budget = acima do orçamento.
cards.ex: …are now billions of dollars over budget…
cards.nc: on schedule = no prazo, o par de on budget.

cards.f: …and years behind schedule.
cards.sig: cronograma, agenda (behind schedule = atrasado)
cards.dica: on schedule = no prazo; ahead of schedule = adiantado; behind schedule = atrasado.
cards.ex: …complains against her very boring schedule at the office…
cards.nc: budget = orçamento; deadline = prazo final.

cards.f: Even worse, Brazil could suffer a more severe form of the disease, the “oil curse”…
cards.sig: doença (Dutch disease = doença holandesa)
cards.dica: Termo de economia: a riqueza do petróleo ou gás valoriza a moeda e enfraquece a indústria. O texto cita a Holanda nos anos 1970.
cards.ex: …Dutch disease and the oil curse will take hold.
cards.nc: Dutch = holandês (alemão = German); oil curse = maldição do petróleo.

cards.f: …if we have a firm and successful local content policy…
cards.sig: conteúdo (local content = conteúdo local)
cards.dica: Política de conteúdo local: parte dos bens e serviços do petróleo deve ser comprada no país.
cards.ex: …by increasing “local content” requirements in the oil industry.
cards.nc: content (adjetivo) = satisfeito, contente; contents = sumário.

cards.f: Exports of these commodities are already driving up the exchange rate…
cards.sig: commodities, matérias-primas (petróleo, minério, grãos)
cards.dica: commodity = produto básico com preço global (no texto: minério de ferro, carne, açúcar, café). Também mercadoria: art became a consumer commodity (Banese 2025).
cards.ex: …only Text II reports on China’s intensive economic growth and absolute need of commodities.
cards.nc: commodity não é comodidade (comfort, convenience).

cards.f: …which now accounts for 60 per cent of total solar cell manufacturing capacity.
cards.sig: fabricação, indústria (manufacturing sector = indústria de transformação)
cards.dica: manufacture = fabricar; manufacturer = fabricante.
cards.ex: …the strengthening of the manufacturing sector.
cards.nc: manual = manual; handmade = feito à mão.

cards.f: Aftermarket sales supported the on-highway, construction, industrial, agricultural and the oil and gas markets.
cards.sig: vendas
cards.dica: sale = venda; for sale = à venda; on sale = em promoção. sell, sold, sold = vender.
cards.nc: salary = salário.

cards.f: Woman 2: I talk with clients, help prepare bids and work on getting projects out the door.
cards.sig: propostas, lances (bid round = rodada de licitação)
cards.dica: bid = oferta em leilão ou licitação; bidder = licitante.
cards.nc: auction = leilão, o evento; bid = o lance dado nele.

cards.f: Brazil has also pioneered the use of auctions for long-term contracts for renewable energy…
cards.sig: leilões
cards.dica: O Brasil usa leilões para contratar energia e áreas de petróleo.
cards.nc: auction não é ação (action) nem ações de empresa (shares).

cards.f: It undergirds and affects all that you think, see, believe, say, and do.
cards.sig: afeta, influencia
cards.dica: affect = verbo (afetar); effect = substantivo (efeito). Macete: Affect é Ação.
cards.nc: effect = efeito; affection = afeto.

cards.f: “Brazil’s experience shows that policies do matter,”
cards.sig: importar, ter importância (do matter = importam, sim)
cards.dica: O do antes do verbo dá ênfase. Como substantivo, matter = assunto, questão.
cards.ex: …speculate on matters that may affect the global energy market in 2018.
cards.nc: no matter = não importa; as a matter of fact = na verdade.

cards.f: …suggest that Brazil could soon be ranked as one of the four main oil producers in the whole world.
cards.sig: sugerir; indicar, dar a entender
cards.dica: No enunciado, the text suggests that = inferência: a ideia não está escrita com essas palavras, mas decorre do texto.
cards.nc: infer = deduzir (one can infer that, Transpetro 2023); imply = implicar.

cards.f: However, others are already delivering practical results.
cards.sig: entregando, gerando (resultados)
cards.dica: deliver results = entregar resultados. Nessa frase caiu (Transpetro 2023, q12): However = ideia de opposition.
cards.ex: …copes with chaos to deliver relief
cards.nc: delivery = entrega; supply = fornecer.

cards.f: …leading expertise in conventional energy and experience in managing renewable resources.
cards.sig: administrar, gerir
cards.dica: manage to + verbo = conseguir fazer (com esforço): has managed to deliver = conseguiu entregar.
cards.ex: For the last three years the country has managed to deliver economic growth…
cards.nc: management = gestão; manager = gerente.

cards.f: …but better project management is another.
cards.sig: gestão, gerenciamento (project management = gestão de projetos)
cards.dica: manage + -ment = substantivo. Mesmo padrão: development, investment, improvement.
cards.ex: …for operational management purposes…
cards.nc: manager = gerente; management também é a direção da empresa.

cards.f: …challenging incumbent suppliers…
cards.sig: fornecedores
cards.dica: supply (fornecer, oferta) + -er = quem fornece. incumbent suppliers = fornecedores já estabelecidos.
cards.nc: supplies = suprimentos; demand = demanda (o par de supply).

cards.f: Both depend on access to satellite networks…
cards.sig: dependem de
cards.dica: A preposição muda: em português depender DE, em inglês depend ON.
cards.ex: …finding efficacious transportation solutions depends exclusively on political decisions.
cards.nc: dependable = confiável.

cards.f: …constitutes a real threat to national security.
cards.sig: ameaça
cards.dica: threaten = ameaçar. Em Segurança da Informação, threat = ameaça.
cards.ex: The threat to stability is all the greater…
cards.nc: treat = tratar (sem h); thread = fio, linha de execução.

cards.f: …found a faster and more reliable means of preventing epidemics and breaches of security.
cards.sig: confiável
cards.dica: rely on (confiar em) + -able = em que se pode confiar.
cards.ex: …to deliver highly reliable connectivity where 4G struggles to reach.
cards.nc: unreliable = não confiável; reliability = confiabilidade.

cards.f: …announce a study to identify an effective strategy to distribute goods and services in emergencies.
cards.sig: eficaz (que funciona, dá resultado)
cards.dica: Essa foi a alternativa correta da Transpetro 2011 (q11). cost-effective = com bom custo-benefício.
cards.ex: …to unlock new resources in a cost-effective way.
cards.nc: efficient = eficiente (sem desperdício); effectively = de fato, com eficácia.

cards.f: …their construction faces constant delays that increase costs.
cards.sig: enfrenta
cards.dica: face = rosto, mas to face = enfrentar. faced with = diante de. Essa foi a alternativa correta da Eletronuclear 2022 (q23).
cards.ex: Yet an expansion of nuclear power faces some serious hurdles…
cards.nc: phase (fase) tem som parecido; hurdles = obstáculos.

cards.f: …carried out by the actions of several well-known companies in South America and in Asia.
cards.sig: vários
cards.dica: several = vários. Não é severo.
cards.nc: severe = severo, grave (severe impacts of climate change, Petrobras 2017).

cards.f: (To be fair, several of China’s recent large-scale reactors have also had cost overruns and delays.)
cards.sig: justo (to be fair = para ser justo); fair = feira
cards.dica: Caiu na Eletronuclear 2022 (q24): o autor usa To be fair para clarify (fazer uma ressalva). job fair = feira de empregos.
cards.ex: Woman 2: I was recruited at a Texas Tech Engineering Job Fair.
cards.nc: fare = tarifa de transporte; fairly = razoavelmente.

cards.f: What if you have the mindset to get the work accomplished, but currently lack certain skills requested by the employer?
cards.sig: não ter, carecer de; (subst.) falta
cards.dica: lack of = falta de; lacking = sem, faltando.
cards.ex: …express lack of necessity.
cards.nc: luck = sorte; lake = lago.

cards.f: A comparable increase in 2018 would offset most of the current OPEC production cuts…
cards.sig: atual
cards.dica: current = atual, de agora. Mesma raiz de currently (atualmente).
cards.ex: …explain the reasons why unemployment is so high in the current global economic crisis.
cards.nc: current account = conta corrente; currency = moeda.

cards.f: A few figures from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) illustrate the challenge.
cards.sig: números, dados
cards.dica: Em texto de economia, figures = números. figure out = descobrir, calcular, entender.
cards.ex: …figure out the costs of space technology.
cards.nc: figure também é figura, personalidade.

cards.f: But its land runs through two municipalities, Altamira and São Félix do Xingu, with some of the highest rates of deforestation in the country.
cards.sig: taxas, índices
cards.dica: unemployment rate = taxa de desemprego; interest rate = taxa de juros.
cards.nc: ratio = razão, proporção; rating = classificação, nota.

cards.f: …art will remain a point of interest for bankers.
cards.sig: interesse; em finanças, juros
cards.dica: interest rate = taxa de juros. Em texto de banco, interest pode ser juros.
cards.ex: …they actually have an interest in what we’re doing…
cards.nc: interesting = interessante; interested = interessado.

cards.f: “We needed a new tool that could get ahead of the devastation.”
cards.sig: à frente, adiante (get ahead of = antecipar-se a)
cards.dica: Caiu na Petrobras 2017 (q15): forging ahead = progressing steadily (avançando com firmeza).
cards.ex: “Solar is forging ahead in global power markets…
cards.nc: ahead of schedule = adiantado; behind = atrás.

cards.f: “You don’t know where demand is, so it’s tricky,”
cards.sig: complicado, delicado, cheio de armadilhas
cards.dica: trick = truque. Nessa frase caiu (Transpetro 2011, q16): so introduz conclusão.
cards.nc: Na Transpetro 2023 (q18), tricky foi isca para pivotal (= essential).

cards.f: Human ecosystems, too, stand to benefit.
cards.sig: beneficiar-se; benefício
cards.dica: stand to benefit = tendem a se beneficiar; benefit from = beneficiar-se de.
cards.ex: The agreement will allow the IEA to benefit from Brazil’s unique experience…
cards.nc: profit = lucro; beneficial = benéfico.

cards.f: …delivering products in emergency situations requires analyzing many factors besides cost and time.
cards.sig: exige, requer
cards.dica: Essa foi a alternativa correta da Transpetro 2011 (q13). requirement = requisito.
cards.ex: The plan requires electricity generation…
cards.nc: request = pedir, solicitar; acquire = adquirir.

cards.f: This insight will help trains run more efficiently with fewer delays for passengers.
cards.sig: menos (com coisas que se contam)
cards.dica: fewer + plural (fewer delays); less + incontável (less energy).
cards.ex: Although far fewer women work in the oil and gas (O&G) industry compared to men…
cards.nc: few = poucos; a few = alguns.

cards.f: …has invested $700m in the expansion of its research centre.
cards.sig: pesquisa
cards.dica: R&D = research and development = P&D.
cards.ex: The research, presented February 18 at the annual meeting…
cards.nc: search = busca; researcher = pesquisador.

cards.f: EO data will be critical in future forecasting models for wind and solar production…
cards.sig: essencial, decisivo
cards.dica: Em texto técnico, critical = crucial, essencial, não algo que critica.
cards.ex: Satellite technology is a critical part of revolutionizing connectivity on trains.
cards.nc: critic = crítico (pessoa); criticism = crítica.

cards.f: Satellite data and communications will also play a fundamental role in shaping a sustainable future for road vehicles.
cards.sig: papel, função (play a role = desempenhar um papel)
cards.dica: role model = exemplo a seguir.
cards.ex: …report on the increasing role of renewable energy sources and natural gas.
cards.nc: roll = rolar: roll up your sleeves = arregaçar as mangas.

cards.f: …they wanted to find a way to prevent it from happening at all.
cards.sig: impedir, evitar (que aconteça)
cards.dica: prevent something from happening. Caiu na BASA 2024 (q7): o it dessa frase se refere a deforestation.
cards.nc: avoid = evitar, desviar de; protect = proteger.

cards.f: Ultimately, Brazil’s ability to avoid Dutch disease will depend not just on how the money from the oil is spent.
cards.sig: evitar
cards.dica: avoid + -ing: avoid postponing = evitar adiar.
cards.nc: prevent = impedir que aconteça; void = vazio, nulo.

cards.f: …a market where speculation is rife.
cards.sig: generalizado, abundante (is rife = há muito)
cards.dica: Caiu na Transpetro 2018 (q18): rife e scarce NÃO expressam ideias parecidas (scarce = escasso).
cards.nc: ripe = maduro.

cards.f: …we are taking another important step to place Brazil at the centre of global debate…
cards.sig: passo, etapa, medida
cards.dica: take a step = tomar uma medida; step by step = passo a passo.
cards.ex: …satcoms will step in to deliver highly reliable connectivity where 4G struggles to reach.
cards.nc: step in = intervir, entrar em ação; stop = parar.

cards.f: “We’ve innovated so little in the past half-century, there’s a lot of ground to gain,”
cards.sig: ganhar, conquistar; (subst.) ganho
cards.dica: efficiency gains = ganhos de eficiência; gain ground = ganhar terreno, avançar.
cards.nc: win = vencer; earn = ganhar dinheiro trabalhando.

cards.f: Nuclear proponents are now banking on next-generation designs…
cards.sig: apostando em, contando com
cards.dica: bank on = confiar que algo vai dar certo. banking sozinho = setor bancário.
cards.ex: …the intersection between the banking sector and the art world since the Middle Ages.
cards.nc: proponents = defensores (na Eletronuclear 2022, q21, proponents e critics não eram sinônimos).

cards.f: Meiji Yasuda is investing in new partnerships and technologies to promote preventive healthcare in Japan.
cards.sig: parcerias
cards.dica: partner (parceiro, sócio) + -ship (relação). Mesmo padrão: relationship, leadership.
cards.ex: Imazon is now establishing partnerships with authorities across the region…
cards.nc: business partner = sócio.

cards.f: …with which to pursue the goal of becoming a US of the south.
cards.sig: meta, objetivo
cards.dica: Sinônimos: aim, target, objective. goal também é gol.
cards.ex: Efficient supply chains have long been a goal of manufacturers…
cards.nc: gold = ouro.

cards.f: …the IEA can support Brazil’s efforts and collaborate in its energy transition.
cards.sig: esforços
cards.dica: effort = esforço; joint effort = esforço conjunto.
cards.ex: …stay closely involved in the projects and the sales efforts.
cards.nc: effect = efeito; afford = ter dinheiro para.

cards.f: What are the issues that will shape the global energy market in 2018?
cards.sig: moldar, definir; forma
cards.dica: shape = forma; to shape = dar forma, influenciar. reshaping = remodelando.
cards.ex: …discuss how China’s economic and energy policy changes may shape global trends.
cards.nc: sharp = acentuado, afiado; share = parcela, ação.

cards.f: Every reader will have their own view on each of the four questions.
cards.sig: opinião, visão (point of view = ponto de vista)
cards.dica: overview = visão geral (present an overview = apresentar um panorama).
cards.ex: …have identical points of view and experiences…
cards.nc: review = revisão; preview = prévia.

cards.f: …may justify Petrobras’ plans to reduce the development of its research center.
cards.sig: justificar
cards.dica: Verbo comum nas alternativas: justify = dar razão, defender uma decisão.
cards.ex: …developed mathematical tools to justify individual animal routines.
cards.nc: adjust = ajustar; judge = julgar.

cards.f: It will underpin a growing network of EV charging points…
cards.sig: rede
cards.dica: network = rede (de computadores, de pontos, de pessoas). networking = fazer contatos profissionais.
cards.nc: grid = rede elétrica; net = rede, líquido.

cards.f: The conventional wisdom fails (at best).
cards.sig: falha, não funciona
cards.dica: fail to + verbo = não conseguir: if it fails to manage = se não conseguir administrar (Petrobras 2011).
cards.ex: …if it fails to manage this windfall wisely…
cards.nc: failure = fracasso, falha; fall = cair.

cards.f: …to treat the result as a licence to reassert its influence in the region.
cards.sig: tratar, considerar (treat X as Y = tratar X como Y)
cards.dica: treatment = tratamento.
cards.ex: …most bankers also treat art both as a financial investment and interior decoration…
cards.nc: threat = ameaça (com h); treaty = tratado.

cards.f: How can job seekers show they have the mindset employers are seeking…
cards.sig: buscar, procurar (seeker = quem procura)
cards.dica: seek, sought, sought. job seekers = candidatos a emprego. Sinônimo: look for.
cards.ex: …regenerative firms seek to boost the health and vitality of people, places and the planet simultaneously
cards.nc: sick = doente.

cards.f: …unemployment rates are high because workers are looking for higher salaries.
cards.sig: procurando (look for = procurar)
cards.dica: look muda com a preposição: look for = procurar; look at = olhar para; look forward to = aguardar com expectativa.
cards.nc: look like = parecer (It looks and smells like ordinary crude oil, Petrobras 2011).

cards.f: Five women were asked the same questions regarding their career choices in the oil and gas industry.
cards.sig: escolhas
cards.dica: choose, chose, chosen = escolher. I chose = eu escolhi.
cards.nc: regarding = a respeito de (está na mesma frase).

cards.f: According to Text I, when asked about their choice of the oil and gas industry,
cards.sig: perguntados (ask = perguntar ou pedir)
cards.dica: ask a question = fazer uma pergunta; ask for help = pedir ajuda.
cards.ex: …they asked themselves: is it possible to generate short-term deforestation prediction models?
cards.nc: answer = responder.

cards.f: Brazil joins IEA as an Association country, reshaping international energy governance
cards.sig: entra para, junta-se a
cards.dica: join a company = entrar numa empresa. joint = conjunto (joint effort); jointly = em conjunto.
cards.ex: As more wind and solar installations join the electricity network…
cards.nc: joint venture = empresa formada por duas ou mais empresas.

cards.f: Given the climate urgency, it is time that businesses think and act beyond sustainability.
cards.sig: além de, para além de
cards.dica: go beyond = ir além, superar.
cards.ex: Beyond our team, I also participate in a number of broader business initiatives…
cards.nc: behind = atrás; below = abaixo; besides = além disso (adição).

cards.f: …accept jobs with severe routines only in order to obtain early promotions.
cards.sig: cedo; inicial, precoce (early promotions = promoções antecipadas)
cards.dica: too early = cedo demais; early 2000s = início dos anos 2000.
cards.ex: WEO-2017 finds it is too early to write the obituary of oil.
cards.nc: earlier = antes; yearly = anual.

cards.f: …the US will soon surpass China in energy consumption.
cards.sig: em breve, logo
cards.dica: as soon as = assim que; sooner or later = mais cedo ou mais tarde.
cards.nc: son = filho (som parecido).

cards.f: Brazil’s leading expertise in bioenergy, hydro and other forms of clean and conventional energy…
cards.sig: principal, líder, de ponta
cards.dica: lead (liderar, levar) + -ing. leading source = principal fonte. Também: leading to = levando a.
cards.ex: …is surely leading Brazilian engineers to work for African countries rich in natural resources.
cards.nc: lead também é chumbo; leader = líder.

cards.f: …to replicate the use of auctions for renewable energies worldwide.
cards.sig: no mundo todo, mundial
cards.dica: world + wide (amplo). Sinônimos: globally, around the world, across the globe.
cards.ex: …set an example to countries around the world.
cards.nc: world-class = de nível mundial; widespread = disseminado.

cards.f: …a biofuels programme that has helped keep domestic oil-demand growth under control.
cards.sig: manter; continuar (keep + -ing = continuar fazendo)
cards.dica: keep, kept, kept. keep under control = manter sob controle.
cards.ex: …as growth for trucks, petrochemicals, shipping and aviation keep pushing demand higher.
cards.nc: keep up with = acompanhar o ritmo.

cards.f: …you will need to roll up your sleeves and work hard for the first couple years…
cards.sig: muito, com afinco (work hard); difícil, duro
cards.dica: hard times = tempos difíceis. roll up your sleeves = arregaçar as mangas.
cards.ex: …because of the hard economic times.
cards.nc: hardly = quase não (falso amigo): hardly any = quase nenhum.

cards.f: The coming year will show us whether it is ready for that challenge.
cards.sig: próximo, que está por vir
cards.dica: in the coming decades = nas próximas décadas; upcoming = próximo, que vai acontecer.
cards.ex: …in the coming decades, analysts say.
cards.nc: income = renda.

cards.f: At the office, I am involved in the daily business operations…
cards.sig: diário, diariamente
cards.dica: day + -ly. weekly = semanal; monthly = mensal; yearly = anual.
cards.nc: on a daily basis = diariamente (foi isca na BNDES 2024, q33); dairy = laticínio.

cards.f: …both texts present ways of starting successful careers in the O&G industry.
cards.sig: bem-sucedido
cards.dica: success (sucesso) + -ful (cheio de). succeed = ter sucesso. O&G = oil and gas.
cards.nc: successive = sucessivo, seguido.

cards.f: Understanding what has happened can help make predictions more precise.
cards.sig: aconteceu (happen = acontecer)
cards.dica: happen = occur = take place.
cards.ex: As it happens, we can obtain a highly moisturizing butter from the seeds of this palm tree…
cards.nc: as it happens = por acaso, aliás; happy = feliz.

cards.f: Regenerative businesses also strive to boost the health and vitality of individuals and communities…
cards.sig: saúde
cards.dica: healthy = saudável; healthcare = assistência à saúde.
cards.nc: wealth = riqueza.

cards.f: Could AI save the Amazon rainforest?
cards.sig: salvar; economizar; guardar
cards.dica: save money or energy = economizar. AI = IA (inteligência artificial).
cards.ex: …save the pretentious language for your English papers.
cards.nc: safe = seguro; savings = poupança.

cards.f: In 2020, faced with the spread of Covid-19, people’s interest in illiquid art investments has diminished…
cards.sig: propagação, disseminação; espalhar
cards.dica: spread, spread, spread: igual nos três tempos. widespread = disseminado.
cards.ex: …should spread their influence over the other Gulf States.
cards.nc: speed = velocidade; spend = gastar.

cards.f: The problem is that the industry remains fragmented.
cards.sig: continua, permanece
cards.dica: remain + adjetivo = continuar: remain flat = continuar estável.
cards.nc: remains (subst.) = restos; remind = lembrar.

cards.f: Companies are running lean and mean in this economy…
cards.sig: operando, funcionando, administrando
cards.dica: run = correr, mas também funcionar (trains run = trens circulam) e administrar (run a business).
cards.ex: This insight will help trains run more efficiently…
cards.nc: run out of = ficar sem.

cards.f: …they don’t have the time to train for those key skills.
cards.sig: treinar (train também é trem)
cards.dica: Polissemia: to train = treinar; a train = um trem (connectivity on trains, Transpetro 2023). training = treinamento.
cards.nc: trainee = quem é treinado (-ee recebe a ação).

cards.f: They published their findings in the journal Spatial Statistics in August 2017.
cards.sig: resultados, conclusões (de pesquisa)
cards.dica: find (achar) → findings = o que a pesquisa encontrou. The IEA finds that = a IEA conclui que.
cards.nc: funding = financiamento.

cards.f: …that use a holistic approach to regenerate people, places and the biodiversity altogether.
cards.sig: abordagem, maneira de lidar
cards.dica: approach também é verbo: aproximar-se (Wind is approaching grid parity = está chegando perto).
cards.ex: …requires a different approach, said Anna Nagurney…
cards.nc: approval = aprovação.

cards.f: Researchers used to comb through thousands of satellite images…
cards.sig: milhares
cards.dica: thousand = mil; tens of thousands = dezenas de milhares.
cards.ex: …asked tens of thousands of top employers worldwide this question
cards.nc: hundred = cem; million = milhão.

cards.f: …the art world’s centre of gravity suddenly shifted straight across the Atlantic…
cards.sig: centro (grafia britânica de center)
cards.dica: Britânico x americano: centre/center, programme/program, licence/license, organisation/organization. O sentido é o mesmo.
cards.ex: …implemented a rewarding biofuels programme that helped reduce national oil-demand growth.
cards.nc: Não muda o sentido, só a grafia.

cards.f: The danger for Brazil…is of falling victim to “Dutch disease”.
cards.sig: perigo
cards.dica: dangerous = perigoso; endangered = ameaçado de extinção (BASA 2024).
cards.nc: threat = ameaça; risk = risco.

cards.f: If the U.S. offshore-drilling moratorium drags on…
cards.sig: se arrasta, se prolonga
cards.dica: drag = arrastar. drag on = durar mais do que o esperado.
cards.nc: moratorium = suspensão temporária.

cards.f: …many women find rewarding careers in the industry.
cards.sig: gratificante, recompensador
cards.dica: reward = recompensa; you will be rewarded = você será recompensado.
cards.nc: award = prêmio; regarding = a respeito de.

cards.f: How to start your career, step by step
cards.sig: carreira
cards.dica: career experts = especialistas em carreira.
cards.ex: There’s a debate going on among career experts about which is more important: skillset or mindset.
cards.nc: carrier = transportadora, operadora (som parecido).

cards.f: I received a summer internship with Texaco before my last year of my Master’s degree.
cards.sig: mestrado
cards.dica: Bachelor’s = graduação; Master’s = mestrado; PhD = doutorado. internship = estágio.
cards.nc: master também é dominar (master a skill) e mestre.

cards.f: …praise China’s capacity of building large-scale nuclear reactors fast and effectively.
cards.sig: construir (building = construindo; também prédio)
cards.dica: build, built, built. a building = um prédio. praise = elogiar.
cards.ex: …some are built to collect subsidies.
cards.nc: built = construído.

cards.f: “In the West, the nuclear industry has substantially lost its ability to build large plants,”
cards.sig: perdeu, perdido
cards.dica: lose, lost, lost = perder. loss = perda, prejuízo.
cards.nc: loose = solto, frouxo.

cards.f: …nuclear power is cheaper in Asia just because of better project management.
cards.sig: melhor
cards.dica: good, better, best = bom, melhor, o melhor. far better = muito melhor.
cards.nc: worse = pior; best = o melhor.

cards.f: The One Asset You Really Need to Win and Keep the Job You Love
cards.sig: conquistar, ganhar
cards.dica: win, won, won. win a job = conseguir um emprego.
cards.nc: earn = ganhar dinheiro; gain = obter, aumentar.

cards.f: …with the aim of stopping deforestation before it starts.
cards.sig: começa
cards.dica: start = begin. startup = empresa iniciante; starting salary = salário inicial.
cards.nc: stop = parar.

cards.f: From humble beginnings with the acquisition of the first few paintings…
cards.sig: começos, inícios
cards.dica: begin, began, begun. at the beginning of = no início de.
cards.ex: At the beginning of the process, seekers can showcase the skills they have…
cards.nc: beginner = iniciante.

cards.f: Sustainable brands strive to just do less harm to the planet.
cards.sig: marcas
cards.dica: brand = marca de produto; branding = gestão de marca.
cards.nc: brand new = novinho em folha.

cards.f: The Amazon’s indigenous peoples chop this palm tree down…
cards.sig: indígenas, nativos
cards.dica: indigenous peoples = povos indígenas.
cards.nc: indigent = indigente, pobre.

cards.f: …the conservation area is rich in biodiversity often found nowhere else in the world.
cards.sig: rico
cards.dica: rich in = rico em: rich in natural resources.
cards.ex: …a nation already rich in renewable energy…
cards.nc: reach = alcançar.

cards.f: …the earth’s hoard of conventional oil is waning even faster.
cards.sig: da Terra (do planeta)
cards.dica: Earth = planeta. waning = diminuindo. low earth orbit (LEO) = órbita baixa.
cards.ex: …medium earth orbit (MEO) and low earth orbit (LEO) satellites…
cards.nc: land = terra firme, terreno; ground = chão.

cards.f: Woman 1: Cool technology, applying science and money.
cards.sig: dinheiro
cards.dica: money é incontável: much money (não many).
cards.ex: …how the money from the oil is spent.
cards.nc: cash = dinheiro vivo; currency = moeda.

cards.f: “At some level Brazil doesn’t just want to be exporting natural resources…
cards.sig: querer
cards.dica: want to + verbo = querer fazer. doesn’t just want = não quer apenas.
cards.ex: …and want to be a part of it.
cards.nc: need = precisar; wish = desejar.

cards.f: We have a strong track record of translating these advances into practical benefits for our customers…
cards.sig: forte
cards.dica: strength = força; strengthen = fortalecer. track record = histórico comprovado.
cards.ex: …dramatic reductions in costs and strong increase in supply.
cards.nc: weak = fraco, o oposto.

cards.f: Most renewable companies are small and local…
cards.sig: pequenas
cards.dica: small and medium-sized companies = pequenas e médias empresas.
cards.ex: …in some 10,000 generators, large and small, around the country.
cards.nc: smell = cheirar.

cards.f: …moving away from heavy industry fuelled largely by coal…
cards.sig: pesada (heavy industry = indústria pesada)
cards.dica: heavy oil = óleo pesado; heavily = fortemente.
cards.nc: light = leve, o oposto.

cards.f: …often in remote locations…
cards.sig: locais, lugares
cards.dica: location = lugar, localização. Não é locação: aluguel = rent, lease.
cards.ex: …she was attracted by the location of the job.
cards.nc: rent ou lease = aluguel.

cards.f: …but Deutsche Bank prefers to feature young, promising artists.
cards.sig: promissores
cards.dica: promise (promessa) + -ing = que promete.
cards.ex: …introduce a promising theory to address climate change concerns…
cards.nc: address = tratar de, abordar (nessa frase).

cards.f: Already, satellites provide regular software updates to vehicles…
cards.sig: atualizações
cards.dica: update = atualizar; up-to-date = atualizado.
cards.nc: upgrade = melhoria, nova versão.

cards.f: It became one of the first few commercial art collections, as we know them today.
cards.sig: um dos, uma das (+ plural)
cards.dica: one of the + plural: one of the cleanest energy mixes = uma das matrizes mais limpas.
cards.ex: …to develop one of the cleanest energy mixes in the world.
cards.nc: the only one = o único.

cards.f: In light of this tectonic shift…
cards.sig: em vista de, considerando
cards.dica: in light of = à luz de. tectonic shift aqui = mudança profunda.
cards.nc: light = luz e leve.

cards.f: …plan their careers in advance.
cards.sig: com antecedência
cards.dica: advance = avanço; advances in China = avanços na China (Transpetro 2018).
cards.ex: …translating these advances into practical benefits…
cards.nc: advanced = avançado.

cards.f: upstream
cards.sig: exploração e produção (E&P): achar e extrair petróleo e gás
cards.dica: Pense num rio: up = rio acima, a nascente. Upstream é o começo da cadeia, o poço.
cards.ex: Most of the company’s investment goes to upstream projects in deep water.
cards.nc: downstream (refino e venda); midstream (transporte e armazenagem).

cards.f: downstream
cards.sig: refino, distribuição e venda de derivados
cards.dica: down = rio abaixo, perto do consumidor: refinarias, distribuidoras e postos.
cards.ex: Refineries and fuel stations are part of the downstream sector.
cards.nc: upstream (exploração e produção); download não tem nada a ver.

cards.f: pipeline
cards.sig: duto (oleoduto, gasoduto)
cards.dica: pipe (cano) + line (linha). oil pipeline = oleoduto; gas pipeline = gasoduto.
cards.ex: The new pipeline will carry natural gas from the coast to the refinery.
cards.nc: Em negócios, pipeline também é a fila de projetos ou vendas; em TI, sequência automatizada de etapas.

cards.f: refinery
cards.sig: refinaria
cards.dica: refine (refinar) + -ery (lugar). refining = refino; refined products = derivados.
cards.ex: The refinery turns crude oil into diesel and gasoline.
cards.nc: refinement = aperfeiçoamento.

cards.f: reserves
cards.sig: reservas (de petróleo ou gás)
cards.dica: proven reserves = reservas provadas. Já apareceu na Petrobras 2011 (billion barrels of proven reserves).
cards.ex: Brazil’s oil reserves grew after the pre-salt discoveries.
cards.nc: reservation = reserva de hotel; resources = recursos.

cards.f: tanker
cards.sig: navio-tanque, petroleiro
cards.dica: tank (tanque) + -er. oil tanker = petroleiro. A Transpetro opera navios, dutos e terminais.
cards.ex: The tanker carried two million barrels of crude oil to Asia.
cards.nc: tank truck = caminhão-tanque.

cards.f: oil spill
cards.sig: derramamento de óleo
cards.dica: spill = derramar. Tema clássico de meio ambiente; já apareceu na Petrobras 2011 (oil spill disaster in the Gulf of Mexico).
cards.ex: The oil spill damaged beaches along the coast.
cards.nc: leak = vazamento por furo ou falha; spell = soletrar.

cards.f: exploration
cards.sig: exploração (busca de novas jazidas)
cards.dica: Em petróleo, exploration é PROCURAR petróleo (sísmica, poços pioneiros). E&P = exploration and production. Já apareceu na Petrobras 2011 (explorations of offshore oil deposits).
cards.ex: Exploration in new offshore areas requires huge investments.
cards.nc: exploitation = aproveitamento econômico de um recurso ou exploração abusiva de alguém.

cards.f: carbon capture
cards.sig: captura de carbono
cards.dica: Capturar o CO2 de chaminés ou do ar e guardá-lo no subsolo. CCUS = captura, uso e armazenamento; já apareceu na Petrobras 2017.
cards.ex: Carbon capture can reduce emissions from refineries.
cards.nc: carbon tax = imposto sobre carbono; carbon credit = crédito de carbono.

cards.f: net zero
cards.sig: emissões líquidas zero
cards.dica: net = líquido (saldo). O que se emite é compensado pelo que se retira. Já apareceu na Eletronuclear 2022 (net-zero carbon economy by 2050).
cards.ex: Many companies have promised to reach net zero by 2050.
cards.nc: zero emissions = nada emitido; carbon neutral = neutro em carbono.

cards.f: low-carbon
cards.sig: de baixo carbono (que emite pouco CO2)
cards.dica: low-carbon fuels = combustíveis de baixo carbono (já apareceu na Petrobras 2017).
cards.ex: The company is investing in low-carbon technologies.
cards.nc: carbon-free = sem carbono; high-carbon = muito emissor.

cards.f: hydrogen
cards.sig: hidrogênio (green hydrogen = hidrogênio verde)
cards.dica: Green hydrogen: produzido com eletricidade renovável, quebrando a água. Blue hydrogen: feito de gás natural com captura de carbono.
cards.ex: Green hydrogen could power heavy trucks and ships.
cards.nc: hydro = hidrelétrica; hydrocarbon = hidrocarboneto.

cards.f: biofuels
cards.sig: biocombustíveis (etanol, biodiesel)
cards.dica: bio (vida, orgânico) + fuels. O Brasil é referência; já apareceu na Petrobras 2017 (biofuels programme).
cards.ex: Brazil blends biofuels such as ethanol into its gasoline.
cards.nc: fossil fuels = combustíveis fósseis.

cards.f: waste
cards.sig: resíduo, lixo; desperdício
cards.dica: radioactive waste = lixo radioativo (já apareceu na Eletronuclear 2022). waste of time = perda de tempo.
cards.ex: The plant turns organic waste into biogas.
cards.nc: waist = cintura (mesma pronúncia); wastewater = águas residuais, esgoto.

cards.f: phase out
cards.sig: eliminar aos poucos
cards.dica: phase = fase. phase out coal = abandonar o carvão gradualmente. O oposto é phase in (introduzir aos poucos).
cards.ex: The country plans to phase out coal plants by 2030.
cards.nc: face = enfrentar (som parecido).

cards.f: target
cards.sig: meta, alvo
cards.dica: emissions target = meta de emissões; on target = dentro da meta. Sinônimos: goal, aim.
cards.ex: The government set a target to cut emissions by half.
cards.nc: targeted = direcionado.

cards.f: shortage
cards.sig: escassez, falta
cards.dica: short (curto) + -age. a shortage of skilled workers = falta de mão de obra qualificada.
cards.ex: A shortage of diesel pushed prices up.
cards.nc: surplus = excedente (o oposto); shortcut = atalho.

cards.f: affordable
cards.sig: acessível, de preço razoável
cards.dica: afford = ter dinheiro para. affordable energy = energia a preço acessível.
cards.ex: Solar power is becoming more affordable every year.
cards.nc: accessible = acessível fisicamente, sem barreiras.

cards.f: cybersecurity
cards.sig: segurança cibernética
cards.dica: cyber = digital, da internet. Tema forte em empresas de energia; ligado à proteção de dados (LGPD).
cards.ex: Energy companies are investing more in cybersecurity.
cards.nc: safety = segurança contra acidentes.

cards.f: data breach
cards.sig: violação de dados, vazamento de dados
cards.dica: breach = violação, brecha. Na Transpetro 2011 (q18), breaches e violations apareceram como par de sentido parecido.
cards.ex: The data breach exposed millions of customer records.
cards.nc: beach = praia; breath = fôlego.

cards.f: encryption
cards.sig: criptografia, cifragem
cards.dica: encrypt = criptografar; decrypt = descriptografar.
cards.ex: Encryption protects data while it travels on the network.
cards.nc: encoding = codificação (não é segurança).

cards.f: AI
cards.sig: IA, inteligência artificial (artificial intelligence)
cards.dica: Em inglês a sigla inverte: AI = IA. Já apareceu na BASA 2024 (Could AI save the Amazon rainforest?).
cards.ex: AI can predict equipment failures before they happen.
cards.nc: machine learning = aprendizado de máquina (um ramo da IA).

cards.f: workforce
cards.sig: força de trabalho, mão de obra
cards.dica: work + force. Já apareceu na BR Distribuidora 2011 (to be effective in the workforce).
cards.ex: The company needs to train its workforce in digital skills.
cards.nc: workload = carga de trabalho; workplace = local de trabalho.

cards.f: skills
cards.sig: habilidades, competências
cards.dica: skillset = conjunto de habilidades. Foi o tema do texto da BR Distribuidora 2011 (skillset x mindset).
cards.ex: Data analysis is one of the most valued skills today.
cards.nc: mindset = mentalidade; skilled = qualificado.

cards.f: revenue
cards.sig: receita, faturamento
cards.dica: O que entra com as vendas, antes dos custos. Já apareceu na Petrobras 2011 (addiction to oil revenues).
cards.ex: The company’s revenue rose 10% this year.
cards.nc: profit = lucro (receita menos custos); income = renda, rendimento.

cards.f: profit
cards.sig: lucro
cards.dica: profitable = lucrativo; profitability = rentabilidade. profit apareceu na Transpetro 2011 (maximize profit); profitability, na Transpetro 2023.
cards.ex: Higher oil prices increased the company’s profit.
cards.nc: revenue = receita; benefit = benefício.

cards.f: loss
cards.sig: prejuízo; perda
cards.dica: lose, lost, lost = perder. net loss = prejuízo líquido. Já apareceu na Transpetro 2011 (loss of products).
cards.ex: The airline reported a loss in the first quarter.
cards.nc: loose = solto; lose = perder.

cards.f: shareholders
cards.sig: acionistas
cards.dica: share = ação; holder = quem detém. Sinônimo: stockholders.
cards.ex: Shareholders approved the payment of dividends.
cards.nc: stakeholders = todos os interessados (funcionários, clientes, governo, comunidade).

cards.f: stakeholders
cards.sig: partes interessadas
cards.dica: Quem afeta ou é afetado pela empresa ou projeto. Já apareceu na BNDES 2024 (multi-stakeholder coalition). Cai em Governança e Projetos.
cards.ex: The project manager met with all stakeholders before the launch.
cards.nc: shareholders = só os acionistas.

cards.f: share
cards.sig: ação (de empresa); parcela, participação
cards.dica: market share = participação de mercado. the share of electricity in the energy mix = a parcela da eletricidade (já apareceu na Petrobras 2017).
cards.ex: Solar power increased its share of the energy mix.
cards.nc: to share = compartilhar.

cards.f: supply chain
cards.sig: cadeia de suprimentos
cards.dica: supply (fornecimento) + chain (corrente). Já apareceu na Transpetro 2011 (efficient supply chains).
cards.ex: The pandemic disrupted global supply chains.
cards.nc: value chain = cadeia de valor; logistics = logística.

cards.f: assets
cards.sig: ativos (bens e direitos de valor)
cards.dica: Já apareceu na Petrobras 2011 (very powerful assets). liabilities = passivos.
cards.ex: The company sold some assets to reduce its debt.
cards.nc: liabilities = passivos, obrigações.

cards.f: GDP
cards.sig: PIB, produto interno bruto
cards.dica: Gross Domestic Product. A sigla inverte a ordem: GDP = PIB. Já apareceu na Petrobras 2011 (per cent of GDP).
cards.ex: Oil accounts for a large part of the country’s GDP.
cards.nc: GNP = produto nacional bruto.

cards.f: procurement
cards.sig: compras, suprimentos (aquisição de bens e serviços)
cards.dica: Falso amigo: to procure = obter, adquirir; procurar = look for.
cards.ex: Procurement rules require at least three bids.
cards.nc: purchase = compra (o ato).

cards.f: compliance
cards.sig: conformidade (cumprir leis e normas)
cards.dica: comply with = cumprir. A área de compliance garante que a empresa siga as regras.
cards.ex: The compliance team checks if contracts follow the law.
cards.nc: complaint = reclamação.

cards.f: state-owned company
cards.sig: empresa estatal (controlada pelo governo)
cards.dica: state = Estado; owned = de propriedade. A Petrobras é controlada pela União.
cards.ex: The government is the main shareholder of the state-owned company.
cards.nc: privately owned = de capital privado.

cards.f: midstream
cards.sig: transporte e armazenamento (dutos, terminais, navios)
cards.dica: mid = meio. É o elo do meio da cadeia, onde atua a logística da Transpetro: dutos, terminais e navios.
cards.ex: Pipelines and storage terminals belong to the midstream segment.
cards.nc: mainstream = corrente principal, popular.

cards.f: oil well
cards.sig: poço de petróleo
cards.dica: well = bem (advérbio) e também poço. to drill a well = perfurar um poço.
cards.ex: Engineers drilled a new oil well in deep water.
cards.nc: as well as = assim como; wealth = riqueza.

cards.f: basin
cards.sig: bacia (sedimentar), região onde há petróleo
cards.dica: Santos Basin e Campos Basin = Bacia de Santos e Bacia de Campos. Já apareceu na Petrobras 2011 (Orinoco Basin).
cards.ex: Most pre-salt fields are in the Santos Basin.
cards.nc: basin também é pia, bacia de lavar.

cards.f: onshore
cards.sig: em terra (não no mar)
cards.dica: on + shore (costa) = na terra. É o oposto de offshore.
cards.ex: Onshore fields are usually cheaper to operate than offshore fields.
cards.nc: offshore = no mar; ashore = em terra firme, para a terra.

cards.f: vessel
cards.sig: embarcação, navio
cards.dica: vessel também é vaso, recipiente: blood vessel = vaso sanguíneo.
cards.ex: The vessel arrived at the terminal early this morning.
cards.nc: ship = navio; boat = barco.

cards.f: fleet
cards.sig: frota
cards.dica: fleet = conjunto de navios, caminhões ou carros (de uma empresa ou de um país). Já apareceu na Petrobras 2017 (a doubling of the car fleet to two billion).
cards.ex: The company plans to renew its fleet of tankers.
cards.nc: flee = fugir; float = flutuar.

cards.f: shipping
cards.sig: transporte marítimo; envio de cargas
cards.dica: ship = navio, mas to ship = enviar (por qualquer meio). shipping costs = frete. Já apareceu na Petrobras 2017.
cards.ex: Shipping costs rose after the storm closed the port.
cards.nc: shipment = carga, remessa; shopping = compras.

cards.f: leak
cards.sig: vazamento; vazar
cards.dica: leak = escapar aos poucos (gás, óleo, água) ou vazar informação (data leak).
cards.ex: Sensors detected a gas leak in the pipeline.
cards.nc: spill = derramamento; lake = lago.

cards.f: LNG
cards.sig: GNL, gás natural liquefeito
cards.dica: Liquefied Natural Gas: gás resfriado a cerca de 162 graus negativos para virar líquido e viajar de navio. Já apareceu na Petrobras 2017.
cards.ex: The country imports LNG by ship during dry years.
cards.nc: LPG = GLP (gás de botijão); CNG = GNV (gás natural comprimido).

cards.f: LPG
cards.sig: GLP, gás liquefeito de petróleo (gás de cozinha)
cards.dica: Liquefied Petroleum Gas: o gás de botijão.
cards.ex: Many families use LPG cylinders for cooking.
cards.nc: LNG = gás natural liquefeito.

cards.f: decommissioning
cards.sig: descomissionamento (desativar e remover plataformas)
cards.dica: de- (desfazer) + commission (pôr em operação). Tema atual: retirar plataformas antigas com segurança.
cards.ex: The decommissioning of old platforms must protect the marine environment.
cards.nc: commissioning = comissionamento, colocar uma instalação em operação.

cards.f: stake
cards.sig: participação (acionária) num negócio
cards.dica: hold a 30% stake = ter 30% de participação. stakeholders vem daí: quem tem algo em jogo.
cards.ex: The company sold a 30% stake in the oil field.
cards.nc: steak = bife (mesma pronúncia); at stake = em jogo.

cards.f: subsea
cards.sig: submarino (no fundo do mar)
cards.dica: sub (abaixo) + sea (mar). subsea equipment = equipamentos submarinos.
cards.ex: Robots inspect subsea pipelines on the seabed.
cards.nc: submarine = submarino, o veículo.

cards.f: FPSO
cards.sig: navio-plataforma que produz, armazena e transfere petróleo
cards.dica: Floating Production, Storage and Offloading. Tipo de plataforma muito usado no pré-sal.
cards.ex: The new FPSO will start production next year.
cards.nc: rig = sonda de perfuração; FPSO = unidade de produção.

cards.f: maintenance
cards.sig: manutenção
cards.dica: maintain (manter) muda a grafia: maintenance. scheduled maintenance = manutenção programada. Já apareceu na Transpetro 2023 (preventative maintenance).
cards.ex: The refinery stopped for scheduled maintenance.
cards.nc: maintain = manter; remain = permanecer.

cards.f: hazard
cards.sig: perigo, fonte de risco
cards.dica: hazardous materials = materiais perigosos. HSE = health, safety and environment (em português, SMS).
cards.ex: Gas leaks are a serious hazard on offshore platforms.
cards.nc: risk = a chance de dano; hazard = o que pode causar o dano.

cards.f: decarbonization
cards.sig: descarbonização (reduzir as emissões de carbono)
cards.dica: de- (retirar) + carbon + -ization. decarbonize the grid = descarbonizar a rede (Eletronuclear 2022).
cards.ex: The decarbonization of shipping requires new fuels.
cards.nc: carbonization = carbonização (outra coisa).

cards.f: carbon footprint
cards.sig: pegada de carbono
cards.dica: footprint = pegada. Total de gases de efeito estufa que uma pessoa, produto ou empresa gera. Já apareceu na Eletronuclear 2022 (Its carbon footprint is equivalent to wind).
cards.ex: Electric buses can reduce the city’s carbon footprint.
cards.nc: fingerprint = impressão digital.

cards.f: offset
cards.sig: compensar; compensação
cards.dica: offset = contrabalançar. carbon offset = compensação de carbono. Já apareceu na Transpetro 2018 (would offset most of the current OPEC production cuts).
cards.ex: The airline plants trees to offset part of its emissions.
cards.nc: onset = início; outset = começo.

cards.f: wind farm
cards.sig: parque eólico
cards.dica: farm aqui não é fazenda: wind farm = conjunto de turbinas; solar farm = usina solar. Já apareceu na Eletronuclear 2022.
cards.ex: A new offshore wind farm will supply energy to 500,000 homes.
cards.nc: wind turbine = turbina eólica.

cards.f: power outage
cards.sig: queda de energia, apagão
cards.dica: outage = interrupção. Em TI, outage = sistema fora do ar. blackout = apagão geral.
cards.ex: The storm caused a power outage in three states.
cards.nc: output = produção; outrage = indignação.

cards.f: global warming
cards.sig: aquecimento global
cards.dica: warm = morno, quente; warming = aquecimento.
cards.ex: Global warming increases the risk of extreme weather.
cards.nc: climate change = mudança climática.

cards.f: drought
cards.sig: seca, estiagem
cards.dica: Afeta hidrelétricas e agricultura. Pronúncia: draut.
cards.ex: A long drought reduced the water levels of the dams.
cards.nc: draught = corrente de ar (Reino Unido); thought = pensamento.

cards.f: flood
cards.sig: enchente, inundação
cards.dica: No sentido figurado, enxurrada: a flood of cheap Chinese-made imports (já apareceu na Petrobras 2011).
cards.ex: Heavy rain caused floods in the south of the country.
cards.nc: food = comida; floor = chão.

cards.f: wildfire
cards.sig: incêndio florestal
cards.dica: wild (selvagem) + fire (fogo).
cards.ex: Wildfires destroyed large areas of forest.
cards.nc: firework = fogo de artifício.

cards.f: deforestation
cards.sig: desmatamento
cards.dica: de- (retirar) + forest. Palavra-chave da prova da BASA 2024 (IA contra o desmatamento na Amazônia): só no texto, aparece 15 vezes.
cards.ex: Satellite images help to monitor deforestation in the Amazon.
cards.nc: reforestation = reflorestamento.

cards.f: sea level rise
cards.sig: elevação do nível do mar
cards.dica: rise = subida. Consequência do aquecimento global. Apareceu numa alternativa da BASA 2024 (q9).
cards.ex: Sea level rise threatens coastal cities.
cards.nc: see (ver) tem o mesmo som de sea.

cards.f: ESG
cards.sig: critérios ambientais, sociais e de governança
cards.dica: Environmental, Social and Governance. Investidores usam para avaliar empresas.
cards.ex: Investors now look closely at a company’s ESG performance.
cards.nc: CSR = corporate social responsibility (responsabilidade social).

cards.f: ramp up
cards.sig: aumentar aos poucos (a produção)
cards.dica: ramp = rampa. ramp-up = período em que um campo novo aumenta a produção.
cards.ex: The new platform will ramp up production over the next year.
cards.nc: scale up = ampliar a escala.

cards.f: tackle
cards.sig: enfrentar, combater (um problema)
cards.dica: tackle climate change = enfrentar a mudança climática. Sinônimos: address, fight, deal with.
cards.ex: Governments must work together to tackle pollution.
cards.nc: address também é tratar de: address climate change concerns (BNDES 2024).

cards.f: pledge
cards.sig: compromisso público, promessa; prometer
cards.dica: climate pledge = compromisso climático. pledge to = comprometer-se a.
cards.ex: Several countries made a pledge to end deforestation.
cards.nc: commitment = compromisso.

cards.f: commitment
cards.sig: compromisso, dedicação
cards.dica: commit = comprometer-se. Falso amigo: compromise = acordo com concessões, não compromisso. Apareceu numa alternativa da Petrobras 2012 (q19: show commitment to the working routine).
cards.ex: The company reaffirmed its commitment to safety.
cards.nc: compromise = acordo em que cada lado cede; appointment = compromisso de agenda.

cards.f: breakthrough
cards.sig: avanço decisivo, grande descoberta
cards.dica: break (quebrar) + through (através): romper uma barreira.
cards.ex: Scientists announced a breakthrough in battery technology.
cards.nc: breakdown = pane, colapso.

cards.f: feasibility
cards.sig: viabilidade
cards.dica: feasible = viável (apareceu na Transpetro 2023, q14: is feasible). feasibility study = estudo de viabilidade.
cards.ex: The feasibility study showed that the project is profitable.
cards.nc: possibility = possibilidade.

cards.f: surplus
cards.sig: excedente, superávit
cards.dica: sur (sobre) + plus (mais). trade surplus = superávit comercial.
cards.ex: Oil exports helped the country achieve a trade surplus.
cards.nc: deficit = déficit (o oposto).

cards.f: cloud computing
cards.sig: computação em nuvem
cards.dica: cloud = nuvem. in the cloud = em servidores na internet, não no seu computador. Já apareceu na BASA 2024 (the cloud computing power they needed).
cards.ex: With cloud computing, employees can access files from anywhere.
cards.nc: crowd = multidão; clown = palhaço.

cards.f: ransomware
cards.sig: sequestro de dados mediante resgate
cards.dica: ransom = resgate. O criminoso criptografa os dados e cobra para liberar.
cards.ex: A ransomware attack locked the company’s files for days.
cards.nc: malware = qualquer software malicioso.

cards.f: phishing
cards.sig: golpe com mensagem falsa para roubar dados
cards.dica: Soa como fishing (pescar): a isca é um e-mail ou link falso.
cards.ex: Employees learned how to spot phishing emails.
cards.nc: spam = mensagem não solicitada (não necessariamente golpe).

cards.f: password
cards.sig: senha
cards.dica: pass (passar) + word (palavra). strong password = senha forte.
cards.ex: Never share your password with anyone.
cards.nc: passport = passaporte.

cards.f: machine learning
cards.sig: aprendizado de máquina
cards.dica: Ramo da IA em que o sistema aprende padrões a partir de dados.
cards.ex: Machine learning models analyze sensor data from the pipelines.
cards.nc: deep learning = aprendizado profundo (redes neurais).

cards.f: automation
cards.sig: automação
cards.dica: automate = automatizar. automated driving = direção autônoma (já apareceu na Transpetro 2023).
cards.ex: Automation reduced the time needed to process invoices.
cards.nc: autonomous = autônomo.

cards.f: device
cards.sig: dispositivo, aparelho
cards.dica: mobile device = celular ou tablet.
cards.ex: Every device connected to the network must be protected.
cards.nc: advice = conselho; devise = criar, planejar.

cards.f: data-driven
cards.sig: orientado por dados
cards.dica: -driven = movido a, guiado por. driven by = motivated by (Transpetro 2018, q16).
